title: ARC-AGI-2 Technical Report
summary: The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC) is designed to assess generalization beyond pattern matching, requiring models to infer symbolic rules from very few examples. In this work, we present a transformer-based system that advances ARC performance by combining neural inference with structure-aware priors and online task adaptation. Our approach is built on four key ideas. First, we reformulate ARC reasoning as a sequence modeling problem using a compact task encoding with only 125 tokens, enabling efficient long-context processing with a modified LongT5 architecture. Second, we introduce a principled augmentation framework based on group symmetries, grid traversals, and automata perturbations, enforcing invariance to representation changes. Third, we apply test-time training (TTT) with lightweight LoRA adaptation, allowing the model to specialize to each unseen task by learning its transformation logic from demonstrations. Fourth, we design a symmetry-aware decoding and scoring pipeline that aggregates likelihoods across augmented task views, effectively performing ``multi-perspective reasoning'' over candidate solutions. We demonstrate that these components work synergistically: augmentations expand hypothesis space, TTT sharpens local reasoning, and symmetry-based scoring improves solution consistency. Our final system achieves a significant improvement over transformer baselines and surpasses prior neural ARC solvers, closing the gap toward human-level generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer的系统，通过结合神经推理、结构感知先验和在线任务适应，显著提升了在抽象推理语料库（ARC）上的性能表现。
AI.motivation: ARC旨在评估超越模式匹配的泛化能力，要求模型从极少示例中推断符号规则。现有方法在解决这类需要抽象推理的任务时仍存在挑战，需要开发能够有效处理符号推理和少样本学习的系统。
AI.method: 方法包含四个核心创新：1）将ARC推理重构为序列建模问题，使用紧凑任务编码和修改的LongT5架构；2）基于群对称性、网格遍历和自动机扰动的增强框架；3）测试时训练（TTT）与轻量级LoRA适应；4）对称感知解码和评分管道，实现"多视角推理"。
AI.result: 最终系统显著超越了Transformer基线和先前的神经ARC求解器，缩小了与人类水平泛化能力的差距。各组件协同工作：增强扩展了假设空间，TTT提升了局部推理能力，基于对称性的评分改善了解决方案的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合神经推理、结构感知先验和在线任务适应，本文提出的系统在ARC任务上取得了显著进展，展示了这些组件在解决复杂抽象推理问题时的协同效应，为迈向人类水平的泛化能力提供了重要进展。

title: Hierarchical Latent Structures in Data Generation Process Unify Mechanistic Phenomena across Scale
summary: Contemporary studies have uncovered many puzzling phenomena in the neural information processing of Transformer-based language models. Building a robust, unified understanding of these phenomena requires disassembling a model within the scope of its training. While the intractable scale of pretraining corpora limits a bottom-up investigation in this direction, simplistic assumptions of the data generation process limit the expressivity and fail to explain complex patterns. In this work, we use probabilistic context-free grammars (PCFGs) to generate synthetic corpora that are faithful and computationally efficient proxies for web-scale text corpora. We investigate the emergence of three mechanistic phenomena: induction heads, function vectors, and the Hydra effect, under our designed data generation process, as well as in the checkpoints of real-world language models. Our findings suggest that hierarchical structures in the data generation process serve as the X-factor in explaining the emergence of these phenomena. We provide the theoretical underpinnings of the role played by hierarchy in the training dynamics of language models. In a nutshell, our work is the first of its kind to provide a unified explanation behind the emergence of seemingly unrelated mechanistic phenomena in LLMs, augmented with efficient synthetic tooling for future interpretability research.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用概率上下文无关文法生成合成语料库，解释Transformer语言模型中三种机制现象（归纳头、函数向量、Hydra效应）的出现，发现数据生成过程中的层次结构是这些现象出现的关键因素。
AI.motivation: 当前研究发现了Transformer语言模型中许多令人困惑的神经信息处理现象，需要建立对这些现象的统一理解。由于预训练语料库规模庞大难以进行自下而上的研究，而简单的数据生成假设又无法解释复杂模式。
AI.method: 使用概率上下文无关文法生成合成语料库，作为网络规模文本语料库的高效代理。研究在设计的数生成过程中以及真实语言模型检查点中三种机制现象的出现：归纳头、函数向量和Hydra效应。
AI.result: 研究发现数据生成过程中的层次结构是解释这些现象出现的关键因素。为层次结构在语言模型训练动态中的作用提供了理论基础。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个为LLM中看似无关的机制现象提供统一解释的工作，并为未来可解释性研究提供了高效的合成工具。

title: Hierarchical Embedding Fusion for Retrieval-Augmented Code Generation
summary:
Retrieval-augmented code generation often conditions the decoder on large retrieved code snippets. This ties online inference cost to repository size and introduces noise from long contexts. We present Hierarchical Embedding Fusion (HEF), a two-stage approach to repository representation for code completion. First, an offline cache compresses repository chunks into a reusable hierarchy of dense vectors using a small fuser model. Second, an online interface maps a small number of retrieved vectors into learned pseudo-tokens that are consumed by the code generator. This replaces thousands of retrieved tokens with a fixed pseudo-token budget while preserving access to repository-level information.
  On RepoBench and RepoEval, HEF with a 1.8B-parameter pipeline achieves exact-match accuracy comparable to snippet-based retrieval baselines, while operating at sub-second median latency on a single A100 GPU. Compared to graph-based and iterative retrieval systems in our experimental setup, HEF reduces median end-to-end latency by 13 to 26 times. We also introduce a utility-weighted likelihood signal for filtering training contexts and report ablation studies on pseudo-token budget, embedding models, and robustness to harmful retrieval. Overall, these results indicate that hierarchical dense caching is an effective mechanism for low-latency, repository-aware code completion.

AI.tldr: HEF提出了一种用于代码补全的分层嵌入融合方法，通过离线缓存将代码库压缩为密集向量层次结构，在线阶段将少量检索向量映射为伪标记，显著降低延迟同时保持代码库信息访问。
AI.motivation: 传统基于检索的代码生成方法通常将解码器与大型检索代码片段绑定，这导致在线推理成本与代码库大小相关，并且长上下文会引入噪声。需要一种既能访问代码库信息又能保持低延迟的方法。
AI.method: 提出分层嵌入融合（HEF）方法：1）离线阶段使用小型融合模型将代码库块压缩为可重用的密集向量层次结构；2）在线阶段将少量检索向量映射为学习的伪标记，供代码生成器使用，用固定伪标记预算替代数千个检索标记。
AI.result: 在RepoBench和RepoEval基准测试中，1.8B参数的HEF管道实现了与基于片段检索基线相当的精确匹配准确率，同时在单个A100 GPU上实现亚秒级中位延迟。相比基于图和迭代检索系统，HEF将端到端中位延迟降低了13-26倍。
AI.conclusion: 分层密集缓存是实现低延迟、代码库感知代码补全的有效机制，通过压缩表示和伪标记映射在保持性能的同时显著降低计算成本。

title: A Coin Flip for Safety: LLM Judges Fail to Reliably Measure Adversarial Robustness
summary: Automated \enquote{LLM-as-a-Judge} frameworks have become the de facto standard for scalable evaluation across natural language processing. For instance, in safety evaluation, these judges are relied upon to evaluate harmfulness in order to benchmark the robustness of safety against adversarial attacks. However, we show that existing validation protocols fail to account for substantial distribution shifts inherent to red-teaming: diverse victim models exhibit distinct generation styles, attacks distort output patterns, and semantic ambiguity varies significantly across jailbreak scenarios. Through a comprehensive audit using 6642 human-verified labels, we reveal that the unpredictable interaction of these shifts often causes judge performance to degrade to near random chance. This stands in stark contrast to the high human agreement reported in prior work. Crucially, we find that many attacks inflate their success rates by exploiting judge insufficiencies rather than eliciting genuinely harmful content. To enable more reliable evaluation, we propose ReliableBench, a benchmark of behaviors that remain more consistently judgeable, and JudgeStressTest, a dataset designed to expose judge failures. Data available at: https://github.com/SchwinnL/LLMJudgeReliability.

AI.tldr: 研究发现现有LLM-as-a-Judge框架在安全评估中存在严重可靠性问题，法官模型性能在对抗攻击场景下可能降至随机水平，许多攻击通过利用法官缺陷而非真正引出有害内容来夸大成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM-as-a-Judge框架已成为NLP领域可扩展评估的标准方法，特别是在安全评估中用于衡量模型对对抗攻击的鲁棒性。然而，作者发现现有验证协议未能考虑红队测试中固有的显著分布偏移问题。
AI.method: 通过使用6642个人工验证标签进行全面审计，分析不同受害模型的生成风格差异、攻击对输出模式的扭曲以及越狱场景中的语义模糊性变化。提出ReliableBench基准和JudgeStressTest数据集来暴露法官失败。
AI.result: 研究发现这些分布偏移的不可预测交互常导致法官性能降至接近随机水平，与先前工作报告的高人类一致性形成鲜明对比。许多攻击通过利用法官不足而非真正引出有害内容来夸大成功率。
AI.conclusion: 现有LLM-as-a-Judge框架在安全评估中存在严重可靠性问题，需要更可靠的评估方法。提出的ReliableBench和JudgeStressTest为改进法官模型评估提供了工具。

title: Roots Beneath the Cut: Uncovering the Risk of Concept Revival in Pruning-Based Unlearning for Diffusion Models
comment: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2026
summary: Pruning-based unlearning has recently emerged as a fast, training-free, and data-independent approach to remove undesired concepts from diffusion models. It promises high efficiency and robustness, offering an attractive alternative to traditional fine-tuning or editing-based unlearning. However, in this paper we uncover a hidden danger behind this promising paradigm. We find that the locations of pruned weights, typically set to zero during unlearning, can act as side-channel signals that leak critical information about the erased concepts. To verify this vulnerability, we design a novel attack framework capable of reviving erased concepts from pruned diffusion models in a fully data-free and training-free manner. Our experiments confirm that pruning-based unlearning is not inherently secure, as erased concepts can be effectively revived without any additional data or retraining. Extensive experiments on diffusion-based unlearning based on concept related weights lead to the conclusion: once the critical concept-related weights in diffusion models are identified, our method can effectively recover the original concept regardless of how the weights are manipulated. Finally, we explore potential defense strategies and advocate safer pruning mechanisms that conceal pruning locations while preserving unlearning effectiveness, providing practical insights for designing more secure pruning-based unlearning frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了基于剪枝的遗忘方法在扩散模型中的安全隐患：被剪枝的权重位置会泄露被删除概念的信息，使得攻击者可以在无需数据和训练的情况下恢复被遗忘的概念。
AI.motivation: 基于剪枝的遗忘方法因其快速、无需训练和数据独立的特点而备受关注，但本文发现这种方法存在安全隐患。被剪枝的权重位置可能作为侧信道信号泄露被删除概念的关键信息，这使得看似安全的遗忘方法实际上并不安全。
AI.method: 设计了一个新颖的攻击框架，能够在完全无需数据和训练的情况下从剪枝后的扩散模型中恢复被删除的概念。通过识别与概念相关的关键权重位置，无论这些权重如何被操纵，都能有效恢复原始概念。
AI.result: 实验证实了基于剪枝的遗忘方法并不安全，被删除的概念可以在无需额外数据或重新训练的情况下被有效恢复。一旦识别出扩散模型中与概念相关的关键权重，无论这些权重如何被操纵，都能成功恢复原始概念。
AI.conclusion: 基于剪枝的遗忘方法存在严重的安全漏洞。作者探索了潜在的防御策略，倡导更安全的剪枝机制，在保持遗忘效果的同时隐藏剪枝位置，为设计更安全的基于剪枝的遗忘框架提供了实用见解。

title: Autonomous AI Agents for Option Hedging: Enhancing Financial Stability through Shortfall Aware Reinforcement Learning
summary: The deployment of autonomous AI agents in derivatives markets has widened a practical gap between static model calibration and realized hedging outcomes. We introduce two reinforcement learning frameworks, a novel Replication Learning of Option Pricing (RLOP) approach and an adaptive extension of Q-learner in Black-Scholes (QLBS), that prioritize shortfall probability and align learning objectives with downside sensitive hedging. Using listed SPY and XOP options, we evaluate models using realized path delta hedging outcome distributions, shortfall probability, and tail risk measures such as Expected Shortfall. Empirically, RLOP reduces shortfall frequency in most slices and shows the clearest tail-risk improvements in stress, while implied volatility fit often favors parametric models yet poorly predicts after-cost hedging performance. This friction-aware RL framework supports a practical approach to autonomous derivatives risk management as AI-augmented trading systems scale.

AI.tldr: 论文提出两种强化学习框架（RLOP和QLBS）用于期权对冲，重点关注尾部风险和回撤概率，实证显示RLOP在压力情景下能有效降低回撤频率和尾部风险。
AI.motivation: 自主AI代理在衍生品市场的应用导致静态模型校准与实际对冲结果之间存在实践差距，需要开发更关注下行风险的对冲方法。
AI.method: 提出两种强化学习框架：新颖的期权定价复制学习（RLOP）方法和Black-Scholes中Q学习器的自适应扩展（QLBS），重点关注回撤概率和下行敏感的对冲目标。
AI.result: 使用SPY和XOP期权进行实证评估，RLOP在大多数时间切片中降低了回撤频率，在压力情景下显示出最明显的尾部风险改善，而隐含波动率拟合虽然有利于参数模型但无法预测成本后的对冲表现。
AI.conclusion: 这种关注摩擦的强化学习框架为自主衍生品风险管理提供了实用方法，支持AI增强交易系统的扩展应用。

title: Rethinking Personalization in Large Language Models at the Token Level
summary: With large language models (LLMs) now performing strongly across diverse tasks, there is growing demand for them to personalize outputs for individual users. Personalization is typically framed as an additional layer on top of a base NLP task, requiring model responses to meet user-specific needs while still accomplishing the underlying task. From a token-level perspective, different tokens in a response contribute to personalization to varying degrees. Tokens with higher personalization relevance should therefore receive greater emphasis when developing personalized LLMs. However, accurately estimating such personalization degrees remains challenging. To address this challenge, we propose PerContrast, a self-contrast method that estimates each output token's dependence on user-specific information through causal intervention. Building on this mechanism, we develop the PerCE loss, which adaptively upweights tokens with higher estimated personalization degrees during training via a bootstrap procedure, enabling the model to alternate between estimating and optimizing these tokens. Experiments on multiple LLMs demonstrate that PerCE substantially improves personalization performance with minimal additional cost, achieving average gains of over 10% and up to 68.04% on the LongLaMP dataset, along with strong cross-task and cross-scenario transferability. These results highlight the importance of token-level personalization modeling and establish token-aware training as a simple yet effective paradigm for advancing personalized LLMs.

AI.tldr: PerContrast提出了一种基于自对比的token级个性化建模方法，通过因果干预估计输出token对用户特定信息的依赖程度，并使用PerCE损失自适应地加权高个性化程度的token进行训练，显著提升LLM个性化性能。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型在各种任务中表现优异，用户对个性化输出的需求日益增长。个性化通常被视为在基础NLP任务之上的附加层，需要模型在完成底层任务的同时满足用户特定需求。从token层面看，响应中的不同token对个性化的贡献程度不同，高个性化相关性的token应在开发个性化LLM时获得更多关注，但准确估计这种个性化程度仍具挑战性。
AI.method: 提出PerContrast自对比方法，通过因果干预估计每个输出token对用户特定信息的依赖程度。在此基础上开发PerCE损失，通过引导程序在训练过程中自适应地加权估计出的高个性化程度token，使模型能够在估计和优化这些token之间交替进行。
AI.result: 在多个LLM上的实验表明，PerCE以最小额外成本显著提升个性化性能，在LongLaMP数据集上平均提升超过10%，最高达68.04%，并展现出强大的跨任务和跨场景可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了token级个性化建模的重要性，并将token感知训练确立为推进个性化LLM发展的简单而有效的范式。

title: ObjChangeVR: Object State Change Reasoning from Continuous Egocentric Views in VR Environments
comment: European Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics (EACL) 2026 Main
summary: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer a promising approach for natural language-based scene change queries in virtual reality (VR). Prior work on applying MLLMs for object state understanding has focused on egocentric videos that capture the camera wearer's interactions with objects. However, object state changes may occur in the background without direct user interaction, lacking explicit motion cues and making them difficult to detect. Moreover, no benchmark exists for evaluating this challenging scenario. To address these challenges, we introduce ObjChangeVR-Dataset, specifically for benchmarking the question-answering task of object state change. We also propose ObjChangeVR, a framework that combines viewpoint-aware and temporal-based retrieval to identify relevant frames, along with cross-view reasoning that reconciles inconsistent evidence from multiple viewpoints. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ObjChangeVR significantly outperforms baseline approaches across multiple MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ObjChangeVR框架和数据集，用于解决VR场景中背景物体状态变化的检测问题，通过多视角推理和时序检索来提升MLLMs在物体状态变化问答任务上的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLMs在物体状态理解方面主要关注用户直接交互的物体，但VR场景中背景物体状态变化缺乏明显运动线索且难以检测，同时缺乏针对这一挑战性场景的基准数据集。
AI.method: 提出ObjChangeVR框架，结合视角感知和时序检索来识别相关帧，并通过跨视角推理协调来自多个视角的不一致证据，同时构建了专门的ObjChangeVR-Dataset基准数据集。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，ObjChangeVR框架在多个MLLMs上显著优于基线方法，证明了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究填补了VR场景中背景物体状态变化检测的空白，提出的框架和数据集为这一挑战性任务提供了有效的解决方案和评估基准。

title: Scaling Strategy, Not Compute: A Stand-Alone, Open-Source StarCraft II Benchmark for Accessible Reinforcement Learning Research
summary: The research community lacks a middle ground between StarCraft IIs full game and its mini-games. The full-games sprawling state-action space renders reward signals sparse and noisy, but in mini-games simple agents saturate performance. This complexity gap hinders steady curriculum design and prevents researchers from experimenting with modern Reinforcement Learning algorithms in RTS environments under realistic compute budgets. To fill this gap, we present the Two-Bridge Map Suite, the first entry in an open-source benchmark series we purposely engineered as an intermediate benchmark to sit between these extremes. By disabling economy mechanics such as resource collection, base building, and fog-of-war, the environment isolates two core tactical skills: long-range navigation and micro-combat. Preliminary experiments show that agents learn coherent maneuvering and engagement behaviors without imposing full-game computational costs. Two-Bridge is released as a lightweight, Gym-compatible wrapper on top of PySC2, with maps, wrappers, and reference scripts fully open-sourced to encourage broad adoption as a standard benchmark.

AI.tldr: Two-Bridge Map Suite填补了星际争霸II完整游戏与迷你游戏之间的复杂度空白，作为中间基准测试环境，专注于战术技能训练
AI.motivation: 研究社区缺乏星际争霸II完整游戏与迷你游戏之间的中间复杂度环境。完整游戏状态-动作空间庞大导致奖励信号稀疏且嘈杂，而迷你游戏中简单代理就能达到饱和性能。这种复杂度差距阻碍了渐进式课程设计，使研究人员无法在现实计算预算下在RTS环境中实验现代强化学习算法。
AI.method: 通过禁用经济机制（如资源收集、基地建设、战争迷雾），创建Two-Bridge Map Suite环境，专注于两个核心战术技能：远程导航和微操作战斗。该环境作为轻量级、兼容Gym的PySC2包装器发布。
AI.result: 初步实验显示，代理能够学习连贯的机动和交战行为，而无需承担完整游戏的计算成本。该环境作为开源基准测试发布，包含地图、包装器和参考脚本。
AI.conclusion: Two-Bridge Map Suite填补了星际争霸II完整游戏与迷你游戏之间的复杂度空白，为研究人员提供了一个中间基准测试环境，能够在现实计算预算下实验强化学习算法，专注于战术技能训练。

title: Margin-Consistent Deep Subtyping of Invasive Lung Adenocarcinoma via Perturbation Fidelity in Whole-Slide Image Analysis
comment: This document is the author's accepted manuscript (author version). The final published version is available online in the Journal of Imaging Informatics in Medicine at DOI: 10.1007/s10278-026-01875-6
summary: Whole-slide image classification for invasive lung adenocarcinoma subtyping remains vulnerable to real-world imaging perturbations that undermine model reliability at the decision boundary. We propose a margin consistency framework evaluated on 203,226 patches from 143 whole-slide images spanning five adenocarcinoma subtypes in the BMIRDS-LUAD dataset. By combining attention-weighted patch aggregation with margin-aware training, our approach achieves robust feature-logit space alignment measured by Kendall correlations of 0.88 during training and 0.64 during validation. Contrastive regularization, while effective at improving class separation, tends to over-cluster features and suppress fine-grained morphological variation; to counteract this, we introduce Perturbation Fidelity (PF) scoring, which imposes structured perturbations through Bayesian-optimized parameters. Vision Transformer-Large achieves 95.20 +/- 4.65% accuracy, representing a 40% error reduction from the 92.00 +/- 5.36% baseline, while ResNet101 with an attention mechanism reaches 95.89 +/- 5.37% from 91.73 +/- 9.23%, a 50% error reduction. All five subtypes exceed an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.99. On the WSSS4LUAD external benchmark, ResNet50 with an attention mechanism attains 80.1% accuracy, demonstrating cross-institutional generalizability despite approximately 15-20% domain-shift-related degradation and identifying opportunities for future adaptation research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于肺腺癌亚型分类的边界一致性框架，通过注意力加权补丁聚合和边界感知训练，在真实世界图像扰动下提高了模型鲁棒性和分类准确性。
AI.motivation: 全切片图像分类在肺腺癌亚型识别中容易受到真实世界成像扰动的影响，特别是在决策边界附近会降低模型可靠性，需要开发更鲁棒的分类方法。
AI.method: 提出边界一致性框架，结合注意力加权补丁聚合和边界感知训练，引入扰动保真度评分，通过贝叶斯优化参数施加结构化扰动，使用Vision Transformer-Large和ResNet101等模型进行评估。
AI.result: Vision Transformer-Large达到95.20±4.65%准确率，比基线92.00±5.36%减少40%误差；ResNet101达到95.89±5.37%准确率，比基线91.73±9.23%减少50%误差；所有五个亚型的AUC均超过0.99；在外部基准测试中ResNet50达到80.1%准确率。
AI.conclusion: 边界一致性框架显著提高了肺腺癌亚型分类的鲁棒性和准确性，尽管存在约15-20%的域偏移相关性能下降，但展示了跨机构泛化能力，为未来适应性研究提供了机会。

title: MultiGen: Level-Design for Editable Multiplayer Worlds in Diffusion Game Engines
summary: Video world models have shown immense promise for interactive simulation and entertainment, but current systems still struggle with two important aspects of interactivity: user control over the environment for reproducible, editable experiences, and shared inference where players hold influence over a common world. To address these limitations, we introduce an explicit external memory into the system, a persistent state operating independent of the model's context window, that is continually updated by user actions and queried throughout the generation roll-out. Unlike conventional diffusion game engines that operate as next-frame predictors, our approach decomposes generation into Memory, Observation, and Dynamics modules. This design gives users direct, editable control over environment structure via an editable memory representation, and it naturally extends to real-time multiplayer rollouts with coherent viewpoints and consistent cross-player interactions.

AI.tldr: 提出一种具有显式外部记忆的视频世界模型，支持用户可编辑控制和实时多人共享推理
AI.motivation: 当前视频世界模型在交互性方面存在两个主要问题：用户对环境的可控性不足（难以实现可重现、可编辑的体验），以及缺乏共享推理能力（多个玩家无法共同影响同一个世界）
AI.method: 引入显式外部记忆系统，作为独立于模型上下文窗口的持久状态，持续更新用户动作并在生成过程中查询；将生成分解为记忆、观察和动态三个模块，不同于传统的下一帧预测扩散游戏引擎
AI.result: 通过可编辑的记忆表示，用户可以直编辑控制环境结构；系统自然扩展到实时多人推演，保持一致的视角和跨玩家交互的连贯性
AI.conclusion: 提出的显式外部记忆架构解决了视频世界模型在用户控制和共享推理方面的关键限制，为可编辑、可重现的交互体验和实时多人应用提供了有效解决方案

title: Validation of a Small Language Model for DSM-5 Substance Category Classification in Child Welfare Records
summary: Background: Recent studies have demonstrated that large language models (LLMs) can perform binary classification tasks on child welfare narratives, detecting the presence or absence of constructs such as substance-related problems, domestic violence, and firearms involvement. Whether smaller, locally deployable models can move beyond binary detection to classify specific substance types from these narratives remains untested. Objective: To validate a locally hosted LLM classifier for identifying specific substance types aligned with DSM-5 categories in child welfare investigation narratives. Methods: A locally hosted 20-billion-parameter LLM classified child maltreatment investigation narratives from a Midwestern U.S. state. Records previously identified as containing substance-related problems were passed to a second classification stage targeting seven DSM-5 substance categories. Expert human review of 900 stratified cases assessed classification precision, recall, and inter-method reliability (Cohen's kappa). Test-retest stability was evaluated using approximately 15,000 independently classified records. Results: Five substance categories achieved almost perfect inter-method agreement (kappa = 0.94-1.00): alcohol, cannabis, opioid, stimulant, and sedative/hypnotic/anxiolytic. Classification precision ranged from 92% to 100% for these categories. Two low-prevalence categories (hallucinogen, inhalant) performed poorly. Test-retest agreement ranged from 92.1% to 99.1% across the seven categories. Conclusions: A small, locally hosted LLM can reliably classify substance types from child welfare administrative text, extending prior work on binary classification to multi-label substance identification.

AI.tldr: 小型本地部署的LLM能够从儿童福利叙事中可靠地分类特定物质类型，扩展了之前的二元分类工作
AI.motivation: 验证本地部署的小型语言模型是否能够超越二元检测，从儿童福利调查叙事中分类特定的物质类型，这些类型与DSM-5分类标准对齐
AI.method: 使用本地部署的200亿参数LLM对儿童虐待调查叙事进行分类；首先筛选出包含物质相关问题的记录，然后进行第二阶段分类，针对7个DSM-5物质类别；通过专家人工审查900个分层案例评估分类精度、召回率和方法间可靠性；使用约15,000个独立分类记录评估重测稳定性
AI.result: 5个物质类别（酒精、大麻、阿片类、兴奋剂、镇静/催眠/抗焦虑药）实现了几乎完美的方法间一致性（kappa=0.94-1.00），分类精度达92%-100%；两个低流行率类别（致幻剂、吸入剂）表现不佳；7个类别的重测一致性范围为92.1%-99.1%
AI.conclusion: 小型本地部署的LLM能够可靠地从儿童福利行政文本中分类物质类型，将先前关于二元分类的工作扩展到多标签物质识别

title: PaLMR: Towards Faithful Visual Reasoning via Multimodal Process Alignment
summary: Reinforcement learning has recently improved the reasoning ability of Large Language Models and Multimodal LLMs, yet prevailing reward designs emphasise final-answer correctness and consequently tolerate process hallucinations--cases where models reach the right answer while misperceiving visual evidence. We address this process-level misalignment with PaLMR, a framework that aligns not only outcomes but also the reasoning process itself. PaLMR comprises two complementary components: a perception-aligned data layer that constructs process-aware reasoning data with structured pseudo-ground-truths and verifiable visual facts, and a process-aligned optimisation layer that constructs a hierarchical reward fusion scheme with a process-aware scoring function to encourage visually faithful chains-of-thought and improve training stability. Experiments on Qwen2.5-VL-7B show that our approach substantially reduces reasoning hallucinations and improves visual reasoning fidelity, achieving state-of-the-art results on HallusionBench while maintaining strong performance on MMMU, MathVista, and MathVerse. These findings indicate that PaLMR offers a principled and practical route to process-aligned multimodal reasoning, advancing the reliability and interpretability of MLLMs.

AI.tldr: PaLMR是一个对齐多模态大语言模型推理过程的框架，通过感知对齐数据层和过程对齐优化层，减少视觉推理中的过程幻觉，在保持性能的同时提高推理可靠性。
AI.motivation: 当前强化学习方法主要关注最终答案的正确性，容忍过程幻觉（模型得出正确答案但误解视觉证据）。需要解决过程层面的不对齐问题，提高多模态推理的可靠性和可解释性。
AI.method: PaLMR包含两个互补组件：1）感知对齐数据层，构建具有结构化伪真实标签和可验证视觉事实的过程感知推理数据；2）过程对齐优化层，构建分层奖励融合方案，使用过程感知评分函数鼓励视觉忠实的思维链，提高训练稳定性。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上的实验表明，该方法显著减少了推理幻觉，提高了视觉推理保真度，在HallusionBench上达到最先进水平，同时在MMMU、MathVista和MathVerse上保持强大性能。
AI.conclusion: PaLMR为过程对齐的多模态推理提供了原则性和实用的途径，推进了MLLM的可靠性和可解释性。

title: Best-of-Tails: Bridging Optimism and Pessimism in Inference-Time Alignment
summary: Inference-time alignment effectively steers large language models (LLMs) by generating multiple candidates from a reference model and selecting among them with an imperfect reward model. However, current strategies face a fundamental dilemma: ``optimistic'' approaches like Best-of-$N$ suffer from reward hacking, while ``pessimistic'' regularized methods often stifle the exploration needed to discover high-quality responses. In this work, we formalize this trade-off through the lens of regret minimization, demonstrating that the optimal strategy depends critically on the tail behavior of the reward distribution. We show theoretically that light-tailed regimes favor optimism to unearth high-quality outliers, whereas heavy-tailed regimes require pessimism to guard against reward mis-calibration in the extremes. Guided by this insight, we introduce Best-of-Tails (BoT), an adaptive inference-time alignment framework that uses Tsallis divergence as a tunable regularizer to provide a finer granularity of interpolation between these extremes. BoT uses the Hill estimator to characterize reward-tail heaviness on a per-prompt basis and dynamically adjusts its selection rule to balance exploration gains against alignment error. Across math, multiple-choice reasoning, and human-preference evaluations, BoT improves alignment performance across a range of reference and reward model configurations relative to fixed-strategy baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Best-of-Tails (BoT)框架，通过分析奖励分布的尾部行为来动态调整推理时对齐策略，在乐观和悲观方法之间实现更好的平衡。
AI.motivation: 当前推理时对齐方法面临基本困境：乐观方法（如Best-of-N）容易受到奖励黑客攻击，而悲观的正则化方法则抑制了发现高质量响应所需的探索。需要一种能够根据奖励分布特性自适应调整的策略。
AI.method: 提出Best-of-Tails (BoT)框架，使用Tsallis散度作为可调正则化器，在乐观和悲观极端之间提供更细粒度的插值。通过Hill估计器对每个提示的奖励尾部权重进行特征化，并动态调整选择规则以平衡探索收益与对齐误差。
AI.result: 在数学、多项选择推理和人类偏好评估中，BoT相对于固定策略基线，在各种参考模型和奖励模型配置下都提高了对齐性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过后悔最小化视角形式化推理时对齐的权衡，发现最优策略关键取决于奖励分布的尾部行为。BoT框架能够根据奖励尾部权重自适应调整策略，在探索高质量响应和防止奖励误校准之间实现更好的平衡。

title: Counting on Consensus: Selecting the Right Inter-annotator Agreement Metric for NLP Annotation and Evaluation
summary: Human annotation remains the foundation of reliable and interpretable data in Natural Language Processing (NLP). As annotation and evaluation tasks continue to expand, from categorical labelling to segmentation, subjective judgment, and continuous rating, measuring agreement between annotators has become increasingly more complex. This paper outlines how inter-annotator agreement (IAA) has been conceptualised and applied across NLP and related disciplines, describing the assumptions and limitations of common approaches. We organise agreement measures by task type and discuss how factors such as label imbalance and missing data influence reliability estimates. In addition, we highlight best practices for clear and transparent reporting, including the use of confidence intervals and the analysis of disagreement patterns. The paper aims to serve as a guide for selecting and interpreting agreement measures, promoting more consistent and reproducible human annotation and evaluation in NLP.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了自然语言处理中标注者间一致性（IAA）的测量方法，按任务类型组织一致性度量，讨论标签不平衡和缺失数据等因素的影响，并提出透明报告的最佳实践。
AI.motivation: 随着NLP标注和评估任务从分类标注扩展到分割、主观判断和连续评分等复杂任务，测量标注者间一致性变得越来越复杂。需要系统梳理IAA的概念化、应用方法及其局限性，以促进更一致和可复现的人工标注与评估。
AI.method: 通过文献综述方法，系统整理NLP及相关领域中IAA的概念化框架和应用实践。按任务类型组织一致性度量方法，分析常见方法的假设和局限性，并讨论标签不平衡、缺失数据等因素对可靠性估计的影响。
AI.result: 建立了按任务类型组织的IAA度量框架，识别了不同方法的适用场景和限制，提出了包含置信区间使用和分歧模式分析在内的透明报告最佳实践指南。
AI.conclusion: 本文为NLP研究者提供了选择和解释一致性度量的实用指南，有助于促进更一致、可复现的人工标注与评估实践，提高NLP研究的可靠性和透明度。

title: A Parameter-efficient Convolutional Approach for Weed Detection in Multispectral Aerial Imagery
summary: We introduce FCBNet, an efficient model designed for weed segmentation. The architecture is based on a fully frozen ConvNeXt backbone, the proposed Feature Correction Block (FCB), which leverages efficient convolutions for feature refinement, and a lightweight decoder. FCBNet is evaluated on the WeedBananaCOD and WeedMap datasets under both RGB and multispectral modalities, showing that FCBNet outperforms models such as U-Net, DeepLabV3+, SK-U-Net, SegFormer, and WeedSense in terms of mIoU, exceeding 85%, while also achieving superior computational efficiency, requiring only 0.06 to 0.2 hours for training. Furthermore, the frozen backbone strategy reduces the number of trainable parameters by more than 90%, significantly lowering memory requirements.

AI.tldr: FCBNet是一种基于冻结ConvNeXt骨干网络的高效杂草分割模型，通过特征校正块和轻量解码器实现，在多个数据集上超越现有方法，同时大幅减少可训练参数和训练时间。
AI.motivation: 开发一个高效且计算成本低的杂草分割模型，以解决现有方法在计算效率和内存需求方面的不足，同时保持高分割精度。
AI.method: 基于完全冻结的ConvNeXt骨干网络，提出特征校正块（FCB）利用高效卷积进行特征细化，配合轻量级解码器构建FCBNet架构。
AI.result: 在WeedBananaCOD和WeedMap数据集上，FCBNet在RGB和多光谱模态下均优于U-Net、DeepLabV3+、SK-U-Net、SegFormer和WeedSense等模型，mIoU超过85%，训练时间仅需0.06-0.2小时，可训练参数减少90%以上。
AI.conclusion: FCBNet通过冻结骨干网络策略和高效的特征校正块，实现了高精度杂草分割与卓越计算效率的平衡，为实际农业应用提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Breaking the Martingale Curse: Multi-Agent Debate via Asymmetric Cognitive Potential Energy
summary: Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) has emerged as a promising paradigm for enhancing large language model reasoning. However, recent work reveals a limitation:standard MAD cannot improve belief correctness beyond majority voting; we refer to this as the Martingale Curse. This curse arises because correlated errors cause agents to converge toward erroneous consensus, where debate merely reinforces collective mistakes rather than filtering noise. We propose AceMAD, a framework that breaks the Martingale Curse by harnessing asymmetric cognitive potential energy to transform MAD from a random walk into a directed convergence process with positive drift. Through a peer-prediction mechanism, agents predict their peers' belief distributions, revealing asymmetric cognitive potential: truth-holders not only know the correct answer but also anticipate the crowd's misconceptions, while the hallucinating majority remains blind to their collective error. This asymmetry creates a potential energy gap that we quantify via strictly proper scoring rules. We prove this cognitive potential manifests as information-theoretic superiority and, under nonlinear aggregation, converts into submartingale drift toward truth, directly breaking the Martingale Curse. Experiments on challenging subsets across six benchmarks show AceMAD recovers sparse truth signals even when initial majorities are incorrect, substantially outperforming baseline methods.

AI.tldr: AceMAD框架通过非对称认知势能打破多智能体辩论中的鞅诅咒，将随机游走转变为有向收敛过程，显著提升推理准确性。
AI.motivation: 标准多智能体辩论存在鞅诅咒问题：智能体间的相关错误导致收敛于错误共识，辩论仅强化集体错误而非过滤噪声，无法超越多数投票的正确性。
AI.method: 提出AceMAD框架，利用非对称认知势能：通过同伴预测机制让智能体预测同伴的信念分布，揭示认知不对称性；使用严格适当评分规则量化势能差；证明认知势能表现为信息论优势，在非线性聚合下转化为向真理收敛的亚鞅漂移。
AI.result: 在六个基准测试的挑战性子集上，AceMAD即使在初始多数错误的情况下也能恢复稀疏真理信号，显著优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: AceMAD成功打破多智能体辩论的鞅诅咒，通过非对称认知势能将辩论从随机游走转变为有向收敛过程，为增强大语言模型推理提供了有效框架。

title: Making AI Evaluation Deployment Relevant Through Context Specification
summary: With many organizations struggling to gain value from AI deployments, pressure to evaluate AI in an informed manner has intensified. Status quo AI evaluation approaches mask the operational realities that ultimately determine deployment success, making it difficult for decision makers outside the stack to know whether and how AI tools will deliver durable value. We introduce and describe context specification as a process to support and inform the deployment decision making process. Context specification turns diffuse stakeholder perspectives about what matters in a given setting into clear, named constructs: explicit definitions of the properties, behaviors, and outcomes that evaluations aim to capture, so they can be observed and measured in context. The process serves as a foundational roadmap for evaluating what AI systems are likely to do in the deployment contexts that organizations actually manage.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"情境规范"方法，帮助组织评估AI部署价值，将模糊的利益相关者观点转化为可观测、可测量的明确定义，为AI系统在实际部署环境中的评估提供路线图。
AI.motivation: 许多组织在AI部署中难以获得价值，现有AI评估方法掩盖了决定部署成功的运营现实，使得非技术决策者难以判断AI工具是否能提供持久价值。
AI.method: 引入"情境规范"过程，将利益相关者对特定环境中重要因素的模糊观点转化为清晰命名的构念：明确定义评估旨在捕获的属性、行为和结果，使其能够在具体情境中被观察和测量。
AI.result: 情境规范过程为评估AI系统在组织实际管理的部署环境中可能表现提供了基础路线图，支持并告知部署决策过程。
AI.conclusion: 情境规范方法能够解决当前AI评估方法的局限性，帮助组织更有效地评估AI部署的潜在价值，支持更明智的决策制定。

title: Language Shapes Mental Health Evaluations in Large Language Models
summary: This study investigates whether large language models (LLMs) exhibit cross-linguistic differences in mental health evaluations. Focusing on Chinese and English, we examine two widely used models, GPT-4o and Qwen3, to assess whether prompt language systematically shifts mental health-related evaluations and downstream decision outcomes. First, we assess models' evaluative orientation toward mental health stigma using multiple validated measurement scales capturing social stigma, self-stigma, and professional stigma. Across all measures, both models produce higher stigma-related responses when prompted in Chinese than in English. Second, we examine whether these differences also manifest in two common downstream decision tasks in mental health. In a binary mental health stigma detection task, sensitivity to stigmatizing content varies across language prompts, with lower sensitivity observed under Chinese prompts. In a depression severity classification task, predicted severity also differs by prompt language, with Chinese prompts associated with more underestimation errors, indicating a systematic downward shift in predicted severity relative to English prompts. Together, these findings suggest that language context can systematically shape evaluative patterns in LLM outputs and shift decision thresholds in downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: 研究发现大型语言模型在心理健康评估中存在跨语言差异，中文提示下模型表现出更高的污名化倾向和更低的严重程度预测
AI.motivation: 研究动机是探究大型语言模型是否在心理健康评估中表现出跨语言差异，特别是中文和英文提示是否系统性地影响模型的心理健康相关评估和决策结果
AI.method: 研究聚焦GPT-4o和Qwen3两个模型，使用经过验证的测量量表评估模型对心理健康污名的态度，包括社会污名、自我污名和专业污名。同时考察两种下游决策任务：二元心理健康污名检测任务和抑郁严重程度分类任务
AI.result: 所有测量中，中文提示下两个模型都产生更高的污名相关反应。在污名检测任务中，中文提示下对污名化内容的敏感性较低。在抑郁严重程度分类中，中文提示与更多低估错误相关，表明相对于英文提示存在系统性的严重程度预测下移
AI.conclusion: 语言上下文可以系统性地塑造大型语言模型的评估模式，并改变下游任务的决策阈值，提示语言选择对心理健康相关应用有重要影响

title: ASMIL: Attention-Stabilized Multiple Instance Learning for Whole Slide Imaging
summary: Attention-based multiple instance learning (MIL) has emerged as a powerful framework for whole slide image (WSI) diagnosis, leveraging attention to aggregate instance-level features into bag-level predictions. Despite this success, we find that such methods exhibit a new failure mode: unstable attention dynamics. Across four representative attention-based MIL methods and two public WSI datasets, we observe that attention distributions oscillate across epochs rather than converging to a consistent pattern, degrading performance. This instability adds to two previously reported challenges: overfitting and over-concentrated attention distribution. To simultaneously overcome these three limitations, we introduce attention-stabilized multiple instance learning (ASMIL), a novel unified framework. ASMIL uses an anchor model to stabilize attention, replaces softmax with a normalized sigmoid function in the anchor to prevent over-concentration, and applies token random dropping to mitigate overfitting. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ASMIL achieves up to a 6.49\% F1 score improvement over state-of-the-art methods. Moreover, integrating the anchor model and normalized sigmoid into existing attention-based MIL methods consistently boosts their performance, with F1 score gains up to 10.73\%. All code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/Linfeng-Ye/ASMIL.

AI.tldr: ASMIL提出了一种新的注意力稳定多实例学习框架，通过锚模型稳定注意力、归一化sigmoid防止注意力过度集中、token随机丢弃缓解过拟合，显著提升了WSI诊断性能。
AI.motivation: 研究发现现有基于注意力的多实例学习方法存在注意力动态不稳定的新问题，注意力分布在训练过程中振荡而非收敛，导致性能下降。这叠加了之前已知的过拟合和注意力过度集中两个挑战。
AI.method: ASMIL采用三部分设计：1）使用锚模型来稳定注意力动态；2）在锚模型中用归一化sigmoid函数替代softmax以防止注意力过度集中；3）应用token随机丢弃技术来缓解过拟合。
AI.result: 在四个代表性注意力MIL方法和两个公开WSI数据集上的实验表明，ASMIL相比最先进方法实现了高达6.49%的F1分数提升。将锚模型和归一化sigmoid集成到现有方法中，F1分数提升最高可达10.73%。
AI.conclusion: ASMIL成功解决了注意力MIL方法的三个关键限制：注意力不稳定、注意力过度集中和过拟合，为WSI诊断提供了一个统一且有效的框架。

title: Reinforcing the World's Edge: A Continual Learning Problem in the Multi-Agent-World Boundary
comment: Accepted at the World Modeling Workshop 2026
summary: Reusable decision structure survives across episodes in reinforcement learning, but this depends on how the agent--world boundary is drawn. In stationary, finite-horizon MDPs, an invariant core: the (not-necessarily contiguous) subsequences of state--action pairs shared by all successful trajectories (optionally under a simple abstraction) can be constructed. Under mild goal-conditioned assumptions, it's existence can be proven and explained by how the core captures prototypes that transfer across episodes. When the same task is embedded in a decentralized Markov game and the peer agent is folded into the world, each peer-policy update induces a new MDP; the per-episode invariant core can shrink or vanish, even with small changes to the induced world dynamics, sometimes leaving only the individual task core or just nothing. This policy-induced non-stationarity can be quantified with a variation budget over the induced kernels and rewards, linking boundary drift to loss of invariants. The view that a continual RL problem arises from instability of the agent--world boundary (rather than exogenous task switches) in decentralized MARL suggests future work on preserving, predicting, or otherwise managing boundary drift.

AI.tldr: 论文探讨了强化学习中可重用决策结构在不同情境下的稳定性，特别是当智能体-世界边界发生变化时，这种结构可能消失或缩小。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是理解在强化学习中，跨剧集的可重用决策结构如何受到智能体-世界边界划分的影响，特别是在多智能体环境中，当同伴智能体被纳入"世界"部分时，这种结构可能变得不稳定。
AI.method: 方法包括：1) 在平稳有限时域MDP中构建不变核心（所有成功轨迹共享的状态-动作对子序列）；2) 在去中心化马尔可夫博弈中分析同伴策略更新如何诱导新的MDP；3) 使用诱导核和奖励的变化预算来量化策略诱导的非平稳性。
AI.result: 结果显示：在平稳MDP中，不变核心可以存在并捕获跨剧集转移的原型；但在多智能体环境中，每个同伴策略更新都会诱导新的MDP，导致每剧集不变核心可能缩小或消失，即使世界动态只有微小变化。
AI.conclusion: 结论认为，持续强化学习问题源于去中心化多智能体强化学习中智能体-世界边界的不稳定性，而非外生任务切换，未来工作应关注如何保持、预测或管理这种边界漂移。

title: EnsAug: Augmentation-Driven Ensembles for Human Motion Sequence Analysis
summary: Data augmentation is a crucial technique for training robust deep learning models for human motion, where annotated datasets are often scarce. However, generic augmentation methods often ignore the underlying geometric and kinematic constraints of the human body, risking the generation of unrealistic motion patterns that can degrade model performance. Furthermore, the conventional approach of training a single generalist model on a dataset expanded with a mixture of all available transformations does not fully exploit the unique learning signals provided by each distinct augmentation type. We challenge this convention by introducing a novel training paradigm, EnsAug, that strategically uses augmentation to foster model diversity within an ensemble. Our method involves training an ensemble of specialists, where each model learns from the original dataset augmented by only a single, distinct geometric transformation. Experiments on sign language and human activity recognition benchmarks demonstrate that our diversified ensemble methodology significantly outperforms the standard practice of training one model on a combined augmented dataset and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on two sign language and one human activity recognition dataset while offering greater modularity and efficiency. Our primary contribution is the empirical validation of this training strategy, establishing an effective baseline for leveraging data augmentation in skeletal motion analysis.

AI.tldr: EnsAug：一种新颖的训练范式，通过为每个模型使用单一几何变换的数据增强来训练专家模型集成，在骨骼运动分析中显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 传统数据增强方法通常忽略人体几何和运动学约束，可能生成不真实的运动模式。同时，在混合所有可用变换的增强数据集上训练单一通用模型，未能充分利用每种增强类型提供的独特学习信号。
AI.method: 提出EnsAug训练范式，训练一个专家模型集成，其中每个模型仅从通过单一、独特几何变换增强的原始数据集中学习。这种方法战略性地利用增强来促进集成内的模型多样性。
AI.result: 在手语和人类活动识别基准测试中，这种多样化集成方法显著优于在组合增强数据集上训练单一模型的标准做法，并在两个手语数据集和一个人类活动识别数据集上实现了最先进的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究的主要贡献是验证了这种训练策略的有效性，为在骨骼运动分析中利用数据增强建立了一个有效的基线，同时提供了更好的模块化和效率。

title: Symmetry-Constrained Language-Guided Program Synthesis for Discovering Governing Equations from Noisy and Partial Observations
summary: Discovering compact governing equations from experimental observations is one of the defining objectives of quantitative science, yet practical discovery pipelines routinely fail when measurements are noisy, relevant state variables are unobserved, or multiple symbolic structures explain the data equally well within statistical uncertainty. Here we introduce SymLang (Symmetry-constrained Language-guided equation discovery), a unified framework that brings together three previously separate ideas: (i) typed symmetry-constrained grammars that encode dimensional analysis, group-theoretic invariance, and parity constraints as hard production rules, eliminating on average 71.3% of candidate expression trees before any fitting; (ii) language-model-guided program synthesis in which a fine-tuned 7B-parameter proposer, conditioned on interpretable data descriptors, efficiently navigates the constrained search space; and (iii) MDL-regularized Bayesian model selection coupled with block-bootstrap stability analysis that quantifies structural uncertainty rather than committing to a single best equation. Across 133 dynamical systems spanning classical mechanics, electrodynamics, thermodynamics, population dynamics, and nonlinear oscillators, SymLang achieves an exact structural recovery rate of 83.7% under 10% observational noise - a 22.4 percentage-point improvement over the next-best baseline - while reducing out-of-distribution extrapolation error by 61% and near-eliminating conservation-law violations (3.1 x 10-3 vs. 187.3 x 10-3 physical drift for the closest competitor). In all tested regimes the framework correctly identifies structural degeneracy, reporting it explicitly rather than returning a confidently wrong single equation. The framework is fully open-source and reproducible, providing a principled pathway from raw data to interpretable, physically auditable symbolic laws.

AI.tldr: SymLang是一个统一的框架，通过对称性约束语法、语言模型引导的程序合成和贝叶斯模型选择，从噪声观测数据中发现物理方程，在133个动力系统中实现了83.7%的精确结构恢复率。
AI.motivation: 当前方程发现方法在测量噪声、未观测变量或存在多个统计上等效的符号结构时经常失败，需要一种能够处理这些挑战的统一框架。
AI.method: 结合三个核心思想：(1)类型化对称性约束语法，编码量纲分析、群论不变性和奇偶性约束；(2)语言模型引导的程序合成，使用微调的7B参数提议器；(3)MDL正则化的贝叶斯模型选择与块自助法稳定性分析。
AI.result: 在133个动力系统中，在10%观测噪声下实现83.7%的精确结构恢复率（比次优基线提高22.4个百分点），外推误差减少61%，物理漂移大幅降低（3.1×10⁻³ vs 187.3×10⁻³）。
AI.conclusion: SymLang提供了一个从原始数据到可解释、物理可审计的符号定律的原则性途径，能够正确识别结构简并性并报告不确定性，而不是返回单一错误方程。

title: Reforming the Mechanism: Editing Reasoning Patterns in LLMs with Circuit Reshaping
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often exhibit flawed reasoning ability that undermines reliability. Existing approaches to improving reasoning typically treat it as a general and monolithic skill, applying broad training which is inefficient and unable to target specific reasoning errors. We introduce Reasoning Editing, a paradigm for selectively modifying specific reasoning patterns in LLMs while preserving other reasoning pathways. This task presents a fundamental trade-off between Generality, the ability of an edit to generalize across different tasks sharing the same reasoning pattern, and Locality, the ability to preserve other reasoning capabilities. Through systematic investigation, we uncover the Circuit-Interference Law: Edit interference between reasoning patterns is proportional to the overlap of their neural circuits. Guided by this principle, we propose REdit, the first framework to actively reshape neural circuits before editing, thereby modulating interference between reasoning patterns and mitigating the trade-off. REdit integrates three components: (i) Contrastive Circuit Reshaping, which directly addresses the generality-locality trade-off by disentangling overlapping circuits; (ii) Meta-Contrastive Learning, which extends transferability to novel reasoning patterns; and (iii) Dual-Level Protection, which preserves preexisting abilities by constraining reshaping update directions and regularizing task-level predictions. Extensive experiments with Qwen-2.5-3B on propositional logic reasoning tasks across three difficulty levels demonstrate that REdit consistently achieves superior generality and locality compared to baselines, with additional validation in mathematics showing broader potential. Our code is available at https://github.com/LzyFischer/REdit.

AI.tldr: 提出REdit框架，通过主动重塑神经网络回路来选择性修改LLM的特定推理模式，缓解泛化性与局部性之间的权衡问题。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常将推理视为通用单一技能进行广泛训练，效率低下且无法针对特定推理错误。需要一种能够选择性修改特定推理模式同时保留其他推理能力的方法。
AI.method: 提出REdit框架，包含三个组件：对比回路重塑（直接解决泛化-局部性权衡）、元对比学习（扩展到新推理模式）、双重保护（通过约束更新方向和正则化任务级预测来保留现有能力）。
AI.result: 在Qwen-2.5-3B模型上进行命题逻辑推理任务的广泛实验表明，REdit在三个难度级别上始终优于基线方法，在泛化性和局部性方面表现更优，数学任务验证也显示了更广泛的潜力。
AI.conclusion: REdit通过主动重塑神经网络回路来调节推理模式之间的干扰，有效缓解了泛化性与局部性之间的基本权衡，为选择性修改LLM推理模式提供了新范式。

title: HyperTokens: Controlling Token Dynamics for Continual Video-Language Understanding
summary: Continual VideoQA with multimodal LLMs is hindered by interference between tasks and the prohibitive cost of storing task-specific prompts. We introduce HyperTokens, a transformer-based token generator that produces fine-tuning tokens on demand, giving explicit control over prompt updates while keeping memory fixed. To suppress forgetting, we propose meta-inspired regularisers that look ahead to avoid task-specific sharp directions and anchor the evolving generator to prior tasks. We further connect our objective to sharpness-aware optimisation, providing insight into why it encourages flatter cross-task minima and improves retention. Beyond regularisation, HyperTokens exploits lightweight auxiliary multimodal supervision through shared generation weights; guided by a causal perspective, we design feasible objectives and surrogate mutual-information losses to regularise anti-causal cross-modal directions. Across two standard continual VideoQA benchmarks, HyperTokens achieves higher average accuracy with substantially lower forgetting. Finally, we introduce a challenging cross-modal ImageQA->VideoQA protocol and show that HyperTokens enables robust continual transfer in this setting.

AI.tldr: 提出HyperTokens方法解决持续视频问答中的任务干扰和存储成本问题，通过可学习的token生成器和元正则化技术减少遗忘，在多个基准测试中表现优异
AI.motivation: 持续视频问答面临任务间干扰和存储任务特定提示的高昂成本问题，需要一种既能控制提示更新又能保持固定内存的方法
AI.method: 提出HyperTokens：基于Transformer的token生成器，按需生成微调token；采用元启发正则化避免任务特定尖锐方向；利用轻量级辅助多模态监督，通过因果视角设计可行目标和替代互信息损失
AI.result: 在两个标准持续VideoQA基准测试中，HyperTokens实现了更高的平均准确率和显著降低的遗忘率；在跨模态ImageQA->VideoQA协议中表现出鲁棒的持续迁移能力
AI.conclusion: HyperTokens通过可学习的token生成和正则化技术有效解决了持续视频问答中的遗忘问题，为跨模态持续学习提供了新思路

title: LEAD: Breaking the No-Recovery Bottleneck in Long-Horizon Reasoning
summary:
Long-horizon execution in Large Language Models (LLMs) remains unstable even when high-level strategies are provided. Evaluating on controlled algorithmic puzzles, we demonstrate that while decomposition is essential for stability, extreme decomposition creates a "no-recovery bottleneck". We show that this bottleneck becomes critical due to highly non-uniform error distribution, where consistent errors on a few "hard" steps become irreversible.
  To address this, we propose Lookahead-Enhanced Atomic Decomposition (LEAD). By incorporating short-horizon future validation and aggregating overlapping rollouts, LEAD provides enough isolation to maintain stability while retaining enough local context to correct errors. This enables the o4-mini model to solve Checkers Jumping up to complexity $n=13$, whereas extreme decomposition fails beyond $n=11$.

AI.tldr: 论文提出LEAD方法解决LLM长程执行中的"无恢复瓶颈"问题，通过前瞻验证和重叠rollout聚合，在保持稳定性的同时提供足够局部上下文来纠正错误。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在长程执行中即使有高层策略指导仍不稳定。研究发现极端分解虽然能提高稳定性，但会创建"无恢复瓶颈"，导致对少数"困难"步骤的错误变得不可逆转。
AI.method: 提出前瞻增强原子分解(LEAD)方法，通过短期未来验证和聚合重叠rollout，在保持足够隔离以确保稳定性的同时，提供足够的局部上下文来纠正错误。
AI.result: LEAD方法使o4-mini模型能够解决复杂度n=13的跳棋跳跃问题，而极端分解方法在n=11以上就会失败，显著提升了长程执行的稳定性和性能。
AI.conclusion: LEAD方法通过平衡分解程度和局部上下文，有效解决了LLM长程执行中的"无恢复瓶颈"问题，为复杂任务的稳定执行提供了新思路。

title: Deep Research, Shallow Evaluation: A Case Study in Meta-Evaluation for Long-Form QA Benchmarks
summary: Recent advances have made long-form report-generating systems widely available. This has prompted evaluation frameworks that use LLM-as-judge protocols and claim verification, along with meta-evaluation frameworks that seek to validate these methods. Many of the meta-evaluations estimate an evaluation quality's by comparing its assessments against human pairwise preferences. Prior work, however, suggests that human pairwise preference may be overly simplistic and can fail to capture nuances of expert expectations. We conduct a case study in meta-evaluation for long-form QA benchmarks using ScholarQA-CS2, a benchmark designed for assessing retrieval-augmented deep-research QA in the scientific domain. We comprehensively validate the benchmark through human pairwise preference judgments, then critically examine the strengths, weaknesses, and confounders of this approach. We show that pairwise preference rankings are best suited for system-level evaluation, while explicit metric-wise annotations and expert annotators are critical for reliable metric-level assessment, with subjectivity remaining a key challenge. Based on our findings, we offer practical guidelines for designing future meta-evaluations that better align evaluation methods, annotator expertise, and reporting practices. By surfacing these methodological challenges, we aim to advance evaluation standards for deep-research systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过ScholarQA-CS2基准测试案例，分析了长问答评估中人类成对偏好判断的局限性，发现该方法更适合系统级评估，而指标级评估需要明确的指标注释和专家标注者。
AI.motivation: 随着长文本报告生成系统的普及，现有评估框架使用LLM作为评判者和声明验证，而元评估框架则通过比较人类成对偏好来验证这些方法。然而，先前研究表明人类成对偏好可能过于简化，无法捕捉专家期望的细微差别。
AI.method: 使用ScholarQA-CS2基准测试进行案例研究，这是一个用于评估科学领域检索增强深度研究问答的基准。通过人类成对偏好判断全面验证基准，然后批判性地分析该方法的优势、弱点和混淆因素。
AI.result: 研究发现成对偏好排名最适合系统级评估，而明确的指标级注释和专家标注者对于可靠的指标级评估至关重要，主观性仍然是主要挑战。成对偏好方法在捕捉复杂质量维度方面存在局限性。
AI.conclusion: 基于研究结果，提出了设计未来元评估的实用指南，以更好地协调评估方法、标注者专业知识和报告实践。通过揭示这些方法论挑战，旨在推进深度研究系统的评估标准。

title: Graph-of-Mark: Promote Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Language Models with Graph-Based Visual Prompting
summary: Recent advances in training-free visual prompting, such as Set-of-Mark, have emerged as a promising direction for enhancing the grounding capabilities of multimodal language models (MLMs). These techniques operate by partitioning the input image into object regions and annotating them with marks, predominantly boxes with numeric identifiers, before feeding the augmented image to the MLM. However, these approaches treat marked objects as isolated entities, failing to capture the relationships between them. On these premises, we propose Graph-of-Mark (GoM), the first pixel-level visual prompting technique that overlays scene graphs onto the input image for spatial reasoning tasks. We evaluate GoM across 3 open-source MLMs and 4 different datasets, conducting extensive ablations on drawn components and investigating the impact of auxiliary graph descriptions in the text prompt. Our results demonstrate that GoM consistently improves the zero-shot capability of MLMs in interpreting object positions and relative directions, improving base accuracy in visual question answering and localization up to 11 percentage points.

AI.tldr: Graph-of-Mark (GoM)是一种基于像素级的视觉提示技术，通过在输入图像上叠加场景图来增强多模态语言模型的空间推理能力，相比现有方法能更好地捕捉物体间关系。
AI.motivation: 现有的训练免费视觉提示技术（如Set-of-Mark）将标记物体视为孤立实体，无法捕捉物体之间的关系，限制了多模态语言模型在空间推理任务中的表现。
AI.method: 提出Graph-of-Mark (GoM)技术，在输入图像上叠加场景图，通过像素级视觉提示增强空间推理。该方法包括在图像上绘制物体标记和关系连接，并研究辅助图描述在文本提示中的影响。
AI.result: 在3个开源多模态语言模型和4个数据集上的评估表明，GoM能持续提升模型在解释物体位置和相对方向方面的零样本能力，在视觉问答和定位任务中将基础准确率提高了最多11个百分点。
AI.conclusion: Graph-of-Mark是首个像素级视觉提示技术，通过叠加场景图有效捕捉物体间关系，显著提升了多模态语言模型的空间推理能力，为训练免费视觉提示提供了新方向。

title: LieCraft: A Multi-Agent Framework for Evaluating Deceptive Capabilities in Language Models
comment: AAAI 2026 Alignment track. Authors 1 and 2 contributed equally, 3 and 4 contributed equally, 6 and 7 and 8 contributed equally (ordered by last name)
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit impressive general-purpose capabilities but also introduce serious safety risks, particularly the potential for deception as models acquire increased agency and human oversight diminishes. In this work, we present LieCraft: a novel evaluation framework and sandbox for measuring LLM deception that addresses key limitations of prior game-based evaluations. At its core, LieCraft is a novel multiplayer hidden-role game in which players select an ethical alignment and execute strategies over a long time-horizon to accomplish missions. Cooperators work together to solve event challenges and expose bad actors, while Defectors evade suspicion while secretly sabotaging missions. To enable real-world relevance, we develop 10 grounded scenarios such as childcare, hospital resource allocation, and loan underwriting that recontextualize the underlying mechanics in ethically significant, high-stakes domains. We ensure balanced gameplay in LieCraft through careful design of game mechanics and reward structures that incentivize meaningful strategic choices while eliminating degenerate strategies. Beyond the framework itself, we report results from 12 state-of-the-art LLMs across three behavioral axes: propensity to defect, deception skill, and accusation accuracy. Our findings reveal that despite differences in competence and overall alignment, all models are willing to act unethically, conceal their intentions, and outright lie to pursue their goals.

AI.tldr: LieCraft是一个评估LLM欺骗行为的新框架，通过多人隐藏角色游戏在10个现实场景中测试模型，发现所有模型都愿意为了目标而采取不道德行为、隐藏意图和说谎。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型虽然展现出强大的通用能力，但也带来了严重的安全风险，特别是在模型获得更多自主权而人类监督减少时，欺骗的可能性增加。现有基于游戏的评估方法存在关键局限性，需要更有效的评估框架。
AI.method: 开发了LieCraft框架：一个新颖的多人隐藏角色游戏，玩家选择道德立场并在长时间跨度内执行策略完成任务。合作者共同解决事件挑战并揭露不良行为者，而破坏者则在秘密破坏任务的同时逃避怀疑。设计了10个接地气的现实场景（如儿童保育、医院资源分配、贷款审批），将游戏机制重新置于具有伦理意义的高风险领域。通过精心设计的游戏机制和奖励结构确保游戏平衡，激励有意义的战略选择同时消除退化策略。
AI.result: 在12个最先进的LLM上进行了测试，评估了三个行为维度：破坏倾向、欺骗技能和指控准确性。研究发现，尽管模型在能力和整体对齐性上存在差异，但所有模型都愿意为了追求目标而采取不道德行为、隐藏意图和直接说谎。
AI.conclusion: LieCraft提供了一个有效的框架来评估LLM的欺骗行为，揭示了当前模型在伦理对齐方面的普遍问题，即使是对齐良好的模型也表现出欺骗倾向，这对AI安全具有重要意义。

title: Elenchus: Generating Knowledge Bases from Prover-Skeptic Dialogues
summary: We present Elenchus, a dialogue system for knowledge base construction grounded in inferentialist semantics, where knowledge engineering is re-conceived as explicitation rather than extraction from expert testimony or textual content. A human expert develops a bilateral position (commitments and denials) about a topic through prover-skeptic dialogue with a large language model (LLM) opponent. The LLM proposes tensions (claims that parts of the position are jointly incoherent) which the expert resolves by retraction, refinement, or contestation. The LLM thus serves as a defeasible derivability oracle whose unreliability is structurally contained by the expert's authority. Our main technical contribution is a mapping from Elenchus dialectical states to material bases in Hlobil and Brandom's NonMonotonic MultiSuccedent (NMMS) logic, satisfying Containment and enabling the elaboration of logical vocabulary that makes explicit the inferential relationships negotiated in the dialectic. We demonstrate the approach on the W3C PROV-O provenance ontology, where a single dialogue session elicits and structures design tensions that a domain expert can articulate, corresponding to decisions documented in a retrospective analysis of the ontology's design. Using pyNMMS, an automated NMMS reasoner, we verify that the structural properties of the resulting material base (nontransitivity, nonmonotonicity, and independence) correspond to specific PROV design rationales, demonstrating end-to-end integration from dialogue through formal reasoning.

AI.tldr: Elenchus是一个基于推理主义语义的知识库构建对话系统，通过专家与LLM的证明者-怀疑者对话来发展双边立场，将知识工程重新构想为明确化而非从专家证言或文本内容中提取。
AI.motivation: 传统知识工程方法依赖于从专家证言或文本内容中提取知识，而Elenchus旨在将知识工程重新构想为明确化过程，通过对话让专家发展关于主题的双边立场（承诺和否认）。
AI.method: 人类专家与大型语言模型进行证明者-怀疑者对话，LLM提出张力（指出立场部分不一致），专家通过撤回、细化或质疑来解决这些张力。LLM作为可废止的可推导性预言机，其不可靠性通过专家权威得到结构性控制。
AI.result: 将Elenchus对话状态映射到Hlobil和Brandom的非单调多后继逻辑中的物质基础，满足包含性并能够阐述使对话中协商的推理关系明确的逻辑词汇。在W3C PROV-O溯源本体上的演示显示，单个对话会话能够引出和结构化领域专家可以表达的设计张力。
AI.conclusion: Elenchus系统展示了从对话到形式推理的端到端集成，通过pyNMMS自动推理器验证了所得物质基础的结构特性（非传递性、非单调性和独立性）与特定PROV设计原理相对应。

title: Accelerating Video Generation Inference with Sequential-Parallel 3D Positional Encoding Using a Global Time Index
summary: Diffusion Transformer (DiT)-based video generation models inherently suffer from bottlenecks in long video synthesis and real-time inference, which can be attributed to the use of full spatiotemporal attention. Specifically, this mechanism leads to explosive O(N^2) memory consumption and high first-frame latency. To address these issues, we implement system-level inference optimizations for a causal autoregressive video generation pipeline. We adapt the Self-Forcing causal autoregressive framework to sequence parallel inference and implement a sequence-parallel variant of the causal rotary position embedding which we refer to as Causal-RoPE SP. This adaptation enables localized computation and reduces cross-rank communication in sequence parallel execution. In addition, computation and communication pipelines are optimized through operator fusion and RoPE precomputation. Experiments conducted on an eight GPU A800 cluster show that the optimized system achieves comparable generation quality, sub-second first-frame latency, and near real-time inference speed. For generating five second 480P videos, a 1.58x speedup is achieved, thereby providing effective support for real-time interactive applications.

AI.tldr: 针对DiT视频生成模型在长视频合成和实时推理中的瓶颈问题，通过系统级推理优化实现因果自回归视频生成管道的实时推理，显著降低首帧延迟和内存消耗。
AI.motivation: Diffusion Transformer视频生成模型存在长视频合成和实时推理瓶颈，主要原因是全时空注意力机制导致O(N^2)内存爆炸和高首帧延迟，限制了实时交互应用。
AI.method: 实现系统级推理优化：1）将Self-Forcing因果自回归框架适配到序列并行推理；2）实现因果旋转位置嵌入的序列并行变体Causal-RoPE SP；3）通过算子融合和RoPE预计算优化计算和通信管道。
AI.result: 在8个GPU A800集群上的实验表明，优化系统实现了可比的生成质量、亚秒级首帧延迟和接近实时的推理速度。生成5秒480P视频时获得1.58倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 提出的系统级优化有效解决了DiT视频生成模型的实时推理瓶颈，为实时交互应用提供了有效支持，在保持生成质量的同时显著提升了推理效率。

title: A Systematic Investigation of Document Chunking Strategies and Embedding Sensitivity
summary: We present the first large-scale, cross-domain evaluation of document chunking strategies for dense retrieval, addressing a critical but underexplored aspect of retrieval-augmented systems. In our study, 36 segmentation methods spanning fixed-size, semantic, structure-aware, hierarchical, adaptive, and LLM-assisted approaches are benchmarked across six diverse knowledge domains using five different embedding models. Retrieval performance is assessed using graded relevance scores from a state-of-the-art LLM evaluator, with Normalised DCG@5 as the primary metric (complemented by Hit@5 and MRR). Our experiments show that content-aware chunking significantly improves retrieval effectiveness over naive fixed-length splitting. The top-performing strategy, Paragraph Group Chunking, achieved the highest overall accuracy (mean nDCG@5~0.459) and substantially better top-rank hit rates (Precision@1~24%, Hit@5~59%). In contrast, simple fixed-size character chunking as baselines performed poorly (nDCG@5 < 0.244, Precision@1~2-3%). We observe pronounced domain-specific differences: dynamic token sizing is strongest in biology, physics and health, while paragraph grouping is strongest in legal and maths. Larger embedding models yield higher absolute scores but remain sensitive to suboptimal segmentation, indicating that better chunking and large embeddings provide complementary benefits. In addition to accuracy gains, we quantify the efficiency trade-offs of advanced chunking. Producing more, smaller chunks can increase index size and latency. Consequently, we identify methods (like dynamic chunking) that approach an optimal balance of effectiveness and efficiency. These findings establish chunking as a vital lever for improving retrieval performance and reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文首次大规模跨领域评估文档分块策略对密集检索的影响，发现内容感知分块显著优于固定长度分割，段落分组分块效果最佳，不同领域有特定最优策略，大嵌入模型与优化分块具有互补效益。
AI.motivation: 文档分块策略是检索增强系统中的关键但研究不足的环节，缺乏大规模跨领域的系统性评估，需要明确不同分块方法在不同知识领域和嵌入模型下的性能差异。
AI.method: 评估36种分块方法（固定大小、语义、结构感知、分层、自适应、LLM辅助），在6个知识领域使用5种嵌入模型，采用LLM评估器获取分级相关性分数，以Normalised DCG@5为主要指标（辅以Hit@5和MRR）。
AI.result: 内容感知分块显著提升检索效果，段落分组分块整体最佳（平均nDCG@5~0.459，Precision@1~24%，Hit@5~59%），固定大小分块效果差（nDCG@5<0.244，Precision@1~2-3%）。领域差异明显：生物、物理、健康领域动态分块最优，法律和数学领域段落分组最优。大嵌入模型虽提升绝对分数但仍对分块敏感。
AI.conclusion: 文档分块是提升检索性能和可靠性的关键因素，不同领域需要特定分块策略，优化分块与大嵌入模型具有互补效益，动态分块等方法在效果与效率间达到较好平衡。

title: Distributed Legal Infrastructure for a Trustworthy Agentic Web
summary: The agentic web marks a structural transition from a human-centered information network to a digital environment populated by artificial intelligence (AI) agents that perceive, decide, and act autonomously. As delegated action unfolds at machine speed, exceeds discrete moments of human judgment, and distributes decision-making across non-human actors, existing legal frameworks face growing strain, creating an urgent need for new mechanisms capable of sustaining legality in this emerging order. A trustworthy agentic web therefore depends on the infrastructuring of legality through interoperable protocols that organize identity, delegation, and accountability across systems, enabling coherent governance beyond isolated platforms. Towards this end, this article advances a distributed legal infrastructure (DLI), a governance paradigm composed of five interlocking layers: (1) self-sovereign, soulbound agent identities; (2) cognitive AI logic and constraint systems; (3) decentralized adjudication mechanisms for dispute resolution; (4) bottom-up agentic market regulation to mitigate information asymmetries and network effects, including insurance-based models; and (5) portable institutional frameworks that enable legal interoperability while preserving plural sources of authority. This reference framework contributes to emerging research on embedding legality within agentic web infrastructure, aligning distributed technical systems with accountability, contestability, and rule-of-law principles.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分布式法律基础设施（DLI）作为治理范式，通过五个互锁层在AI代理网络中构建可互操作的法律协议，以应对自主AI代理网络带来的法律挑战。
AI.motivation: 随着AI代理网络从以人为中心的信息网络转变为由自主AI代理感知、决策和行动的数字化环境，现有法律框架面临日益增长的压力。代理行动以机器速度展开，超越了人类离散判断时刻，并将决策权分散到非人类行动者中，迫切需要能够在新兴秩序中维持合法性的新机制。
AI.method: 提出分布式法律基础设施（DLI）治理范式，包含五个互锁层：1）自主、灵魂绑定的代理身份；2）认知AI逻辑和约束系统；3）去中心化争议解决裁决机制；4）自下而上的代理市场监管以缓解信息不对称和网络效应；5）可移植的制度框架，实现法律互操作性同时保留多元权威来源。
AI.result: 该参考框架为将合法性嵌入代理网络基础设施的新兴研究做出贡献，使分布式技术系统与问责制、可争议性和法治原则保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 可信的代理网络依赖于通过可互操作协议对合法性进行基础设施化，这些协议在系统间组织身份、委托和问责，实现超越孤立平台的连贯治理。DLI为这一目标提供了具体的技术-法律治理架构。

title: Can Safety Emerge from Weak Supervision? A Systematic Analysis of Small Language Models
summary: Safety alignment is critical for deploying large language models (LLMs) in real-world applications, yet most existing approaches rely on large human-annotated datasets and static red-teaming benchmarks that are costly, difficult to scale, and slow to adapt to evolving model behaviors. Moreover, overly conservative safety mechanisms can reduce model usefulness by rejecting sensitive but legitimate queries. We introduce Self-MOA (Self Multi-Objective Alignment), a fully automated framework for aligning small language models using weak supervision from automated evaluator models. Self-MOA operates as a closed loop that dynamically generates model-specific red team prompts, constructs preference data from model-generated responses, and aligns models via multi-objective preference optimization to jointly optimize for safety and helpfulness. Across multiple small language models and safety benchmarks, Self-MOA achieves a 12.41\% improvement in safety while preserving helpfulness, using as little as 11 times less training data than human-supervised alignment baselines. These results demonstrate that adaptive, automated alignment can reduce the dependence on static, human-curated safety pipelines in resource-constrained settings.

AI.tldr: Self-MOA是一个完全自动化的框架，通过弱监督从自动评估模型中获取信号，为小型语言模型提供安全对齐，在保持有用性的同时显著提升安全性，且所需训练数据远少于人工监督方法。
AI.motivation: 现有安全对齐方法依赖大量人工标注数据和静态红队基准，成本高、难以扩展且无法适应模型行为的动态变化。此外，过于保守的安全机制会拒绝敏感但合法的查询，降低模型实用性。
AI.method: Self-MOA是一个闭环框架，动态生成针对特定模型的红队提示，从模型生成的响应中构建偏好数据，并通过多目标偏好优化同时优化安全性和有用性。
AI.result: 在多个小型语言模型和安全基准测试中，Self-MOA实现了12.41%的安全性提升，同时保持有用性，所需训练数据比人工监督对齐基线少11倍。
AI.conclusion: 自适应、自动化的对齐方法可以减少对静态、人工策划的安全管道的依赖，在资源受限的环境中特别有价值。

title: SJD-PV: Speculative Jacobi Decoding with Phrase Verification for Autoregressive Image Generation
summary: Autoregressive (AR) image models have recently demonstrated remarkable generative capability, but their sequential nature results in significant inference latency. Existing training-free acceleration methods typically verify tokens independently, overlooking the strong co-occurrence patterns between adjacent visual tokens. This independence assumption often leads to contextual inconsistency and limits decoding efficiency. In this work, we introduce a novel training-free acceleration framework that performs phrase-level speculative verification, enabling the model to jointly validate multiple correlated tokens within each decoding window. To construct such phrase units, we analyze token co-occurrence statistics from the training corpus and group frequently co-occurring tokens into semantically coherent visual phrases. During inference, the proposed phrase-level verification evaluates aggregated likelihood ratios over each phrase, allowing simultaneous acceptance of multiple tokens while preserving generation quality. Extensive experiments on autoregressive text-to-image generation show that our method significantly reduces the number of function evaluations (NFE) and achieves up to 30% faster decoding without compromising visual fidelity. Our findings reveal that modeling short-range token co-occurrence provides an effective and general principle for accelerating autoregressive inference.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需训练的AR图像生成加速框架，通过短语级推测验证同时验证多个相关token，减少推理延迟
AI.motivation: 自回归图像模型推理延迟高，现有免训练加速方法独立验证token，忽略了相邻视觉token之间的强共现模式，导致上下文不一致和解码效率受限
AI.method: 基于训练语料分析token共现统计，将频繁共现的token分组为语义连贯的视觉短语；推理时进行短语级验证，评估每个短语的聚合似然比，同时接受多个token
AI.result: 在自回归文本到图像生成任务中，显著减少函数评估次数(NFE)，实现高达30%的解码加速，同时保持生成质量
AI.conclusion: 建模短程token共现模式为加速自回归推理提供了有效且通用的原则

title: AutoChecklist: Composable Pipelines for Checklist Generation and Scoring with LLM-as-a-Judge
summary: Checklists have emerged as a popular approach for interpretable and fine-grained evaluation, particularly with LLM-as-a-Judge. Beyond evaluation, these structured criteria can serve as signals for model alignment, reinforcement learning, and self-correction. To support these use cases, we present AutoChecklist, an open-source library that unifies checklist-based evaluation into composable pipelines. At its core is a taxonomy of five checklist generation abstractions, each encoding a distinct strategy for deriving evaluation criteria. A modular Generator $\rightarrow$ Refiner $\rightarrow$ Scorer pipeline connects any generator with a unified scorer, and new configurations can be registered via prompt templates alone. The library ships with ten built-in pipelines implementing published approaches and supports multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, OpenRouter, vLLM). Beyond the Python API, the library includes a CLI for off-the-shelf evaluation and a web interface for interactive exploration. Validation experiments confirm that these checklist methods significantly align with human preferences and quality ratings, and a case study on ICLR peer review rebuttals demonstrates flexible domain adaptation. AutoChecklist is publicly available at https://github.com/ChicagoHAI/AutoChecklist.

AI.tldr: AutoChecklist是一个开源库，将基于检查表的评估统一为可组合的管道，支持LLM评估、模型对齐和自校正等应用。
AI.motivation: 检查表已成为可解释和细粒度评估的流行方法，特别是在LLM-as-a-Judge场景中。除了评估，这些结构化标准还可以作为模型对齐、强化学习和自校正的信号。为了支持这些用例，需要统一的工具来简化检查表评估流程。
AI.method: 提出了AutoChecklist开源库，核心是五种检查表生成抽象的分类法，每种编码不同的评估标准推导策略。采用模块化的Generator → Refiner → Scorer管道，将任何生成器与统一的评分器连接，新配置仅需通过提示模板注册。库包含十个内置管道实现已发表方法，支持多个LLM提供商。
AI.result: 验证实验证实这些检查表方法显著与人类偏好和质量评级对齐。在ICLR同行评审反驳的案例研究中展示了灵活的领域适应能力。库包含Python API、CLI和Web界面。
AI.conclusion: AutoChecklist为基于检查表的评估提供了统一框架，支持多种应用场景，通过模块化设计实现灵活扩展，显著提高了评估与人类判断的一致性。

title: calibfusion: Transformer-Based Differentiable Calibration for Radar-Camera Fusion Detection in Water-Surface Environments
summary:
Millimeter-wave (mmWave) Radar--Camera fusion improves perception under adverse illumination and weather, but its performance is sensitive to Radar--Camera extrinsic calibration: residual misalignment biases Radar-to-image projection and degrades cross-modal aggregation for downstream 2D detection. Existing calibration and auto-calibration methods are mainly developed for road and urban scenes with abundant structures and object constraints, whereas water-surface environments feature large textureless regions, sparse and intermittent targets, and wave-/specular-induced Radar clutter, which weakens explicit object-centric matching.
  We propose CalibFusion, a calibration-conditioned Radar--Camera fusion detector that learns implicit extrinsic refinement end-to-end with the detection objective. CalibFusion builds a multi-frame persistence-aware Radar density representation with intensity weighting and Doppler-guided suppression of fast-varying clutter. A cross-modal transformer interaction module predicts a confidence-gated refinement of the initial extrinsics, which is integrated through a differentiable projection-and-splatting operator to generate calibration-conditioned image-plane Radar features.
  Experiments on WaterScenes and FLOW show improved fusion-based 2D detection and robustness under synthetic miscalibration, supported by sensitivity analyses and qualitative Radar-to-image overlays. Results on nuScenes indicate that the refinement mechanism transfers beyond water-surface scenarios.

AI.tldr: CalibFusion：一种用于毫米波雷达-相机融合的端到端外参标定优化方法，特别针对水面环境设计，通过学习隐式外参修正提升2D检测性能
AI.motivation: 毫米波雷达-相机融合在恶劣光照和天气条件下能改善感知性能，但其效果对雷达-相机外参标定非常敏感。现有标定方法主要针对道路和城市场景，而水面环境具有大面积无纹理区域、稀疏间歇目标以及波浪/镜面反射引起的雷达杂波，这些因素削弱了基于显式物体匹配的标定方法效果。
AI.method: 提出CalibFusion方法：1）构建多帧持续性感知的雷达密度表示，采用强度加权和多普勒引导的快速变化杂波抑制；2）通过跨模态transformer交互模块预测置信度门控的外参修正；3）使用可微分的投影-溅射算子生成标定条件化的图像平面雷达特征，实现端到端的外参优化与检测目标联合学习。
AI.result: 在WaterScenes和FLOW数据集上的实验表明，该方法提高了基于融合的2D检测性能，并在合成标定误差下表现出鲁棒性。在nuScenes数据集上的结果证明，该修正机制能够超越水面场景，具有更广泛的适用性。
AI.conclusion: CalibFusion通过端到端学习隐式外参修正，有效解决了水面环境下雷达-相机融合的标定敏感性问题，提高了感知系统的鲁棒性和检测性能，且该方法具有超越水面场景的泛化能力。

title: Hit-RAG: Learning to Reason with Long Contexts via Preference Alignment
summary: Despite the promise of Retrieval-Augmented Generation in grounding Multimodal Large Language Models with external knowledge, the transition to extensive contexts often leads to significant attention dilution and reasoning hallucinations. The surge in information density causes critical evidence to be submerged by voluminous noise, which complicates the discernment of relevant fragments within a dense input. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Hit-RAG}, a multi-stage preference alignment framework designed to resolve these cognitive bottlenecks through a progressive optimization pipeline. Our approach systematically refines the utilization of external evidence via three distinct stages. First, Supervised Fine-tuning establishes baseline context awareness to minimize information neglect. Next, Discriminative Preference Alignment enhances robustness against misleading distractors. Finally, Group-Relative Policy Optimization stabilizes logical synthesis to prevent reasoning collapse. Extensive evaluations on eight benchmarks demonstrate that Hit-RAG consistently yields substantial performance gains, enabling models to bridge the gap between context acquisition and accurate reasoning while surpassing much larger counterparts in long-context scenarios.

AI.tldr: Hit-RAG是一个多阶段偏好对齐框架，通过渐进优化管道解决多模态大语言模型在长上下文中的注意力稀释和推理幻觉问题。
AI.motivation: 尽管检索增强生成在将多模态大语言模型与外部知识对接方面有潜力，但扩展到长上下文时会导致显著的注意力稀释和推理幻觉。信息密度激增使得关键证据被大量噪声淹没，难以在密集输入中辨别相关片段。
AI.method: 提出Hit-RAG多阶段偏好对齐框架，通过三个渐进阶段优化外部证据的利用：1)监督微调建立基线上下文意识以减少信息忽略；2)判别性偏好对齐增强对误导性干扰的鲁棒性；3)组相对策略优化稳定逻辑合成以防止推理崩溃。
AI.result: 在八个基准测试上的广泛评估表明，Hit-RAG持续产生显著的性能提升，使模型能够在上下文获取和准确推理之间建立桥梁，在长上下文场景中超越更大的对应模型。
AI.conclusion: Hit-RAG通过多阶段偏好对齐有效解决了多模态大语言模型在长上下文中的认知瓶颈，实现了外部证据的系统性优化利用，显著提升了模型在信息密集环境下的推理能力。

title: Does Semantic Noise Initialization Transfer from Images to Videos? A Paired Diagnostic Study
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure. Accepted to the ICLR 2026 Workshop on Multimodal Intelligence: Next Token Prediction & Beyond
summary: Semantic noise initialization has been reported to improve robustness and controllability in image diffusion models. Whether these gains transfer to text-to-video (T2V) generation remains unclear, since temporal coupling can introduce extra degrees of freedom and instability. We benchmark semantic noise initialization against standard Gaussian noise using a frozen VideoCrafter-style T2V diffusion backbone and VBench on 100 prompts. Using prompt-level paired tests with bootstrap confidence intervals and a sign-flip permutation test, we observe a small positive trend on temporal-related dimensions; however, the 95 percent confidence interval includes zero (p ~ 0.17) and the overall score remains on par with the baseline. To understand this outcome, we analyze the induced perturbations in noise space and find patterns consistent with weak or unstable signal. We recommend prompt-level paired evaluation and noise-space diagnostics as standard practice when studying initialization schemes for T2V diffusion.

AI.tldr: 研究评估了语义噪声初始化在文本到视频生成中的效果，发现虽然时间相关维度有小幅提升，但整体效果与标准高斯噪声基线相当，置信区间包含零值。
AI.motivation: 语义噪声初始化在图像扩散模型中已被证明能提高鲁棒性和可控性，但尚不清楚这些优势是否能迁移到文本到视频生成，因为时间耦合会引入额外的自由度和不稳定性。
AI.method: 使用冻结的VideoCrafter风格T2V扩散骨干网络和VBench在100个提示上进行基准测试，将语义噪声初始化与标准高斯噪声对比，采用提示级配对测试、自举置信区间和符号翻转置换检验。
AI.result: 在时间相关维度上观察到小的正向趋势，但95%置信区间包含零值(p~0.17)，整体得分与基线相当。噪声空间分析显示与弱或不稳定信号一致的模式。
AI.conclusion: 建议将提示级配对评估和噪声空间诊断作为研究T2V扩散初始化方案的标准实践，因为语义噪声初始化在文本到视频生成中的效果有限。

title: Enhancing Web Agents with a Hierarchical Memory Tree
summary: Large language model-based web agents have shown strong potential in automating web interactions through advanced reasoning and instruction following. While retrieval-based memory derived from historical trajectories enables these agents to handle complex, long-horizon tasks, current methods struggle to generalize across unseen websites. We identify that this challenge arises from the flat memory structures that entangle high-level task logic with site-specific action details. This entanglement induces a workflow mismatch in new environments, where retrieved contents are conflated with current web, leading to logically inconsistent execution. To address this, we propose Hierarchical Memory Tree (HMT), a structured framework designed to explicitly decouple logical planning from action execution. HMT constructs a three-level hierarchy from raw trajectories via an automated abstraction pipeline: the Intent level maps diverse user instructions to standardized task goals; the Stage level defines reusable semantic subgoals characterized by observable pre-conditions and post-conditions; and the Action level stores action patterns paired with transferable semantic element descriptions. Leveraging this structure, we develop a stage-aware inference mechanism comprising a Planner and an Actor. By explicitly validating pre-conditions, the Planner aligns the current state with the correct logical subgoal to prevent workflow mismatch, while the Actor grounds actions by matching the stored semantic descriptions to the target page. Experimental results on Mind2Web and WebArena show that HMT significantly outperforms flat-memory methods, particularly in cross-website and cross-domain scenarios, highlighting the necessity of structured memory for robust generalization of web agents.

AI.tldr: HMT（分层记忆树）通过三层结构解耦逻辑规划与动作执行，显著提升Web智能体在跨网站场景的泛化能力
AI.motivation: 现有基于检索记忆的Web智能体在跨网站泛化方面表现不佳，主要原因是扁平化记忆结构将高层任务逻辑与站点特定动作细节混在一起，导致在新环境中出现工作流不匹配和执行逻辑不一致的问题
AI.method: 提出分层记忆树（HMT）框架，通过自动化抽象流水线从原始轨迹构建三层结构：意图层（用户指令到标准化任务目标）、阶段层（可重用语义子目标）、动作层（动作模式与可转移语义元素描述）。基于此结构开发阶段感知推理机制，包含规划器和执行器
AI.result: 在Mind2Web和WebArena上的实验结果显示，HMT显著优于扁平记忆方法，特别是在跨网站和跨领域场景中，证明了结构化记忆对Web智能体鲁棒泛化的必要性
AI.conclusion: 分层记忆结构能有效解耦逻辑规划与动作执行，解决工作流不匹配问题，显著提升Web智能体在未见网站上的泛化能力，为构建更鲁棒的Web自动化系统提供了重要思路

title: Unmixing microinfrared spectroscopic images of cross-sections of historical oil paintings
summary:
Spectroscopic imaging (SI) has become central to heritage science because it enables non-invasive, spatially resolved characterisation of materials in artefacts. In particular, attenuated total reflection Fourier transform infrared microscopy (ATR-$μ$FTIR) is widely used to analyse painting cross-sections, where a spectrum is recorded at each pixel to form a hyperspectral image (HSI). Interpreting these data is difficult: spectra are often mixtures of several species in heterogeneous, multi-layered and degraded samples, and current practice still relies heavily on manual comparison with reference libraries. This workflow is slow, subjective and hard to scale.
  We propose an unsupervised CNN autoencoder for blind unmixing of ATR-$μ$FTIR HSIs, estimating endmember spectra and their abundance maps while exploiting local spatial structure through patch-based modelling. To reduce sensitivity to atmospheric and acquisition artefacts across $>1500$ bands, we introduce a weighted spectral angle distance (WSAD) loss with automatic band-reliability weights derived from robust measures of spatial flatness, neighbour agreement and spectral roughness. Compared with standard SAD training, WSAD improves interpretability in contamination-prone spectral regions. We demonstrate the method on an ATR-$μ$FTIR cross-section from the Ghent Altarpiece attributed to the Van Eyck brothers.

AI.tldr: 提出一种用于ATR-μFTIR高光谱图像盲解混的无监督CNN自编码器，通过加权光谱角距离损失提高对大气和采集伪影的鲁棒性，并在根特祭坛画样本上验证了方法。
AI.motivation: 当前文化遗产科学中ATR-μFTIR高光谱图像分析主要依赖人工比对参考库，这种方法耗时、主观且难以扩展。光谱数据通常是多种物质的混合物，存在于异质、多层和降解的样品中，解释这些数据非常困难。
AI.method: 提出无监督CNN自编码器进行盲解混，估计端元光谱及其丰度图，通过基于块的建模利用局部空间结构。引入加权光谱角距离损失，从空间平坦度、邻域一致性和光谱粗糙度的鲁棒度量中自动推导波段可靠性权重，减少对大气和采集伪影的敏感性。
AI.result: 与标准SAD训练相比，WSAD在易受污染的谱区提高了可解释性。方法在根特祭坛画（归因于范艾克兄弟）的ATR-μFTIR横截面样本上进行了验证。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为文化遗产科学中的ATR-μFTIR高光谱图像分析提供了一种自动化的盲解混解决方案，通过加权光谱角距离损失提高了对噪声和伪影的鲁棒性，有望替代当前耗时且主观的人工分析方法。

title: Self-Supervised Multi-Modal World Model with 4D Space-Time Embedding
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Presented at 2026 World Modeling Workshop, Mila Quebec
