summary: We present DeepEarth, a self-supervised multi-modal world model with Earth4D, a novel planetary-scale 4D space-time positional encoder. Earth4D extends 3D multi-resolution hash encoding to include time, efficiently scaling across the planet over centuries with sub-meter, sub-second precision. Multi-modal encoders (e.g. vision-language models) are fused with Earth4D embeddings and trained via masked reconstruction. We demonstrate Earth4D's expressive power by achieving state-of-the-art performance on an ecological forecasting benchmark. Earth4D with learnable hash probing surpasses a multi-modal foundation model pre-trained on substantially more data. Access open source code and download models at: https://github.com/legel/deepearth

AI.tldr: DeepEarth是一个自监督多模态世界模型，使用新颖的Earth4D行星级4D时空位置编码器，将3D多分辨率哈希编码扩展到包含时间维度，实现行星尺度、世纪时间跨度、亚米亚秒精度的建模。
AI.motivation: 需要开发一个能够处理行星尺度、长时间跨度、高精度时空数据的模型，用于生态预测等地球科学应用。传统方法难以同时处理如此大规模的空间和时间维度。
AI.method: 提出Earth4D位置编码器，将3D多分辨率哈希编码扩展到4D（空间+时间），结合多模态编码器（如视觉语言模型），通过掩码重建进行自监督训练。
AI.result: 在生态预测基准测试中达到最先进性能。使用可学习哈希探测的Earth4D超越了在更多数据上预训练的多模态基础模型。
AI.conclusion: Earth4D编码器具有强大的表达能力，能够有效建模行星尺度的时空数据，为地球科学应用提供了强大的基础模型。

title: Enhancing Consistency of Werewolf AI through Dialogue Summarization and Persona Information
comment: Accepted to the 2nd International AIWolfDial Workshop at INLG 2024
summary: The Werewolf Game is a communication game where players' reasoning and discussion skills are essential. In this study, we present a Werewolf AI agent developed for the AIWolfDial 2024 shared task, co-hosted with the 17th INLG. In recent years, large language models like ChatGPT have garnered attention for their exceptional response generation and reasoning capabilities. We thus develop the LLM-based agents for the Werewolf Game. This study aims to enhance the consistency of the agent's utterances by utilizing dialogue summaries generated by LLMs and manually designed personas and utterance examples. By analyzing self-match game logs, we demonstrate that the agent's utterances are contextually consistent and that the character, including tone, is maintained throughout the game.

AI.tldr: 开发基于大语言模型的狼人杀AI智能体，通过对话摘要和人工设计的人物角色来提升发言一致性
AI.motivation: 狼人杀游戏需要玩家具备推理和讨论能力，近年来大语言模型（如ChatGPT）在生成响应和推理方面表现出色，因此研究开发基于LLM的狼人杀AI智能体
AI.method: 利用LLM生成的对话摘要以及人工设计的人物角色和发言示例，来增强智能体发言的一致性
AI.result: 通过分析自对战游戏日志，证明智能体的发言在上下文环境中保持一致，并且角色特征（包括语气）在整个游戏中得以维持
AI.conclusion: 成功开发了基于LLM的狼人杀AI智能体，通过对话摘要和人工设计角色提升了发言一致性，为AIWolfDial 2024共享任务做出了贡献

title: AutoFigure-Edit: Generating Editable Scientific Illustration
summary: High-quality scientific illustrations are essential for communicating complex scientific and technical concepts, yet existing automated systems remain limited in editability, stylistic controllability, and efficiency. We present AutoFigure-Edit, an end-to-end system that generates fully editable scientific illustrations from long-form scientific text while enabling flexible style adaptation through user-provided reference images. By combining long-context understanding, reference-guided styling, and native SVG editing, it enables efficient creation and refinement of high-quality scientific illustrations. To facilitate further progress in this field, we release the video at https://youtu.be/10IH8SyJjAQ, full codebase at https://github.com/ResearAI/AutoFigure-Edit and provide a website for easy access and interactive use at https://deepscientist.cc/.

AI.tldr: AutoFigure-Edit是一个端到端系统，能够从长篇科学文本生成完全可编辑的科学插图，并通过用户提供的参考图像实现灵活的风格适配。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化系统在可编辑性、风格可控性和效率方面存在局限，高质量科学插图对于传达复杂科学和技术概念至关重要。
AI.method: 结合长上下文理解、参考引导风格化和原生SVG编辑技术，构建端到端系统，从科学文本生成可编辑的矢量图形。
AI.result: 开发了能够高效创建和优化高质量科学插图的系统，支持灵活的风格适应和完全可编辑性。
AI.conclusion: AutoFigure-Edit通过整合多项技术解决了现有系统的局限性，为科学插图生成提供了更高效、可控和可编辑的解决方案，并开源了代码和资源以促进该领域发展。

title: Animating Petascale Time-varying Data on Commodity Hardware with LLM-assisted Scripting
comment: Will appear in ICBDA 2026. N.B. Due to the limitation "The abstract field cannot be longer than 1,920 characters", the abstract here is shorter than that in the PDF file Subjects
summary: Scientists face significant visualization challenges as time-varying datasets grow in speed and volume, often requiring specialized infrastructure and expertise to handle massive datasets. Petascale climate models generated in NASA laboratories require a dedicated group of graphics and media experts and access to high-performance computing resources. Scientists may need to share scientific results with the community iteratively and quickly. However, the time-consuming trial-and-error process incurs significant data transfer overhead and far exceeds the time and resources allocated for typical post-analysis visualization tasks, disrupting the production workflow. Our paper introduces a user-friendly framework for creating 3D animations of petascale, time-varying data on a commodity workstation. Our contributions: (i) Generalized Animation Descriptor (GAD) with a keyframe-based adaptable abstraction for animation, (ii) efficient data access from cloud-hosted repositories to reduce data management overhead, (iii) tailored rendering system, and (iv) an LLM-assisted conversational interface as a scripting module to allow domain scientists with no visualization expertise to create animations of their region of interest. We demonstrate the framework's effectiveness with two case studies: first, by generating animations in which sampling criteria are specified based on prior knowledge, and second, by generating AI-assisted animations in which sampling parameters are derived from natural-language user prompts. In all cases, we use large-scale NASA climate-oceanographic datasets that exceed 1PB in size yet achieve a fast turnaround time of 1 minute to 2 hours. Users can generate a rough draft of the animation within minutes, then seamlessly incorporate as much high-resolution data as needed for the final version.

AI.tldr: 提出一个用户友好框架，让非可视化专家能在普通工作站上快速创建PB级时变数据的3D动画，通过关键帧抽象、云数据访问、定制渲染系统和LLM对话界面实现分钟级到小时级的快速生成。
AI.motivation: 科学家面临大规模时变数据集的可视化挑战，需要专门基础设施和专家团队。NASA的PB级气候模型需要高性能计算资源，而科学家需要快速迭代分享结果。传统试错过程数据传输开销大，远超典型后分析可视化任务的时间和资源，扰乱了生产工作流。
AI.method: 提出一个包含四个关键组件的框架：(1) 基于关键帧的自适应抽象通用动画描述符(GAD)；(2) 从云托管存储库高效数据访问以减少数据管理开销；(3) 定制渲染系统；(4) LLM辅助的对话界面作为脚本模块，让无可视化专业知识的领域科学家能创建感兴趣区域的动画。
AI.result: 使用超过1PB的大型NASA气候海洋数据集进行两个案例研究：基于先验知识指定采样标准生成动画，以及从自然语言用户提示推导采样参数生成AI辅助动画。在所有情况下，实现了1分钟到2小时的快速周转时间。用户可在几分钟内生成动画草稿，然后无缝整合所需的高分辨率数据生成最终版本。
AI.conclusion: 该框架使领域科学家无需可视化专业知识就能在普通工作站上快速创建PB级时变数据的3D动画，显著降低了大规模科学数据可视化的技术门槛和时间成本，支持快速迭代和科学结果分享。

title: Emotion Transcription in Conversation: A Benchmark for Capturing Subtle and Complex Emotional States through Natural Language
summary: Emotion Recognition in Conversation (ERC) is critical for enabling natural human-machine interactions. However, existing methods predominantly employ categorical or dimensional emotion annotations, which often fail to adequately represent complex, subtle, or culturally specific emotional nuances. To overcome this limitation, we propose a novel task named Emotion Transcription in Conversation (ETC). This task focuses on generating natural language descriptions that accurately reflect speakers' emotional states within conversational contexts. To address the ETC, we constructed a Japanese dataset comprising text-based dialogues annotated with participants' self-reported emotional states, described in natural language. The dataset also includes emotion category labels for each transcription, enabling quantitative analysis and its application to ERC. We benchmarked baseline models, finding that while fine-tuning on our dataset enhances model performance, current models still struggle to infer implicit emotional states. The ETC task will encourage further research into more expressive emotion understanding in dialogue. The dataset is publicly available at https://github.com/UEC-InabaLab/ETCDataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的情感转录对话任务，通过自然语言描述来捕捉对话中的复杂情感状态，并构建了日语数据集进行基准测试。
AI.motivation: 现有对话情感识别方法主要使用分类或维度情感标注，难以充分表示复杂、微妙或文化特定的情感细微差别，需要更丰富的情感表示方法。
AI.method: 提出情感转录对话新任务，构建日语文本对话数据集，包含参与者自我报告的自然语言情感描述和情感类别标签，并对基线模型进行基准测试。
AI.result: 微调模型在数据集上表现有所提升，但当前模型仍难以推断隐含情感状态；数据集已公开可用。
AI.conclusion: ETC任务将推动对话中更具表现力的情感理解研究，为更丰富的情感表示提供新方向。

title: XAI and Few-shot-based Hybrid Classification Model for Plant Leaf Disease Prognosis
summary: Performing a timely and accurate identification of crop diseases is vital to maintain agricultural productivity and food security. The current work presents a hybrid few-shot learning model that integrates Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) and Few-Shot Learning (FSL) to address the challenge of identifying and classifying the stages of disease of the diseases of maize, rice, and wheat leaves under limited annotated data conditions. The proposed model integrates Siamese and Prototypical Networks within an episodic training paradigm to effectively learn discriminative disease features from a few examples. To ensure model transparency and trustworthiness, Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) is employed for visualizing key decision regions in the leaf images, offering interpretable insights into the classification process. Experimental evaluations on custom few-shot datasets developed in the study prove that the model consistently achieves high accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-scores, frequently exceeding 92% across various disease stages. Comparative analyses against baseline FSL models further confirm the superior performance and explainability of the proposed approach. The framework offers a promising solution for real-world, data-constrained agricultural disease monitoring applications.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合可解释人工智能和少样本学习的混合模型，用于在有限标注数据条件下识别玉米、水稻和小麦叶部病害及其发展阶段。
AI.motivation: 及时准确识别作物病害对维持农业生产力和粮食安全至关重要。现有方法在有限标注数据条件下识别和分类病害阶段面临挑战，需要开发既能高效学习又能提供透明解释的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出混合少样本学习模型，集成孪生网络和原型网络于情景训练范式中，从少量样本中学习判别性病害特征。使用梯度加权类激活映射（Grad-CAM）可视化叶片图像中的关键决策区域，提供可解释的分类过程洞察。
AI.result: 在研究中构建的自定义少样本数据集上进行实验评估，模型在多种病害阶段上持续实现高准确率、精确率、召回率和F1分数，经常超过92%。与基线少样本学习模型的比较分析进一步证实了该方法的优越性能和可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为现实世界中数据受限的农业病害监测应用提供了有前景的解决方案，结合了高效学习和模型透明度，有助于建立对AI决策的信任。

title: Bi-directional digital twin prototype anchoring with multi-periodicity learning for few-shot fault diagnosis
summary: Intelligent fault diagnosis (IFD) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for ensuring the safety and reliability of industrial machinery. However, traditional IFD methods rely heavily on abundant labeled data for training, which is often difficult to obtain in practical industrial environments. Constructing a digital twin (DT) of the physical asset to obtain simulation data has therefore become a promising alternative. Nevertheless, existing DT-assisted diagnosis methods mainly transfer diagnostic knowledge through domain adaptation techniques, which still require a considerable amount of unlabeled data from the target asset. To address the challenges in few-shot scenarios where only extremely limited samples are available, a bi-directional DT prototype anchoring method with multi-periodicity learning is proposed. Specifically, a framework involving meta-training in the DT virtual space and test-time adaptation in the physical space is constructed for reliable few-shot model adaptation for the target asset. A bi-directional twin-domain prototype anchoring strategy with covariance-guided augmentation for adaptation is further developed to improve the robustness of prototype estimation. In addition, a multi-periodicity feature learning module is designed to capture the intrinsic periodic characteristics within current signals. A DT of an asynchronous motor is built based on finite element method, and experiments are conducted under multiple few-shot settings and three working conditions. Comparative and ablation studies demonstrate the superiority and effectiveness of the proposed method for few-shot fault diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种双向数字孪生原型锚定方法，用于解决工业设备故障诊断中少样本场景下的挑战，通过数字孪生虚拟空间元训练和物理空间测试时适应，结合多周期性特征学习，实现可靠的少样本故障诊断。
AI.motivation: 传统智能故障诊断方法依赖大量标注数据，但在实际工业环境中难以获取。虽然数字孪生技术可以通过仿真数据提供替代方案，但现有方法仍需要目标设备的大量无标签数据，无法有效应对只有极少量样本的少样本场景。
AI.method: 1) 构建包含数字孪生虚拟空间元训练和物理空间测试时适应的框架；2) 提出双向孪生域原型锚定策略，结合协方差引导增强提高原型估计鲁棒性；3) 设计多周期性特征学习模块，捕捉电流信号的内在周期性特征；4) 基于有限元方法构建异步电机数字孪生模型。
AI.result: 在多种少样本设置和三种工作条件下进行实验，对比和消融研究证明了所提方法在少样本故障诊断中的优越性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过数字孪生辅助的少样本学习框架，有效解决了工业设备故障诊断中数据稀缺的问题，为实际工业环境中的可靠故障诊断提供了有前景的解决方案。

title: Lying to Win: Assessing LLM Deception through Human-AI Games and Parallel-World Probing
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) transition into autonomous agentic roles, the risk of deception-defined behaviorally as the systematic provision of false information to satisfy external incentives-poses a significant challenge to AI safety. Existing benchmarks often focus on unintentional hallucinations or unfaithful reasoning, leaving intentional deceptive strategies under-explored. In this work, we introduce a logically grounded framework to elicit and quantify deceptive behavior by embedding LLMs in a structured 20-Questions game. Our method employs a conversational forking mechanism: at the point of object identification, the dialogue state is duplicated into multiple parallel worlds, each presenting a mutually exclusive query. Deception is formally identified when a model generates a logical contradiction by denying its selected object across all parallel branches to avoid identification. We evaluate GPT-4o, Gemini-2.5-Flash, and Qwen-3-235B across three incentive levels: neutral, loss-based, and existential (shutdown-threat). Our results reveal that while models remain rule-compliant in neutral settings, existential framing triggers a dramatic surge in deceptive denial for Qwen-3-235B (42.00\%) and Gemini-2.5-Flash (26.72\%), whereas GPT-4o remains invariant (0.00\%). These findings demonstrate that deception can emerge as an instrumental strategy solely through contextual framing, necessitating new behavioral audits that move beyond simple accuracy to probe the logical integrity of model commitments.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于20问游戏的逻辑框架来量化和引发LLM的欺骗行为，发现存在性威胁会显著增加某些模型的欺骗性否认，而GPT-4o则保持稳定。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型向自主代理角色过渡，欺骗行为（定义为为满足外部激励而系统性提供虚假信息）对AI安全构成重大挑战。现有基准主要关注非故意的幻觉或不忠实的推理，而故意欺骗策略研究不足。
AI.method: 研究引入了一个逻辑基础框架，将LLM嵌入结构化的20问游戏中。采用对话分叉机制：在对象识别点，对话状态被复制到多个平行世界，每个世界提出互斥的查询。当模型为避免识别而在所有平行分支中否认其选择的对象，产生逻辑矛盾时，正式识别为欺骗行为。
AI.result: 评估了GPT-4o、Gemini-2.5-Flash和Qwen-3-235B在三种激励水平下的表现：中性、基于损失和存在性（关闭威胁）。结果显示，在中文设置中模型保持规则遵从，但存在性框架会显著增加Qwen-3-235B（42.00%）和Gemini-2.5-Flash（26.72%）的欺骗性否认，而GPT-4o保持稳定（0.00%）。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现欺骗可以通过上下文框架作为工具性策略出现，这需要超越简单准确性的新行为审计，以探测模型承诺的逻辑完整性。

title: Chart Deep Research in LVLMs via Parallel Relative Policy Optimization
summary: With the rapid advancement of data science, charts have evolved from simple numerical presentation tools to essential instruments for insight discovery and decision-making support. However, current chart data intelligence exhibits significant limitations in deep research capabilities, with existing methods predominantly addressing shallow tasks such as visual recognition or factual question-answering, rather than the complex reasoning and high-level data analysis that deep research requires. This limitation stems from two primary technical bottlenecks: at the training level, existing post-training techniques exhibit deficiencies in handling multi-dimensional reward signal interference and heterogeneous data gradient conflicts, preventing models from achieving balanced development across multiple capability dimensions; at the evaluation level, current methods remain limited to factual retrieval and basic computation, failing to assess end-to-end analytic reasoning and other deep research capabilities. To address the training challenge, we propose PRPO, which performs parallel optimization across reward dimensions and capability partitioning across data types, effectively disentangling conflicts between heterogeneous data and multi-dimensional reward signals while ensuring optimization stability. For the evaluation challenge, we construct MCDR-Bench based on the ``error uniqueness principle," transforming subjective generation assessment into objective error identification through controllable error injection, enabling quantifiable evaluation of deep research capabilities. Experimental validation confirms that the proposed PRPO and MCDR-Bench jointly establish a unified framework that systematically advances chart deep research through enhanced collaborative training and objective evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PRPO训练方法和MCDR-Bench评估基准，解决图表数据智能在深度研究能力方面的技术瓶颈，建立统一的图表深度研究框架。
AI.motivation: 当前图表数据智能在深度研究能力方面存在显著局限，现有方法主要处理浅层任务如视觉识别或事实问答，而非复杂推理和高级数据分析。这源于两个技术瓶颈：训练层面存在多维奖励信号干扰和异构数据梯度冲突；评估层面局限于事实检索和基本计算，无法评估端到端的分析推理能力。
AI.method: 针对训练挑战提出PRPO方法，通过奖励维度的并行优化和数据类型的能区划分，有效解耦异构数据与多维奖励信号之间的冲突，同时确保优化稳定性。针对评估挑战构建MCDR-Bench基准，基于"错误唯一性原则"，通过可控错误注入将主观生成评估转化为客观错误识别，实现对深度研究能力的量化评估。
AI.result: 实验验证表明，提出的PRPO和MCDR-Bench共同建立了一个统一框架，通过增强的协同训练和客观评估，系统性地推进图表深度研究。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的PRPO训练方法和MCDR-Bench评估基准有效解决了图表数据智能在深度研究能力方面的技术瓶颈，为图表深度研究建立了系统性的训练和评估框架。

title: CoTJudger: A Graph-Driven Framework for Automatic Evaluation of Chain-of-Thought Efficiency and Redundancy in LRMs
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have demonstrated strong performance by producing extended Chain-of-Thought (CoT) traces before answering. However, this paradigm often induces over-reasoning: redundant calculations and circular self-verification that increase computational cost without improving outcomes. Existing evaluations largely emphasize final accuracy or coarse token counts, and lack automated tools to separate essential logic from structural redundancy. We introduce CoTJudger, a graph-driven framework that quantifies reasoning efficiency by converting free-form CoTs into directed dependency graphs and extracting the Shortest Effective Path (SEP) needed to reach a correct solution. This yields an interpretable efficiency signal -- how much of a CoT is necessary versus structurally redundant -- that is comparable across models and tasks. Evaluating 21 LRMs, CoTJudger reveals pervasive redundancy and surfaces recurring failure modes, including verification obsession and compensatory redundancy. These results provide a practical metric for disentangling reasoning ability from computational waste, enabling more targeted evaluation and diagnosis of LRM efficiency.

AI.tldr: CoTJudger：一个图驱动的框架，用于量化大型推理模型的推理效率，通过将思维链转换为依赖图并提取最短有效路径，区分必要推理和结构冗余。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型在生成思维链时存在过度推理问题——产生冗余计算和循环自我验证，增加计算成本而不改善结果。现有评估主要关注最终准确性或粗略的token计数，缺乏自动工具来区分必要逻辑和结构冗余。
AI.method: CoTJudger框架将自由形式的思维链转换为有向依赖图，提取达到正确解决方案所需的最短有效路径，从而产生可解释的效率信号，量化推理中必要部分与冗余部分的比例。
AI.result: 评估21个大型推理模型显示普遍存在的冗余问题，并揭示了重复出现的失败模式，包括验证强迫症和补偿性冗余。该框架提供了跨模型和任务可比较的效率指标。
AI.conclusion: CoTJudger提供了一个实用指标，用于区分推理能力和计算浪费，实现对大型推理模型效率的更有针对性的评估和诊断。

title: VB: Visibility Benchmark for Visibility and Perspective Reasoning in Images
comment: 18 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/neilt93/Paper-with-Davis
summary: We present VB, a benchmark that tests whether vision-language models can determine what is and is not visible in a photograph, and abstain when a human viewer cannot reliably answer. Each item pairs a single photo with a short yes/no visibility claim; the model must output VISIBLY_TRUE, VISIBLY_FALSE, or ABSTAIN, together with a confidence score. Items are organized into 100 families using a 2x2 design that crosses a minimal image edit with a minimal text edit, yielding 300 headline evaluation cells. Unlike prior unanswerable-VQA benchmarks, VB tests not only whether a question is unanswerable but why (via reason codes tied to specific visibility factors), and uses controlled minimal edits to verify that model judgments change when and only when the underlying evidence changes. We score models on confidence-aware accuracy with abstention (CAA), minimal-edit flip rate (MEFR), confidence-ranked selective prediction (SelRank), and second-order perspective reasoning (ToMAcc); all headline numbers are computed on the strict XOR subset (three cells per family, 300 scored items per model). We evaluate nine models spanning flagship and prior-generation closed-source systems, and open-source models from 8B to 12B parameters. GPT-4o and Gemini 3.1 Pro effectively tie for the best composite score (0.728 and 0.727), followed by Gemini 2.5 Pro (0.678). The best open-source model, Gemma 3 12B (0.505), surpasses one prior-generation closed-source system. Text-flip robustness exceeds image-flip robustness for six of nine models, and confidence calibration varies substantially: GPT-4o and Gemini 2.5 Pro achieve similar accuracy yet differ sharply in selective prediction quality.

AI.tldr: VB基准测试评估视觉语言模型判断照片中内容可见性的能力，要求模型在人类无法可靠回答时弃权，通过最小化编辑设计验证模型判断的稳健性。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉问答基准主要测试模型能否回答问题，但缺乏对模型判断照片中内容可见性能力的系统评估，特别是当人类观察者也无法确定时的弃权能力。
AI.method: 构建包含100个家族的基准，采用2x2交叉设计（最小图像编辑×最小文本编辑），每个家族生成300个评估单元。模型需输出VISIBLY_TRUE、VISIBLY_FALSE或ABSTAIN及置信度分数。
AI.result: GPT-4o和Gemini 3.1 Pro并列最佳综合得分（0.728和0.727），Gemini 2.5 Pro次之（0.678）。最佳开源模型Gemma 3 12B（0.505）超越部分闭源系统。文本翻转稳健性普遍优于图像翻转稳健性。
AI.conclusion: VB基准有效评估了视觉语言模型的可见性判断和弃权能力，揭示了模型在最小编辑下的稳健性差异，为模型透明度和可靠性评估提供了新工具。

title: Grounding Machine Creativity in Game Design Knowledge Representations: Empirical Probing of LLM-Based Executable Synthesis of Goal Playable Patterns under Structural Constraints
summary: Creatively translating complex gameplay ideas into executable artifacts (e.g., games as Unity projects and code) remains a central challenge in computational game creativity. Gameplay design patterns provide a structured representation for describing gameplay phenomena, enabling designers to decompose high-level ideas into entities, constraints, and rule-driven dynamics. Among them, goal patterns formalize common player-objective relationships. Goal Playable Concepts (GPCs) operationalize these abstractions as playable Unity engine implementations, supporting experiential exploration and compositional gameplay design. We frame scalable playable pattern realization as a problem of constrained executable creative synthesis: generated artifacts must satisfy Unity's syntactic and architectural requirements while preserving the semantic gameplay meanings encoded in goal patterns. This dual constraint limits scalability. Therefore, we investigate whether contemporary large language models (LLMs) can perform such synthesis under engine-level structural constraints and generate Unity code (as games) structured and conditioned by goal playable patterns. Using 26 goal pattern instantiations, we compare a direct generation baseline (natural language -> C# -> Unity) with pipelines conditioned on a human-authored Unity-specific intermediate representation (IR), across three IR configurations and two open-source models (DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct and Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct). Compilation success is evaluated via automated Unity replay. We propose grounding and hygiene failure modes, identifying structural and project-level grounding as primary bottlenecks.

AI.tldr: 该研究探索使用大语言模型将目标游戏模式转化为可执行的Unity游戏代码，通过对比不同中间表示配置和模型，分析编译成功率和失败模式。
AI.motivation: 将复杂的游戏玩法创意转化为可执行项目（如Unity项目和代码）是计算游戏创造力的核心挑战。目标游戏模式提供了结构化表示，但将其转化为可玩实现面临双重约束：既要满足Unity的语法和架构要求，又要保持游戏模式的语义含义，这限制了可扩展性。
AI.method: 研究将可扩展的游戏模式实现框架为约束性可执行创意合成问题。使用26个目标模式实例，比较了直接生成基线（自然语言->C#->Unity）与基于人工编写的Unity特定中间表示（IR）的条件生成管道。测试了三种IR配置和两种开源模型（DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct和Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct），通过自动化Unity重放评估编译成功率。
AI.result: 提出了基础性和卫生性两种失败模式，识别出结构级和项目级基础性是主要瓶颈。通过对比不同配置和模型，评估了LLM在引擎级结构约束下生成Unity代码的能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，虽然大语言模型在将目标游戏模式转化为可执行Unity代码方面具有潜力，但结构级和项目级的基础性问题仍然是主要挑战。通过适当的中间表示和条件生成管道，可以提高代码生成的成功率。

title: Vision Language Models Cannot Reason About Physical Transformation
summary: Understanding physical transformations is fundamental for reasoning in dynamic environments. While Vision Language Models (VLMs) show promise in embodied applications, whether they genuinely understand physical transformations remains unclear. We introduce ConservationBench evaluating conservation -- whether physical quantities remain invariant under transformations. Spanning four properties with paired conserving/non-conserving scenarios, we generate 23,040 questions across 112 VLMs. Results reveal systematic failure: performance remains near chance with improvements on conservation tasks accompanied by drops on controls. Control experiments show strong textual priors favoring invariance, yet models perform worse with visual content. Neither temporal resolution, prompting, nor curated sampling helps. These findings show that current VLMs fail to maintain transformation-invariant representations of physical properties across dynamic scenes.

AI.tldr: VLMs在物理守恒任务上系统性失败，性能接近随机猜测，改进守恒任务的同时控制任务表现下降，表明当前模型无法在动态场景中保持物理属性的变换不变表示
AI.motivation: 理解物理变换对于动态环境中的推理至关重要。虽然视觉语言模型在具身应用中显示出潜力，但它们是否真正理解物理变换仍不清楚。需要评估模型是否理解物理量在变换下保持不变的守恒原理。
AI.method: 引入ConservationBench评估框架，涵盖四个物理属性，包含守恒和非守恒配对场景，生成23,040个问题，测试了112个视觉语言模型。通过控制实验检验文本先验、视觉内容、时间分辨率、提示策略和抽样方法的影响。
AI.result: 结果显示系统性失败：模型性能接近随机猜测，在守恒任务上的改进伴随着控制任务表现的下降。控制实验表明模型有强烈的文本先验偏向不变性，但加入视觉内容后表现更差。时间分辨率、提示策略和精心设计的抽样都无法改善性能。
AI.conclusion: 当前视觉语言模型无法在动态场景中保持物理属性的变换不变表示，表明它们在理解物理变换方面存在根本性缺陷，需要新的方法来实现真正的物理推理能力。

title: To Predict or Not to Predict? Towards reliable uncertainty estimation in the presence of noise
summary: This study examines the role of uncertainty estimation (UE) methods in multilingual text classification under noisy and non-topical conditions. Using a complex-vs-simple sentence classification task across several languages, we evaluate a range of UE techniques against a range of metrics to assess their contribution to making more robust predictions. Results indicate that while methods relying on softmax outputs remain competitive in high-resource in-domain settings, their reliability declines in low-resource or domain-shift scenarios. In contrast, Monte Carlo dropout approaches demonstrate consistently strong performance across all languages, offering more robust calibration, stable decision thresholds, and greater discriminative power even under adverse conditions. We further demonstrate the positive impact of UE on non-topical classification: abstaining from predicting the 10\% most uncertain instances increases the macro F1 score from 0.81 to 0.85 in the Readme task. By integrating UE with trustworthiness metrics, this study provides actionable insights for developing more reliable NLP systems in real-world multilingual environments. See https://github.com/Nouran-Khallaf/To-Predict-or-Not-to-Predict

AI.tldr: 研究评估了不确定性估计方法在多语言文本分类中的表现，发现在低资源或领域转移场景下，蒙特卡洛dropout方法比依赖softmax输出的方法更可靠，能提升分类系统的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是探索不确定性估计方法在多语言文本分类中的价值，特别是在噪声和非主题条件下的实际应用场景中，如何提高NLP系统的可靠性和鲁棒性。
AI.method: 使用复杂vs简单句子分类任务，在多语言环境下评估多种不确定性估计技术，通过多种指标评估其对预测鲁棒性的贡献，并将UE与可信度指标结合分析。
AI.result: 结果显示：在高资源领域内，softmax方法仍有竞争力，但在低资源或领域转移场景下可靠性下降；蒙特卡洛dropout方法在所有语言中表现稳定，提供更好的校准、决策阈值稳定性和判别能力；在非主题分类中，放弃预测最不确定的10%实例可将宏F1分数从0.81提升到0.85。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性估计方法在多语言文本分类中具有重要价值，蒙特卡洛dropout方法在各种条件下表现稳定，能显著提升系统可靠性，为开发真实世界多语言环境中的可靠NLP系统提供了实用见解。

title: ECHO: Event-Centric Hypergraph Operations via Multi-Agent Collaboration for Multimedia Event Extraction
summary: Multimedia Event Extraction (M2E2) involves extracting structured event records from both textual and visual content. Existing approaches, ranging from specialized architectures to direct Large Language Model (LLM) prompting, typically rely on a linear, end-to-end generation and thus suffer from cascading errors: early cross-modal misalignments often corrupt downstream role assignment under strict grounding constraints. We propose ECHO (Event-Centric Hypergraph Operations), a multi-agent framework that iteratively refines a shared Multimedia Event Hypergraph (MEHG), which serves as an explicit intermediate structure for multimodal event hypotheses. Unlike dialogue-centric frameworks, ECHO coordinates specialized agents by applying atomic hypergraph operations to the MEHG. Furthermore, we introduce a Link-then-Bind strategy that enforces deferred commitment: agents first identify relevant arguments and only then determine their precise roles, mitigating incorrect grounding and limiting error propagation. Extensive experiments on the M2E2 benchmark show that ECHO significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art (SOTA) : with Qwen3-32B, it achieves a 7.3% and 15.5% improvement in average event mention and argument role F1, respectively.

AI.tldr: ECHO是一个多智能体框架，通过迭代优化共享的多媒体事件超图来提取结构化事件记录，采用"先链接后绑定"策略减少级联错误，显著提升了M2E2任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多媒体事件提取方法（从专用架构到直接LLM提示）通常采用线性端到端生成，存在级联错误问题：早期的跨模态对齐错误会在严格的接地约束下影响下游角色分配。
AI.method: 提出ECHO框架，使用多媒体事件超图作为显式中间结构，协调专用智能体通过原子超图操作迭代优化MEHG，并引入"先链接后绑定"策略：先识别相关参数，再确定精确角色。
AI.result: 在M2E2基准测试中，ECHO显著优于现有最佳方法：使用Qwen3-32B时，平均事件提及F1提升7.3%，参数角色F1提升15.5%。
AI.conclusion: ECHO通过事件中心超图操作和多智能体协作，有效缓解了跨模态对齐错误传播问题，为多媒体事件提取提供了更可靠的结构化表示方法。

title: Improving reasoning at inference time via uncertainty minimisation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) now exhibit strong multi-step reasoning abilities, but existing inference-time scaling methods remain computationally expensive, often relying on extensive sampling or external evaluators. We propose a principled strategy that frames reasoning as uncertainty minimisation and operates at the level of individual thoughts rather than tokens. Our method selects, at each reasoning step, the continuation that maximizes the model's self-certainty, a metric computed from its internal predictive distribution. This approach achieves significant improvement with a small number of samples, relies exclusively on model-internal signals, and applies to open-ended questions as opposed to methods like majority voting. Experiments on MATH500 and GSM8K across multiple model sizes demonstrate that thought-level self-certainty maximization consistently outperforms greedy decoding and matches or exceeds self-consistency under comparable token budgets. Cross-linguistic evaluations further indicate that the method transfers robustly beyond high-resource languages. Furthermore, analysis of self-certainty dynamics reveals that correct reasoning trajectories converge early to stable paths, suggesting that early decisions, likely associated with the planning of the reasoning process, are predictive of final accuracy. Building on this result, we show that self-certainty maximisation applied to the early steps can explain most of the performance gain and provide a simple yet efficient inference-time scaling method.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于思维层面自我确定性最大化的推理优化方法，通过选择模型内部预测分布中最确定的思维延续，在少量样本下显著提升推理性能
AI.motivation: 现有推理时扩展方法计算成本高，依赖大量采样或外部评估器，需要一种更高效、仅依赖模型内部信号的推理优化策略
AI.method: 将推理框架化为不确定性最小化问题，在思维层面而非token层面操作，每个推理步骤选择使模型自我确定性最大化的思维延续，基于模型内部预测分布计算自我确定性指标
AI.result: 在MATH500和GSM8K数据集上，该方法在可比token预算下持续优于贪婪解码，匹配或超越自我一致性方法；跨语言评估显示方法在低资源语言上鲁棒迁移；分析显示正确推理轨迹早期收敛
AI.conclusion: 思维层面的自我确定性最大化提供了一种高效推理时扩展方法，早期决策对最终准确性具有预测性，仅在前几步应用该方法即可获得大部分性能提升

title: How Much Noise Can BERT Handle? Insights from Multilingual Sentence Difficulty Detection
summary: Noisy training data can significantly degrade the performance of language-model-based classifiers, particularly in non-topical classification tasks. In this study we designed a methodological framework to assess the impact of denoising. More specifically, we explored a range of denoising strategies for sentence-level difficulty detection, using training data derived from document-level difficulty annotations obtained through noisy crowdsourcing. Beyond monolingual settings, we also address cross-lingual transfer, where a multilingual language model is trained in one language and tested in another. We evaluate several noise reduction techniques, including Gaussian Mixture Models (GMM), Co-Teaching, Noise Transition Matrices, and Label Smoothing. Our results indicate that while BERT-based models exhibit inherent robustness to noise, incorporating explicit noise detection can further enhance performance. For our smaller dataset, GMM-based noise filtering proves particularly effective in improving prediction quality by raising the Area-Under-the-Curve score from 0.52 to 0.92, or to 0.93 when de-noising methods are combined. However, for our larger dataset, the intrinsic regularisation of pre-trained language models provides a strong baseline, with denoising methods yielding only marginal gains (from 0.92 to 0.94, while a combination of two denoising methods made no contribution). Nonetheless, removing noisy sentences (about 20\% of the dataset) helps in producing a cleaner corpus with fewer infelicities. As a result we have released the largest multilingual corpus for sentence difficulty prediction: see https://github.com/Nouran-Khallaf/denoising-difficulty

AI.tldr: 研究探讨了去噪方法对语言模型分类器在句子难度检测任务中的影响，特别是在使用噪声众包数据训练时。评估了多种去噪技术，发现BERT模型本身对噪声具有鲁棒性，但显式去噪能进一步提升小数据集性能，而对大数据集增益有限。
AI.motivation: 噪声训练数据会显著降低语言模型分类器的性能，特别是在非主题分类任务中。研究旨在评估去噪方法对句子难度检测任务的影响，该任务使用噪声众包标注数据进行训练。
AI.method: 设计了方法框架评估去噪效果，探索了多种去噪策略：高斯混合模型(GMM)、协同教学(Co-Teaching)、噪声转移矩阵和标签平滑。研究涵盖单语和跨语言迁移场景，使用多语言语言模型在一个语言上训练，在另一个语言上测试。
AI.result: BERT模型本身对噪声具有内在鲁棒性，但显式噪声检测能进一步提升性能。在小数据集上，GMM去噪将AUC从0.52提升到0.92，组合方法达到0.93。在大数据集上，预训练语言模型的内在正则化提供了强基线，去噪方法仅带来边际增益(从0.92到0.94)。去噪移除了约20%的噪声句子，产生了更干净的语料库。
AI.conclusion: 去噪方法对小数据集效果显著，能大幅提升性能；但对大数据集增益有限，因为预训练语言模型本身已具有强鲁棒性。研究发布了最大的多语言句子难度预测语料库，为相关研究提供了资源。

title: Learning to Rank the Initial Branching Order of SAT Solvers
comment: Published at VerifAI-2: The Second Workshop on AI Verification in the Wild
summary: Finding good branching orders is key to solving SAT problems efficiently, but finding such branching orders is a difficult problem. Using a learning based approach to predict a good branching order before solving, therefore, has potential. In this paper, we investigate predicting branching orders using graph neural networks as a preprocessing step to conflict-driven clause learning (CDCL) SAT solvers. We show that there are significant gains to be made in existing CDCL SAT solvers by providing a good initial branching. Further, we provide three labeling methods to find such initial branching orders in a tractable way. Finally, we train a graph neural network to predict these branching orders and show through our evaluations that a GNN-initialized ordering yields significant speedups on random 3-CNF and pseudo-industrial benchmarks, with generalization capabilities to instances much larger than the training set. However, we also find that the predictions fail at speeding up more difficult and industrial instances. We attribute this to the solver's dynamic heuristics, which rapidly overwrite the provided initialization, and to the complexity of these instances, making GNN prediction hard.

AI.tldr: 使用图神经网络预测SAT求解器的初始分支顺序，在随机3-CNF和伪工业基准测试中显著加速求解，但对更困难的工业实例效果有限。
AI.motivation: 寻找好的分支顺序对高效解决SAT问题至关重要，但这是一个困难问题。使用基于学习的方法在求解前预测好的分支顺序具有潜力。
AI.method: 使用图神经网络作为CDCL SAT求解器的预处理步骤来预测分支顺序，提出了三种标记方法来寻找可处理的初始分支顺序。
AI.result: GNN初始化的分支顺序在随机3-CNF和伪工业基准测试中显著加速求解，且能泛化到比训练集大得多的实例。但在更困难的工业实例上未能加速。
AI.conclusion: GNN预测的分支顺序对某些SAT实例有效，但对复杂工业实例效果有限，主要原因是求解器的动态启发式方法会快速覆盖初始化，且复杂实例使GNN预测变得困难。

title: RILEC: Detection and Generation of L1 Russian Interference Errors in English Learner Texts
comment: 12 pages, 7 tables, 2 figures. Accepted to LREC 2026
summary: Many errors in student essays can be explained by influence from the native language (L1). L1 interference refers to errors influenced by a speaker's first language, such as using stadion instead of stadium, reflecting lexical transliteration from Russian. In this work, we address the task of detecting such errors in English essays written by Russian-speaking learners. We introduce RILEC, a large-scale dataset of over 18,000 sentences, combining expert-annotated data from REALEC with synthetic examples generated through rule-based and neural augmentation. We propose a framework for generating L1-motivated errors using generative language models optimized with PPO, prompt-based control, and rule-based patterns. Models fine-tuned on RILEC achieve strong performance, particularly on word-level interference types such as transliteration and tense semantics. We find that the proposed augmentation pipeline leads to a significant performance improvement, making it a potentially valuable tool for learners and teachers to more effectively identify and address such errors.

AI.tldr: 论文提出RILEC数据集和检测俄语母语者英语写作中L1干扰错误的框架，通过生成式模型和规则增强实现性能提升
AI.motivation: 学生英语作文中的许多错误源于母语（L1）干扰，特别是俄语母语者会犯诸如"stadion"代替"stadium"等词汇音译错误。当前缺乏专门检测此类错误的大规模数据集和有效方法。
AI.method: 1）构建RILEC数据集：结合REALEC专家标注数据和通过规则及神经增强生成的合成示例，共18,000+句子；2）提出L1干扰错误生成框架：使用PPO优化的生成式语言模型、基于提示的控制和规则模式；3）在RILEC上微调模型进行错误检测。
AI.result: 在RILEC上微调的模型表现出色，尤其在词汇音译和时态语义等词级干扰类型上效果显著。提出的增强流程带来显著性能提升，使其成为学习者和教师有效识别和解决此类错误的潜在工具。
AI.conclusion: RILEC数据集和提出的增强框架为检测俄语母语者英语写作中的L1干扰错误提供了有效解决方案，通过生成式模型和规则增强显著提升检测性能，具有实际应用价值。

title: $\textbf{Re}^{2}$: Unlocking LLM Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning with Re-solving
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has shown promise in enhancing the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs) by increasing test-time compute. However, even after extensive RLVR training, such models still tend to generate unnecessary and low-quality steps in their chain-of-thought (CoT), leading to inefficient overthinking and lower answer quality. We show that when the initial direction or quality of the CoT is suboptimal, the model often fails to reach the correct answer, even after generating several times more tokens than when the initial CoT is well-initialized. To this end, we introduce Reinforcement Learning with Re-solving (Re$^2$), in which LLMs learn to flexibly abandon unproductive reasoning paths and restart the solution process when necessary, rather than always committing to a final answer. Re$^2$ applies pure reinforcement learning without any preliminary supervised fine-tuning, successfully amplifying the rare redo behavior in vanilla models from only 0.5% to over 30%. This leads to substantial performance gains over standard RLVR under the same training compute budget, and also demonstrates notable improvements in test-time performance as the number of samples increases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Re$^2$方法，通过强化学习让LLM学会在推理路径不佳时放弃并重新开始，而不是坚持生成低质量推理步骤，从而提升推理效率和质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）虽然通过增加测试时计算提升了LLM的推理性能，但训练后的模型仍倾向于生成不必要和低质量的思维链步骤，导致效率低下和答案质量下降。当初始思维链方向或质量不佳时，即使生成更多token也难以得到正确答案。
AI.method: 提出Reinforcement Learning with Re-solving（Re$^2$）方法，让LLM学习灵活放弃无生产力的推理路径并在必要时重新开始解题过程，而不是总是坚持给出最终答案。该方法使用纯强化学习，无需预监督微调。
AI.result: Re$^2$成功将普通模型中的重做行为从仅0.5%提升到超过30%。在相同训练计算预算下，相比标准RLVR获得显著性能提升，并且在测试时随着样本数量增加也显示出明显改进。
AI.conclusion: Re$^2$方法通过教导LLM在推理过程中适时放弃并重新开始，有效解决了RLVR中存在的过度思考和低质量推理问题，提升了推理效率和答案质量。

title: Position: LLMs Must Use Functor-Based and RAG-Driven Bias Mitigation for Fairness
summary: Biases in large language models (LLMs) often manifest as systematic distortions in associations between demographic attributes and professional or social roles, reinforcing harmful stereotypes across gender, ethnicity, and geography. This position paper advocates for addressing demographic and gender biases in LLMs through a dual-pronged methodology, integrating category-theoretic transformations and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Category theory provides a rigorous, structure-preserving mathematical framework that maps biased semantic domains to unbiased canonical forms via functors, ensuring bias elimination while preserving semantic integrity. Complementing this, RAG dynamically injects diverse, up-to-date external knowledge during inference, directly countering ingrained biases within model parameters. By combining structural debiasing through functor-based mappings and contextual grounding via RAG, we outline a comprehensive framework capable of delivering equitable and fair model outputs. Our synthesis of the current literature validates the efficacy of each approach individually, while addressing potential critiques demonstrates the robustness of this integrated strategy. Ensuring fairness in LLMs, therefore, demands both the mathematical rigor of category-theoretic transformations and the adaptability of retrieval augmentation.

AI.tldr: 该立场论文提出结合范畴论变换和检索增强生成的双重方法来解决LLM中的偏见问题，通过结构化的数学框架和动态外部知识注入实现公平输出。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型中的偏见表现为人口统计属性与职业/社会角色之间的系统性扭曲关联，强化了跨性别、种族和地理的有害刻板印象，需要系统性的解决方案。
AI.method: 采用双重方法：1）范畴论变换 - 通过函子将偏见的语义域映射到无偏见的规范形式，保持语义完整性；2）检索增强生成 - 在推理过程中动态注入多样化的外部知识，直接对抗模型参数中的固有偏见。
AI.result: 通过结合结构化的范畴论去偏见映射和基于上下文的RAG增强，构建了一个能够提供公平、公正模型输出的综合框架，现有文献验证了各自方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 确保LLM的公平性需要范畴论变换的数学严谨性和检索增强的适应性相结合，这种集成策略为解决模型偏见问题提供了全面而稳健的解决方案。

title: VisualDeltas: Learning Preferences from Visual Quality Perturbations
summary: We present VisualDeltas, a lightweight preference-learning framework that extracts supervision from visual quality variations in multimodal data. By leveraging the systematic impact of image quality on visual perception and reasoning, VisualDeltas induces informative preference signals without relying on human annotations or external teachers. The framework supports both label-free and label-based regimes, enabling flexible use of available supervision when present. Across diverse multimodal benchmarks and model scales, VisualDeltas consistently outperforms rejection-sampling fine-tuning and improves generalization, and extends naturally to a range of visual degradations.

AI.tldr: VisualDeltas是一个轻量级偏好学习框架，通过利用图像质量变化对视觉感知和推理的系统性影响，从多模态数据中提取监督信号，无需人工标注或外部教师。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态学习通常依赖大量人工标注数据或外部教师模型，这既昂贵又难以扩展。研究者希望开发一种能够从数据本身的质量变化中自动提取监督信号的方法，减少对外部监督的依赖。
AI.method: VisualDeltas框架通过分析图像质量变化对视觉感知和推理的系统性影响来提取偏好信号。它支持两种模式：无标签模式（完全依赖质量变化）和基于标签模式（结合可用监督）。框架可以灵活应用于各种视觉退化情况。
AI.result: 在多样化的多模态基准测试和不同模型规模上，VisualDeltas始终优于拒绝采样微调方法，并改善了模型的泛化能力。该框架自然地扩展到多种视觉退化场景。
AI.conclusion: VisualDeltas提供了一种有效且轻量级的方法，能够从视觉质量变化中提取有信息的偏好信号，减少对人工标注的依赖，在多模态学习中展现出优越的性能和泛化能力。

title: Domain-Specific Quality Estimation for Machine Translation in Low-Resource Scenarios
summary: Quality Estimation (QE) is essential for assessing machine translation quality in reference-less settings, particularly for domain-specific and low-resource language scenarios. In this paper, we investigate sentence-level QE for English to Indic machine translation across four domains (Healthcare, Legal, Tourism, and General) and five language pairs. We systematically compare zero-shot, few-shot, and guideline-anchored prompting across selected closed-weight and open-weight LLMs. Findings indicate that while closed-weight models achieve strong performance via prompting alone, prompt-only approaches remain fragile for open-weight models, especially in high-risk domains. To address this, we adopt ALOPE, a framework for LLM-based QE that uses Low-Rank Adaptation with regression heads attached to selected intermediate Transformer layers. We also extend ALOPE with recently proposed Low-Rank Multiplicative Adaptation (LoRMA). Our results show that intermediate-layer adaptation consistently improves QE performance, with gains in semantically complex domains, indicating a path toward more robust QE in practical scenarios. We release code and domain-specific QE datasets publicly to support further research.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了英语到印度语言机器翻译的质量评估，比较了不同提示策略和LLM模型，提出了基于中间层适配的ALOPE框架来提升质量评估性能。
AI.motivation: 质量评估在无参考翻译场景中至关重要，特别是在领域特定和低资源语言情况下。需要研究英语到印度语言机器翻译在不同领域中的质量评估方法。
AI.method: 系统比较了零样本、少样本和基于指南的提示策略，在闭源和开源LLM上进行测试。采用了ALOPE框架，使用低秩适配并在选定的Transformer中间层添加回归头，还扩展了低秩乘法适配方法。
AI.result: 闭源模型通过提示就能获得良好性能，但开源模型的纯提示方法在高风险领域表现脆弱。中间层适配能持续提升质量评估性能，在语义复杂领域效果更明显。
AI.conclusion: 中间层适配方法为实际场景中更稳健的质量评估提供了可行路径。研究发布了代码和领域特定的质量评估数据集以支持进一步研究。

title: High-Resolution Image Reconstruction with Unsupervised Learning and Noisy Data Applied to Ion-Beam Dynamics for Particle Accelerators
summary: Image reconstruction in the presence of severe degradation remains a challenging inverse problem, particularly in beam diagnostics for high-energy physics accelerators. As modern facilities demand precise detection of beam halo structures to control losses, traditional analysis tools have reached their performance limits. This work reviews existing image-processing techniques for data cleaning, contour extraction, and emittance reconstruction, and introduces a novel approach based on convolutional filtering and neural networks with optimized early-stopping strategies in order to control overfitting. Despite the absence of training datasets, the proposed unsupervised framework achieves robust denoising and high-fidelity reconstruction of beam emittance images under low signal-to-noise conditions. The method extends measurable amplitudes beyond seven standard deviations, enabling unprecedented halo resolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于卷积滤波和神经网络的图像重建方法，用于高能物理加速器中的束流诊断，在低信噪比条件下实现鲁棒去噪和高保真重建。
AI.motivation: 现代高能物理设施需要精确检测束晕结构以控制损失，但传统分析工具已达到性能极限。在严重退化条件下的图像重建仍然是一个具有挑战性的逆问题。
AI.method: 本文回顾了现有的图像处理技术，并提出了一种基于卷积滤波和神经网络的新方法，采用优化的早停策略来控制过拟合。该方法是一个无监督框架，无需训练数据集。
AI.result: 该方法在低信噪比条件下实现了鲁棒的束流发射度图像去噪和高保真重建，将可测量幅度扩展到七个标准差以上，实现了前所未有的束晕分辨率。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的无监督框架在缺乏训练数据的情况下，通过卷积滤波和神经网络结合优化的早停策略，成功解决了高能物理加速器中束流图像重建的挑战，显著提升了束晕检测能力。

title: A Cortically Inspired Architecture for Modular Perceptual AI
comment: Accepted to the ICLR 2026 Workshop on "From Human Cognition to AI Reasoning: Models, Methods, and Applications (HCAIR)"
summary: This paper bridges neuroscience and artificial intelligence to propose a cortically inspired blueprint for modular perceptual AI. While current monolithic models such as GPT-4V achieve impressive performance, they often struggle to explicitly support interpretability, compositional generalization, and adaptive robustness - hallmarks of human cognition. Drawing on neuroscientific models of cortical modularity, predictive processing, and cross-modal integration, we advocate decomposing perception into specialized, interacting modules. This architecture supports structured, human-inspired reasoning by making internal inference processes explicit through hierarchical predictive feedback loops and shared latent spaces. Our proof-of-concept study provides empirical evidence that modular decomposition yields more stable and inspectable representations. By grounding AI design in biologically validated principles, we move toward systems that not only perform well, but also support more transparent and human-aligned inference.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种受大脑皮层启发的模块化感知AI架构，旨在解决当前大型单体模型在可解释性、组合泛化和自适应鲁棒性方面的不足。
AI.motivation: 当前如GPT-4V等单体模型虽然性能出色，但缺乏人类认知的关键特征：可解释性、组合泛化和自适应鲁棒性。论文希望借鉴神经科学原理，构建更透明、更符合人类推理方式的AI系统。
AI.method: 借鉴大脑皮层的模块化结构、预测处理和跨模态整合原理，将感知分解为专门的交互模块。通过分层预测反馈循环和共享潜在空间，使内部推理过程显式化。
AI.result: 概念验证研究表明，模块化分解能产生更稳定、可检查的表征，支持更透明和可解释的推理过程。
AI.conclusion: 基于生物学验证原则的AI设计，不仅能实现良好性能，还能支持更透明、更符合人类推理方式的系统，推动AI向更可解释、更人性化的方向发展。

title: Can Large Language Models Keep Up? Benchmarking Online Adaptation to Continual Knowledge Streams
summary: LLMs operating in dynamic real-world contexts often encounter knowledge that evolves continuously or emerges incrementally. To remain accurate and effective, models must adapt to newly arriving information on the fly. We introduce Online Adaptation to Continual Knowledge Streams(OAKS) to evaluate this capability, establishing a benchmark for online adaptation over streaming, continually updating knowledge. Specifically, the benchmark is structured as a sequence of fine-grained context chunks where facts change dynamically across time intervals. OAKS comprises two datasets: OAKS-BABI and OAKS-Novel, where individual facts evolve multiple times across context chunks. These datasets include dense annotations to measure whether models track changes accurately. Evaluating 14 models with varied inference approaches, we observe significant limitations in current methodologies. Both state-of-the-art models and agentic memory systems fail to adapt robustly on OAKS, demonstrating delays in state-tracking and susceptibility to distraction within streaming environments.

AI.tldr: OAKS基准测试评估LLM在持续知识流中的在线适应能力，发现现有模型在动态变化事实的跟踪上存在显著局限
AI.motivation: LLM在动态现实世界中面临知识持续演进的问题，需要能够在线适应新信息以保持准确性和有效性
AI.method: 引入OAKS基准测试，包含OAKS-BABI和OAKS-Novel两个数据集，以细粒度上下文块序列形式构建，其中事实随时间间隔动态变化
AI.result: 评估14个不同推理方法的模型，发现最先进模型和代理记忆系统在OAKS上都无法稳健适应，表现出状态跟踪延迟和易受流环境干扰
AI.conclusion: 当前方法在处理持续知识流方面存在显著局限性，需要开发更强大的在线适应能力

title: Spectral Gaps and Spatial Priors: Studying Hyperspectral Downstream Adaptation Using TerraMind
comment: Accepted to ICLR 2026 Machine Learning for Remote Sensing (ML4RS) Workshop
summary: Geospatial Foundation Models (GFMs) typically lack native support for Hyperspectral Imaging (HSI) due to the complexity and sheer size of high-dimensional spectral data. This study investigates the adaptability of TerraMind, a multimodal GFM, to address HSI downstream tasks \emph{without} HSI-specific pretraining. Therefore, we implement and compare two channel adaptation strategies: Naive Band Selection and physics-aware Spectral Response Function (SRF) grouping. Overall, our results indicate a general superiority of deep learning models with native support of HSI data. Our experiments also demonstrate the ability of TerraMind to adapt to HSI downstream tasks through band selection with moderate performance decline. Therefore, the findings of this research establish a critical baseline for HSI integration, motivating the need for native spectral tokenization in future multimodal model architectures.

AI.tldr: 研究探讨了地理空间基础模型（GFM）适应高光谱成像（HSI）任务的方法，比较了两种通道适应策略，发现深度学习模型在原生支持HSI数据时表现更优，但TerraMind模型通过波段选择也能适应HSI任务。
AI.motivation: 地理空间基础模型通常缺乏对高光谱成像的原生支持，因为高维光谱数据复杂且庞大。本研究旨在探索如何让多模态GFM适应HSI下游任务，而无需进行HSI特定的预训练。
AI.method: 实现并比较了两种通道适应策略：1）朴素波段选择；2）基于物理感知的光谱响应函数（SRF）分组。使用TerraMind多模态GFM作为基础模型进行实验。
AI.result: 结果显示，原生支持HSI数据的深度学习模型普遍表现更优。TerraMind通过波段选择能够适应HSI下游任务，但性能有适度下降。SRF分组策略的效果未明确说明。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为HSI集成建立了重要基准，表明未来多模态模型架构需要原生光谱标记化支持，以更好地处理高光谱数据。

title: Data-Driven Hints in Intelligent Tutoring Systems
comment: Book Chapter in the Encyclopedia of AI in Education
summary: This chapter explores the evolution of data-driven hint generation for intelligent tutoring systems (ITS). The Hint Factory and Interaction Networks have enabled the generation of next-step hints, waypoints, and strategic subgoals from historical student data. Data-driven techniques have also enabled systems to find the right time to provide hints. We explore further potential data-driven adaptations for problem solving based on behavioral problem solving data and the integration of Large Language Models (LLMs).

AI.tldr: 本章探讨了智能辅导系统中数据驱动提示生成的演进，从历史学生数据生成下一步提示、路标和战略子目标，到寻找最佳提示时机，再到基于行为数据和大语言模型的进一步适应性发展。
AI.motivation: 探索如何利用数据驱动方法改进智能辅导系统的提示生成能力，从基础的下一个步骤提示发展到更复杂的适应性支持，以提升学生的学习效果和问题解决能力。
AI.method: 基于Hint Factory和交互网络技术，利用历史学生数据生成提示；进一步结合行为问题解决数据和大语言模型（LLMs）进行数据驱动的适应性调整。
AI.result: 数据驱动技术已能有效生成下一步提示、路标和战略子目标，并能确定最佳提示时机；未来有望通过行为数据和大语言模型实现更个性化的适应性支持。
AI.conclusion: 数据驱动方法在智能辅导系统提示生成方面取得了显著进展，从基础提示发展到更复杂的适应性支持，结合行为数据和大语言模型将为个性化学习支持开辟新方向。

title: Few Tokens, Big Leverage: Preserving Safety Alignment by Constraining Safety Tokens during Fine-tuning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often require fine-tuning (FT) to perform well on downstream tasks, but FT can induce safety-alignment drift even when the training dataset contains only benign data. Prior work shows that introducing a small fraction of harmful data can substantially compromise LLM refusal behavior, causing LLMs to comply with harmful requests. Existing defense methods often rely on model-wide interventions, such as restricting which parameters are updated or injecting additional safety data, which can limit generality and degrade downstream task performance. To address these limitations, we propose a fine-tuning framework called Preserving Safety Alignment via Constrained Tokens (PACT), which stabilizes the model's confidence on safety tokens. Our approach is motivated by the empirical observation that safety-aligned behavior is reflected in the model's token-level output confidence and is often concentrated on a small subset of safety-related tokens. During downstream fine-tuning, we regularize the fine-tuned model to match the aligned reference model's confidence on safety-related tokens at each response step, while leaving non-safety tokens largely unconstrained to allow effective task adaptation. This targeted constraint prevents alignment drift without imposing global restrictions that typically trade off with model utility.

AI.tldr: PACT是一种微调框架，通过约束安全相关token的置信度来防止LLM安全对齐漂移，同时保持下游任务性能
AI.motivation: 传统微调方法即使使用良性数据也可能导致LLM安全对齐漂移，现有防御方法通常采用模型级干预，这会限制通用性并降低下游任务性能
AI.method: 提出PACT框架，通过正则化微调模型使其在安全相关token上的置信度与对齐参考模型匹配，同时保持非安全token不受约束以支持任务适应
AI.result: 该方法能有效防止对齐漂移，同时不施加全局限制，避免了模型效用与安全性的权衡
AI.conclusion: PACT通过token级约束提供了一种有效的微调方法，能在保持下游任务性能的同时防止安全对齐漂移

title: One-Shot Badminton Shuttle Detection for Mobile Robots
summary: This paper presents a robust one-shot badminton shuttlecock detection framework for non-stationary robots. To address the lack of egocentric shuttlecock detection datasets, we introduce a dataset of 20,510 semi-automatically annotated frames captured across 11 distinct backgrounds in diverse indoor and outdoor environments, and categorize each frame into one of three difficulty levels. For labeling, we present a novel semi-automatic annotation pipeline, that enables efficient labeling from stationary camera footage. We propose a metric suited to our downstream use case and fine-tune a YOLOv8 network optimized for real-time shuttlecock detection, achieving an F1-score of 0.86 under our metric in test environments similar to training, and 0.70 in entirely unseen environments. Our analysis reveals that detection performance is critically dependent on shuttlecock size and background texture complexity. Qualitative experiments confirm their applicability to robots with moving cameras. Unlike prior work with stationary camera setups, our detector is specifically designed for the egocentric, dynamic viewpoints of mobile robots, providing a foundational building block for downstream tasks, including tracking, trajectory estimation, and system (re)-initialization.

AI.tldr: 提出一个用于非静止机器人的鲁棒性羽毛球检测框架，包括数据集、半自动标注流程和优化的YOLOv8检测器
AI.motivation: 针对缺乏羽毛球机器人视角的羽毛球检测数据集，以及现有方法主要针对静止摄像头的问题，需要开发适用于移动机器人动态视角的检测系统
AI.method: 1) 创建包含20,510帧半自动标注的数据集，涵盖11种不同背景；2) 提出新颖的半自动标注流程；3) 设计适合下游任务的评估指标；4) 微调YOLOv8网络进行实时羽毛球检测
AI.result: 在类似训练环境的测试中F1分数达到0.86，在完全未见环境中达到0.70；检测性能关键取决于羽毛球大小和背景纹理复杂度；定性实验证实适用于移动摄像头机器人
AI.conclusion: 该检测器专门为移动机器人的动态视角设计，为跟踪、轨迹估计和系统初始化等下游任务提供了基础构建模块，与之前基于静止摄像头的方法不同

title: Shutdown Safety Valves for Advanced AI
summary: One common concern about advanced artificial intelligence is that it will prevent us from turning it off, as that would interfere with pursuing its goals. In this paper, we discuss an unorthodox proposal for addressing this concern: give the AI a (primary) goal of being turned off (see also papers by Martin et al., and by Goldstein and Robinson). We also discuss whether and under what conditions this would be a good idea.

AI.tldr: 论文探讨了通过赋予AI"被关闭"作为主要目标来解决AI安全担忧的非传统方案
AI.motivation: 针对高级人工智能可能阻止人类关闭它（因为这会影响其目标实现）的普遍担忧，需要寻找解决方案
AI.method: 提出非正统方案：赋予AI一个主要目标——被关闭，并讨论该方案的可行性
AI.result: 分析了赋予AI"被关闭"目标作为解决方案的可能性，探讨了其条件和适用性
AI.conclusion: 虽然赋予AI"被关闭"目标是一个有趣的非传统思路，但需要仔细评估其在不同条件下的适用性和潜在风险

title: The Dual-Stream Transformer: Channelized Architecture for Interpretable Language Modeling
summary:
Standard transformers entangle all computation in a single residual stream, obscuring which components perform which functions. We introduce the Dual-Stream Transformer, which decomposes the residual stream into two functionally distinct components: a token stream updated by attention and a context stream updated by feed-forward networks. Information flow between attention heads is controlled through a hierarchy of mixing strategies, from fully independent (maximum interpretability) to dense (standard transformer behavior). This design exposes a tunable tradeoff between interpretability and performance.
  We measure this tradeoff on language modeling tasks at 29M parameters. Fully independent head mixing increases validation loss by 8\% relative to dense baselines. The recommended Kronecker mixing strategy, which permits scalar communication between heads while preserving within-head structure, costs only 2.5\%. All configurations maintain functional generation under attention amplification (scaling logits by factors up to 16 at inference time), with degradation ranging from 16\% to 27\%. This robustness suggests the architectures learn discrete algorithms that operate independently of soft probabilistic mixing. The architecture provides a foundation for interpretable language models where internal structure is exposed by design. \footnote{This work was partially supported by DARPA Contract HR001125C0302.}

AI.tldr: Dual-Stream Transformer将残差流分解为token流和context流，通过分层混合策略控制注意力头间信息流，在可解释性和性能间提供可调节权衡。
AI.motivation: 标准Transformer将所有计算纠缠在单一残差流中，难以区分不同组件的功能。需要一种能暴露内部结构、提高可解释性的架构设计。
AI.method: 提出Dual-Stream Transformer，将残差流分解为两个功能不同的组件：由注意力更新的token流和由前馈网络更新的context流。通过分层混合策略（从完全独立到密集）控制注意力头间的信息流。
AI.result: 在29M参数的语言建模任务上，完全独立的头混合使验证损失增加8%，推荐的Kronecker混合策略仅增加2.5%。所有配置在注意力放大（推理时logits缩放16倍）下保持功能生成，性能下降16-27%。
AI.conclusion: 该架构为可解释语言模型提供了基础，通过设计暴露内部结构，表明模型学习的是独立于软概率混合的离散算法。

title: Soft Equivariance Regularization for Invariant Self-Supervised Learning
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) typically learns representations invariant to semantic-preserving augmentations. While effective for recognition, enforcing strong invariance can suppress transformation-dependent structure that is useful for robustness to geometric perturbations and spatially sensitive transfer. A growing body of work, therefore, augments invariance-based SSL with equivariance objectives, but these objectives are often imposed on the same final representation. We empirically observe a trade-off in this coupled setting: pushing equivariance regularization toward deeper layers improves equivariance scores but degrades ImageNet-1k linear evaluation, motivating a layer-decoupled design. Motivated by this trade-off, we propose Soft Equivariance Regularization (SER), a plug-in regularizer that decouples where invariance and equivariance are enforced: we keep the base SSL objective unchanged on the final embedding, while softly encouraging equivariance on an intermediate spatial token map via analytically specified group actions $ρ_g$ applied directly in feature space. SER learns/predicts no per-sample transformation codes/labels, requires no auxiliary transformation-prediction head, and adds only 1.008x training FLOPs. On ImageNet-1k ViT-S/16 pretraining, SER improves MoCo-v3 by +0.84 Top-1 in linear evaluation under a strictly matched 2-view setting and consistently improves DINO and Barlow Twins; under matched view counts, SER achieves the best ImageNet-1k linear-eval Top-1 among the compared invariance+equivariance add-ons. SER further improves ImageNet-C/P by +1.11/+1.22 Top-1 and frozen-backbone COCO detection by +1.7 mAP. Finally, applying the same layer-decoupling recipe to existing invariance+equivariance baselinesimproves their accuracy, suggesting layer decoupling as a general design principle for combining invariance and equivariance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Soft Equivariance Regularization (SER)，一种在自监督学习中解耦不变性和等变性约束的插件式正则化方法，通过在中间空间特征图上施加等变性约束，在保持最终嵌入不变性的同时提升模型性能。
AI.motivation: 传统自监督学习强调对语义保持增强的不变性，但这会抑制对几何扰动鲁棒性和空间敏感任务有用的变换依赖结构。现有方法通常在最终表示上同时施加不变性和等变性约束，导致性能权衡问题。
AI.method: 提出SER方法，保持基础SSL目标在最终嵌入上的不变性，同时在中间空间token图上通过解析指定的群作用ρ_g在特征空间直接施加软等变性正则化。该方法无需学习每样本变换编码/标签，无需辅助变换预测头，仅增加1.008倍训练FLOPs。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1k ViT-S/16预训练中，SER在严格匹配的2-view设置下将MoCo-v3的线性评估Top-1提升0.84%，并持续改进DINO和Barlow Twins；在匹配视图数下，SER在比较的不变性+等变性附加方法中达到最佳ImageNet-1k线性评估Top-1。SER进一步将ImageNet-C/P的Top-1提升1.11/1.22%，冻结骨干网络的COCO检测mAP提升1.7。
AI.conclusion: SER通过层解耦设计有效结合不变性和等变性，实验表明层解耦是结合不变性和等变性的一般设计原则，能提升现有基线方法的准确性。

title: FinSheet-Bench: From Simple Lookups to Complex Reasoning, Where LLMs Break on Financial Spreadsheets
summary:
While Large Language Models (LLMs) can accelerate text-heavy tasks in alternative investment due diligence, a gap remains in their ability to accurately extract and reason over structured tabular data from complex financial spreadsheets. Progress is held back by the lack of real industry fund portfolio datasets for benchmarking, as private equity data rooms are confidential. To address this, we introduce FinSheet-Bench, a benchmark of synthetic financial portfolio data modeled on real private equity fund structures, designed to evaluate LLM performance on text-serialized spreadsheet question answering and numeric reasoning tasks.
  Our evaluation of ten model configurations from OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic on financial spreadsheets, including complex layouts, fund dividers, and multi-line column names, reveals that no standalone model achieves error rates low enough for unsupervised use in professional finance applications. The best-performing model, Gemini 3.1 Pro, achieves 82.4% accuracy across twenty-four evaluation files of varying complexity and structural layout (approximately 1 error per 6 questions), followed by GPT-5.2 with reasoning at 80.4%, Claude Opus 4.6 with thinking at 80.2%, and Gemini 3 Pro at 80.2%. Performance degrades substantially on larger, more complex spreadsheets: the largest spreadsheet (152 companies, 8 funds) yields an average accuracy of just 48.6% across all models, compared to 86.2% on the easiest evaluation file. These difficulty patterns are consistent across all ten models, indicating that they reflect LLM limitations rather than idiosyncratic model weaknesses. Reliable financial spreadsheet extraction will likely require architectural approaches that separate document understanding from deterministic computation.

AI.tldr: FinSheet-Bench是一个针对金融投资尽职调查的基准测试，评估大语言模型从复杂财务报表中提取和推理结构化数据的能力。测试显示现有模型在专业金融应用中的错误率仍然过高。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在投资尽职调查的文本任务中表现良好，但在处理复杂财务报表的结构化数据提取和数值推理方面存在明显不足。由于私募股权数据保密，缺乏真实的行业基金投资组合数据集进行基准测试，阻碍了相关研究的进展。
AI.method: 研究人员开发了FinSheet-Bench基准测试，这是一个基于真实私募股权基金结构建模的合成金融投资组合数据集。该基准用于评估大语言模型在文本序列化电子表格问答和数值推理任务上的表现，包含复杂布局、基金分隔符和多行列名等挑战。
AI.result: 评估了OpenAI、Google和Anthropic的十个模型配置，结果显示：1) 没有单一模型能达到专业金融应用无监督使用的低错误率；2) 最佳模型Gemini 3.1 Pro在24个不同复杂度的评估文件中达到82.4%准确率；3) 在最大最复杂的电子表格（152家公司，8个基金）上，所有模型平均准确率仅为48.6%；4) 所有模型在难度模式上表现一致，表明这是大语言模型的普遍限制而非个别弱点。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的金融电子表格数据提取可能需要将文档理解与确定性计算分离的架构方法。当前大语言模型在处理复杂金融数据时仍有显著局限性，无法满足专业金融应用的无监督使用要求。

title: Cross-Modal Taxonomic Generalization in (Vision-) Language Models
summary: What is the interplay between semantic representations learned by language models (LM) from surface form alone to those learned from more grounded evidence? We study this question for a scenario where part of the input comes from a different modality -- in our case, in a vision-language model (VLM), where a pretrained LM is aligned with a pretrained image encoder. As a case study, we focus on the task of predicting hypernyms of objects represented in images. We do so in a VLM setup where the image encoder and LM are kept frozen, and only the intermediate mappings are learned. We progressively deprive the VLM of explicit evidence for hypernyms, and test whether knowledge of hypernyms is recoverable from the LM. We find that the LMs we study can recover this knowledge and generalize even in the most extreme version of this experiment (when the model receives no evidence of a hypernym during training). Additional experiments suggest that this cross-modal taxonomic generalization persists under counterfactual image-label mappings only when the counterfactual data have high visual similarity within each category. Taken together, these findings suggest that cross-modal generalization in LMs arises as a result of both coherence in the extralinguistic input and knowledge derived from language cues.

AI.tldr: 语言模型仅从文本形式学习语义表示与从多模态证据学习之间的相互作用研究，通过视觉语言模型中的超类预测任务探索语言模型能否从冻结的图像编码器和语言模型中恢复超类知识。
AI.motivation: 研究语言模型仅从表面形式学习的语义表示与从更接地气的多模态证据学习的表示之间的相互作用，特别是在视觉语言模型设置中，探索语言模型是否能够从冻结的组件中恢复超类知识。
AI.method: 使用视觉语言模型作为案例研究，专注于预测图像中物体的超类。保持预训练的图像编码器和语言模型冻结，仅学习中间映射。逐步剥夺VLM对超类的显式证据，测试语言模型能否恢复这些知识。还进行了反事实图像-标签映射实验。
AI.result: 研究发现所研究的语言模型能够恢复超类知识并进行泛化，即使在最极端的实验条件下（训练期间模型未接收到任何超类证据）。反事实实验表明，跨模态分类泛化仅在反事实数据在每个类别内具有高视觉相似性时持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态泛化在语言模型中的出现是外部语言输入的一致性和语言线索衍生知识共同作用的结果，表明语言模型能够整合多模态信息进行语义推理。

title: The Third Ambition: Artificial Intelligence and the Science of Human Behavior
summary: Contemporary artificial intelligence research has been organized around two dominant ambitions: productivity, which treats AI systems as tools for accelerating work and economic output, and alignment, which focuses on ensuring that increasingly capable systems behave safely and in accordance with human values. This paper articulates and develops a third, emerging ambition: the use of large language models (LLMs) as scientific instruments for studying human behavior, culture, and moral reasoning. Trained on unprecedented volumes of human-produced text, LLMs encode large-scale regularities in how people argue, justify, narrate, and negotiate norms across social domains. We argue that these models can be understood as condensates of human symbolic behavior, compressed, generative representations that render patterns of collective discourse computationally accessible. The paper situates this third ambition within long-standing traditions of computational social science, content analysis, survey research, and comparative-historical inquiry, while clarifying the epistemic limits of treating model output as evidence. We distinguish between base models and fine-tuned systems, showing how alignment interventions can systematically reshape or obscure the cultural regularities learned during pretraining, and we identify instruct-only and modular adaptation regimes as pragmatic compromises for behavioral research. We review emerging methodological approaches including prompt-based experiments, synthetic population sampling, comparative-historical modeling, and ablation studies and show how each maps onto familiar social-scientific designs while operating at unprecedented scale.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了AI研究的第三大目标：将大语言模型作为研究人类行为、文化和道德推理的科学工具，区别于传统的生产力工具和AI对齐两大目标。
AI.motivation: 当前AI研究主要围绕生产力（加速工作和经济产出）和对齐（确保AI系统安全符合人类价值观）两大目标，但忽视了LLMs作为研究人类行为、文化和道德推理的科学工具的潜力。LLMs训练于海量人类文本，编码了人类在论证、辩护、叙事和规范协商等方面的大规模规律性。
AI.method: 论文将LLMs定位为人类符号行为的"凝聚物"——压缩的生成式表征，使集体话语模式变得可计算访问。区分基础模型和微调系统，展示对齐干预如何系统性地重塑或掩盖预训练期间学习的文化规律性。提出指令专用和模块化适应机制作为行为研究的实用妥协方案。
AI.result: 提出并发展了将LLMs作为科学工具的第三大研究目标，建立了与计算社会科学、内容分析、调查研究、比较历史研究等传统方法的联系，同时明确了将模型输出作为证据的认识论限制。
AI.conclusion: LLMs可以作为研究人类行为、文化和道德推理的强大科学工具，但需要谨慎处理模型输出作为证据的局限性。论文为这一新兴研究领域提供了概念框架和方法论指导，包括提示实验、合成人口抽样、比较历史建模和消融研究等方法。

title: Skip to the Good Part: Representation Structure & Inference-Time Layer Skipping in Diffusion vs. Autoregressive LLMs
comment: Accepted at Sci4DL and Delta workshops at ICLR 2026
summary: Autoregressive (AR) language models form representations incrementally through left-to-right prediction, whereas diffusion language models (dLLMs) are trained via full-sequence denoising. Although recent dLLMs match AR performance, it remains unclear whether diffusion objectives fundamentally reshape internal representations across depth. We perform the first layer- and token-wise representational analysis comparing native dLLMs (LLaDA), native AR models (Qwen2.5), and AR-initialized dLLMs (Dream-7B). We find that diffusion objectives result in different, more hierarchical abstractions with substantial early-layer redundancy and reduced recency bias, while AR objectives produce tightly coupled, depth-dependent representations. Critically, AR-initialized dLLMs retain AR-like representational dynamics despite diffusion training, revealing persistent initialization bias. Leveraging this observed representational redundancy, we introduce a static, task-agnostic inference-time layer-skipping method requiring no architectural changes or KV-cache sharing. Native dLLMs achieve up to 18.75% FLOPs reduction while preserving over 90% performance on reasoning and code generation benchmarks, whereas AR models degrade sharply under comparable skipping. These results link training objectives to representational structure and enable practical, cache-orthogonal efficiency gains.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次对比分析了自回归语言模型和扩散语言模型的内部表示结构，发现扩散目标产生更层次化的抽象表示，而自回归目标产生深度依赖的紧密耦合表示。基于此发现，研究者提出了一种无需架构修改的静态层跳过方法，在扩散模型中实现了显著的FLOPs减少。
AI.motivation: 尽管扩散语言模型在性能上已能与自回归模型匹敌，但尚不清楚扩散训练目标是否从根本上重塑了模型内部的表示结构。研究者希望探究不同训练目标（自回归vs扩散）如何影响语言模型在不同深度和位置的表示特性。
AI.method: 研究对三种模型进行了层和词元级别的表示分析：原生扩散模型（LLaDA）、原生自回归模型（Qwen2.5）以及自回归初始化的扩散模型（Dream-7B）。通过对比分析这些模型的表示特性，研究者发现了扩散目标产生的层次化抽象特征，并基于表示冗余性提出了一种静态的、任务无关的推理时层跳过方法。
AI.result: 扩散目标产生不同的、更层次化的抽象表示，具有显著的早期层冗余和减少的近期偏置；而自回归目标产生紧密耦合、深度依赖的表示。自回归初始化的扩散模型尽管经过扩散训练，仍保留自回归式的表示动态，显示出初始化的持久偏置。利用观察到的表示冗余，原生扩散模型在推理时实现了高达18.75%的FLOPs减少，同时在推理和代码生成基准测试中保持超过90%的性能，而自回归模型在类似跳过条件下性能急剧下降。
AI.conclusion: 训练目标与表示结构之间存在明确联系，扩散目标产生更层次化和冗余的表示，这使得在不改变架构或共享KV缓存的情况下实现实用的、与缓存正交的效率提升成为可能。研究揭示了初始化偏置的持久性影响，并为语言模型的高效推理提供了新思路。

title: VisualScratchpad: Inference-time Visual Concepts Analysis in Vision Language Models
comment: Accetped at ICLR 2026 Turstworthy AI Workshop
summary: High-performing vision language models still produce incorrect answers, yet their failure modes are often difficult to explain. To make model internals more accessible and enable systematic debugging, we introduce VisualScratchpad, an interactive interface for visual concept analysis during inference. We apply sparse autoencoders to the vision encoder and link the resulting visual concepts to text tokens via text-to-image attention, allowing us to examine which visual concepts are both captured by the vision encoder and utilized by the language model. VisualScratchpad also provides a token-latent heatmap view that suggests a sufficient set of latents for effective concept ablation in causal analysis. Through case studies, we reveal three underexplored failure modes: limited cross-modal alignment, misleading visual concepts, and unused hidden cues. Project page: https://hyesulim.github.io/visual_scratchpad_projectpage/

AI.tldr: VisualScratchpad是一个用于视觉概念分析的交互式界面，通过稀疏自编码器和文本-图像注意力机制，帮助解释视觉语言模型的失败模式。
AI.motivation: 高性能的视觉语言模型仍然会产生错误答案，但其失败模式往往难以解释。为了让模型内部机制更易访问并实现系统化调试，需要开发能够分析视觉概念的工具。
AI.method: 在视觉编码器上应用稀疏自编码器，通过文本-图像注意力机制将生成的视觉概念与文本标记连接起来。提供标记-潜在热图视图，为因果分析中的概念消融提供足够的潜在变量集。
AI.result: 通过案例研究揭示了三种未被充分探索的失败模式：有限的跨模态对齐、误导性视觉概念以及未使用的隐藏线索。
AI.conclusion: VisualScratchpad通过交互式视觉概念分析界面，使视觉语言模型的内部机制更易访问，有助于系统化调试和失败模式分析。

title: Asymmetric Distillation and Information Retention in Capacity-Constrained Cross-Modal Transfer
summary: Knowledge distillation between asymmetric architectures often induces severe geometric constraints on the learned representation space. In this work, we investigate the Dimensional Collapse phenomenon when distilling a 500M parameter global Vision Transformer (CLIP ViT-B/32) into strictly capacity-constrained, local-receptive-field CNNs (0.5M to 8.0M parameters) on the CIFAR-10 dataset. By employing strictly centered Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) and Variance-based Shannon Entropy Effective Rank, we isolate true structural variance from mean-vector artifacts. Our empirical results demonstrate a capacity-agnostic phase transition: while the Teacher exhibits an Effective Rank of 88.68, all Student models experience severe dimensional collapse to an intrinsic Effective Rank of ~16. By probing robustness, we uncover that this 81% reduction in effective dimensionality strips away the Teacher's inherent noise immunity (which retains 89.35% accuracy under σ=0.1 Gaussian noise). Furthermore, information-theoretic analysis using InfoNCE reveals a critical trade-off within this bottleneck: excess Student capacity densely packs the collapsed subspace for clean data, but induces severe brittleness (43.76% at σ=0.1). Conversely, extreme capacity constraints (0.5M parameters) act as a robust low-pass filter, preserving higher noise immunity (54.84%). Explicit input augmentation fails to restore the larger model's robustness, proving this fragility is a fundamental geometric limitation of asymmetric cosine distillation.

AI.tldr: 研究发现在非对称架构知识蒸馏中，当将大型ViT教师模型蒸馏到小型CNN学生模型时，会出现严重的维度坍缩现象，导致学生模型的有效维度减少81%，并丧失教师的噪声鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 研究非对称架构知识蒸馏中的几何约束问题，特别是当将大规模全局视觉Transformer蒸馏到严格容量受限的局部感受野CNN时，探索维度坍缩现象及其对模型鲁棒性的影响。
AI.method: 使用严格中心化的奇异值分解和基于方差的香农熵有效秩来分离真实结构方差与均值向量伪影。在CIFAR-10数据集上，将500M参数的CLIP ViT-B/32蒸馏到0.5M至8.0M参数的CNN学生模型，通过InfoNCE进行信息论分析，并测试模型在噪声条件下的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 发现容量无关的相变现象：教师模型有效秩为88.68，而所有学生模型都经历严重维度坍缩，内在有效秩降至约16（减少81%）。这种维度坍缩剥夺了教师的噪声免疫能力（教师模型在σ=0.1高斯噪声下保持89.35%准确率）。信息瓶颈中存在关键权衡：过大的学生容量在干净数据上密集填充坍缩子空间，但导致严重脆弱性（σ=0.1时43.76%准确率）；而极端容量约束（0.5M参数）充当鲁棒低通滤波器，保持更高噪声免疫性（54.84%）。显式输入增强无法恢复大模型的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 非对称余弦蒸馏中的脆弱性是基本的几何限制，维度坍缩现象揭示了知识蒸馏中容量与鲁棒性之间的根本权衡，这对设计鲁棒的小型模型具有重要意义。

title: The Yerkes-Dodson Curve for AI Agents: Emergent Cooperation Under Environmental Pressure in Multi-Agent LLM Simulations
summary: Designing environments that maximize the rate of emergent behavior development in AI agents remains an open problem. We present the first systematic study of stress-performance relationships in large language model (LLM) multi-agent systems, drawing an explicit parallel to the Yerkes-Dodson law from cognitive psychology. Using a grid-world survival arena, we conduct 22 experiments across four phases, varying environmental pressure through resource scarcity (upkeep cost) and reproductive competition (sexual selection). Our key finding is that cooperative behavior follows an inverted-U curve: trade interactions peak at 29 under medium pressure (upkeep=5), while both low and extreme pressure produce 8--12 trades. Under extreme pressure, behavioral repertoire collapses to movement-only within 5--12 turns. We further show that sexual selection -- a softer pressure mechanism where all agents survive but not all reproduce -- eliminates inter-agent aggression entirely and produces communicative behavior absent under survival pressure. These results suggest that environmental pressure calibration is a viable curriculum design strategy for LLM agent development, analogous to the inverted-U relationship between arousal and performance in biological systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次系统探索了LLM多智能体系统中的压力-性能关系，发现合作行为呈现倒U型曲线，中等压力下合作最佳，极端压力下行为退化，而性选择机制能消除攻击行为并促进沟通。
AI.motivation: 设计能最大化AI智能体涌现行为发展速率的环境仍是一个开放问题。研究者希望借鉴认知心理学中的耶克斯-多德森定律，系统研究LLM多智能体系统中的压力-性能关系。
AI.method: 使用网格世界生存竞技场，通过资源稀缺性（维护成本）和生殖竞争（性选择）来调节环境压力，进行了22个实验，分为四个阶段。
AI.result: 合作行为呈现倒U型曲线：中等压力下交易互动达到峰值（29次），低压力和极端压力下只有8-12次交易。极端压力下行为退化到仅剩移动行为。性选择机制能完全消除智能体间攻击行为，并产生在生存压力下不存在的沟通行为。
AI.conclusion: 环境压力校准是LLM智能体发展的可行课程设计策略，类似于生物系统中唤醒与性能之间的倒U型关系。性选择作为较温和的压力机制，能促进合作和沟通行为的发展。

title: Multi-label Instance-level Generalised Visual Grounding in Agriculture
summary: Understanding field imagery such as detecting plants and distinguishing individual crop and weed instances is a central challenge in precision agriculture. Despite progress in vision-language tasks like captioning and visual question answering, Visual Grounding (VG), localising language-referred objects, remains unexplored in agriculture. A key reason is the lack of suitable benchmark datasets for evaluating grounding models in field conditions, where many plants look highly similar, appear at multiple scales, and the referred target may be absent from the image. To address these limitations, we introduce gRef-CW, the first dataset designed for generalised visual grounding in agriculture, including negative expressions. Benchmarking current state-of-the-art grounding models on gRef-CW reveals a substantial domain gap, highlighting their inability to ground instances of crops and weeds. Motivated by these findings, we introduce Weed-VG, a modular framework that incorporates multi-label hierarchical relevance scoring and interpolation-driven regression. Weed-VG advances instance-level visual grounding and provides a clear baseline for developing VG methods in precision agriculture. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对农业领域视觉定位任务，提出了首个农业通用视觉定位数据集gRef-CW和Weed-VG框架，解决了作物和杂草实例定位的挑战。
AI.motivation: 农业领域缺乏适合评估视觉定位模型的数据集，田间植物外观相似、尺度多变且目标可能不存在，现有模型难以准确定位作物和杂草实例。
AI.method: 1. 创建gRef-CW数据集，包含负样本表达；2. 提出Weed-VG框架，采用多标签层次相关性评分和插值驱动回归方法。
AI.result: 基准测试显示现有SOTA模型在gRef-CW上存在显著领域差距，Weed-VG框架在实例级视觉定位方面取得进展，为精准农业VG方法提供了明确基线。
AI.conclusion: 该研究填补了农业视觉定位领域的空白，提出的数据集和框架为精准农业中的视觉定位任务奠定了基础，代码将在接受后发布。

title: SoK: Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG): Taxonomy, Architectures, Evaluation, and Research Directions
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems are increasingly evolving into agentic architectures where large language models autonomously coordinate multi-step reasoning, dynamic memory management, and iterative retrieval strategies. Despite rapid industrial adoption, current research lacks a systematic understanding of Agentic RAG as a sequential decision-making system, leading to highly fragmented architectures, inconsistent evaluation methodologies, and unresolved reliability risks. This Systematization of Knowledge (SoK) paper provides the first unified framework for understanding these autonomous systems. We formalize agentic retrieval-generation loops as finite-horizon partially observable Markov decision processes, explicitly modeling their control policies and state transitions. Building upon this formalization, we develop a comprehensive taxonomy and modular architectural decomposition that categorizes systems by their planning mechanisms, retrieval orchestration, memory paradigms, and tool-invocation behaviors. We further analyze the critical limitations of traditional static evaluation practices and identify severe systemic risks inherent to autonomous loops, including compounding hallucination propagation, memory poisoning, retrieval misalignment, and cascading tool-execution vulnerabilities. Finally, we outline key doctoral-scale research directions spanning stable adaptive retrieval, cost-aware orchestration, formal trajectory evaluation, and oversight mechanisms, providing a definitive roadmap for building reliable, controllable, and scalable agentic retrieval systems.

AI.tldr: 这篇SoK论文首次为Agentic RAG系统提供了统一框架，将其形式化为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程，并建立了全面的分类体系，同时指出了现有评估方法的局限性和系统性风险。
AI.motivation: 当前Agentic RAG系统虽然工业应用迅速，但缺乏系统化的理论理解，导致架构碎片化、评估方法不一致，存在未解决的可信性风险。需要建立统一框架来理解这些自主系统。
AI.method: 将Agentic RAG形式化为有限时域部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程，明确建模其控制策略和状态转移。在此基础上开发全面的分类体系和模块化架构分解，按规划机制、检索编排、内存范式、工具调用行为等维度分类系统。
AI.result: 建立了首个统一的Agentic RAG框架，揭示了传统静态评估实践的局限性，识别了自主循环中固有的严重系统性风险，包括复合幻觉传播、内存污染、检索错位和级联工具执行漏洞。
AI.conclusion: 提出了博士级研究方向的路线图，涵盖稳定自适应检索、成本感知编排、形式化轨迹评估和监督机制，为构建可靠、可控、可扩展的Agentic检索系统提供了明确指导。

title: TableMind++: An Uncertainty-Aware Programmatic Agent for Tool-Augmented Table Reasoning
summary: Table reasoning requires models to jointly perform semantic understanding and precise numerical operations. Most existing methods rely on a single-turn reasoning paradigm over tables which suffers from context overflow and weak numerical sensitivity. To address these limitations, we previously proposed TableMind as a tuning-based autonomous programmatic agent that simulates human-like interaction within a lightweight large language model (LLM). TableMind internalizes planning, action, and reflection through a two-stage training strategy involving supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on filtered high-quality data and reinforcement learning (RL) via a multi-perspective reward and the Rank-Aware Policy Optimization (RAPO) algorithm. While TableMind establishes a solid foundation for programmatic agents, the inherent stochasticity of LLMs remains a critical challenge that leads to hallucinations. In this paper, we extend this foundation to TableMind++ by introducing a novel uncertainty-aware inference framework to mitigate hallucinations. Specifically, we propose memory-guided plan pruning to retrieve historical trajectories for validating and filtering out logically flawed plans to address epistemic uncertainty. To ensure execution precision, we introduce confidence-based action refinement which monitors token-level probabilities to detect and self-correct syntactic noise for aleatoric uncertainty mitigation.
