summary: LLM agents that retrieve external knowledge typically generate a search query as text, then run a separate embedding model to encode it into a vector. This two-model pipeline adds infrastructure complexity and latency, yet is redundant: the LLM already encodes the full conversational context in its hidden states. We propose equipping LLM agents with native retrieval capability by adding a lightweight projection head that maps hidden states directly into the embedding space, eliminating the need for a separate embedding model. Trained with a combination of alignment, contrastive, and rank distillation losses, our method retains 97\% of baseline retrieval quality while enabling the LLM agent to search with its own representations. Experiments on the QReCC conversational search benchmark show competitive Recall@10 and MRR@10 compared to the standard generate-then-encode pipeline, with systematic ablations confirming the contribution of each loss component.

AI.tldr: 提出让LLM代理具备原生检索能力的方法，通过添加轻量级投影头将隐藏状态直接映射到嵌入空间，无需单独嵌入模型，在保持97%检索质量的同时降低复杂性和延迟。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM代理检索外部知识时通常需要生成搜索查询文本，然后运行单独的嵌入模型将其编码为向量。这种两模型管道增加了基础设施复杂性和延迟，但实际上是冗余的，因为LLM已经在隐藏状态中编码了完整的对话上下文。
AI.method: 为LLM代理添加轻量级投影头，将隐藏状态直接映射到嵌入空间，通过结合对齐损失、对比损失和排名蒸馏损失进行训练，使LLM能够使用自身表示进行搜索。
AI.result: 在QReCC对话搜索基准测试中，该方法保持了97%的基线检索质量，Recall@10和MRR@10指标与标准的生成-编码管道相比具有竞争力，系统消融实验证实了每个损失组件的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 通过为LLM代理添加原生检索能力，可以消除对单独嵌入模型的需求，降低系统复杂性和延迟，同时保持高质量的检索性能，为LLM代理架构提供了更高效的解决方案。

title: ACD-U: Asymmetric co-teaching with machine unlearning for robust learning with noisy labels
summary: Deep neural networks are prone to memorizing incorrect labels during training, which degrades their generalizability. Although recent methods have combined sample selection with semi-supervised learning (SSL) to exploit the memorization effect -- where networks learn from clean data before noisy data -- they cannot correct selection errors once a sample is misclassified. To overcome this, we propose asymmetric co-teaching with different architectures (ACD)-U, an asymmetric co-teaching framework that uses different model architectures and incorporates machine unlearning. ACD-U addresses this limitation through two core mechanisms. First, its asymmetric co-teaching pairs a contrastive language-image pretraining (CLIP)-pretrained vision Transformer with a convolutional neural network (CNN), leveraging their complementary learning behaviors: the pretrained model provides stable predictions, whereas the CNN adapts throughout training. This asymmetry, where the vision Transformer is trained only on clean samples and the CNN is trained through SSL, effectively mitigates confirmation bias. Second, selective unlearning enables post-hoc error correction by identifying incorrectly memorized samples through loss trajectory analysis and CLIP consistency checks, and then removing their influence via Kullback--Leibler divergence-based forgetting. This approach shifts the learning paradigm from passive error avoidance to active error correction. Experiments on synthetic and real-world noisy datasets, including CIFAR-10/100, CIFAR-N, WebVision, Clothing1M, and Red Mini-ImageNet, demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, particularly in high-noise regimes and under instance-dependent noise. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/meruemon/ACD-U.

AI.tldr: 提出ACD-U框架，通过非对称协同教学和选择性遗忘机制解决深度神经网络在噪声标签训练中的记忆错误问题，实现主动错误修正而非被动避免。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络在训练过程中容易记忆错误标签，降低泛化能力。现有方法结合样本选择和半监督学习利用记忆效应，但一旦样本被错误分类就无法修正选择错误。
AI.method: 提出ACD-U框架：1) 非对称协同教学，将CLIP预训练的视觉Transformer与CNN配对，利用互补学习行为；2) 选择性遗忘机制，通过损失轨迹分析和CLIP一致性检查识别错误记忆样本，使用KL散度进行遗忘。
AI.result: 在合成和真实噪声数据集（CIFAR-10/100、CIFAR-N、WebVision、Clothing1M、Red Mini-ImageNet）上达到最先进性能，特别是在高噪声场景和实例依赖噪声下表现优异。
AI.conclusion: ACD-U通过非对称协同教学和选择性遗忘机制，将学习范式从被动错误避免转变为主动错误修正，有效解决了噪声标签训练中的记忆错误问题。

title: A Dataset for Probing Translationese Preferences in English-to-Swedish Translation
summary: Translations often carry traces of the source language, a phenomenon known as translationese. We introduce the first freely available English-to-Swedish dataset contrasting translationese sentences with idiomatic alternatives, designed to probe intrinsic preferences of language models. It includes error tags and descriptions of the problems in the original translations. In experiments evaluating smaller Swedish and multilingual LLMs with our dataset, we find that they often favor the translationese phrasing. Human alternatives are chosen more often when the English source sentence is omitted, indicating that exposure to the source biases models toward literal translations, although even without context models often prefer the translationese variant. Our dataset and findings provide a resource and benchmark for developing models that produce more natural, idiomatic output in non-English languages.

AI.tldr: 创建首个英译瑞典语翻译腔数据集，包含翻译腔句子与地道替代句，用于测试语言模型的内在偏好，发现模型倾向于翻译腔表达
AI.motivation: 翻译常带有源语言痕迹（翻译腔），需要研究语言模型对翻译腔与地道表达的偏好，为开发更自然非英语输出提供资源
AI.method: 创建首个免费英译瑞典语数据集，包含翻译腔句子与地道替代句、错误标签和问题描述；评估瑞典语和多语言LLM的偏好选择
AI.result: 模型常偏好翻译腔表达；省略英语源句时人类替代句被选更多，表明源语言暴露使模型偏向直译，但即使无上下文模型仍常选翻译腔变体
AI.conclusion: 数据集和发现为开发能产出更自然地道非英语输出的模型提供了资源和基准

title: Fanar-Sadiq: A Multi-Agent Architecture for Grounded Islamic QA
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can answer religious knowledge queries fluently, yet they often hallucinate and misattribute sources, which is especially consequential in Islamic settings where users expect grounding in canonical texts (Qur'an and Hadith) and jurisprudential (fiqh) nuance. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) reduces some of these limitations by grounding generation in external evidence. However, a single ``retrieve-then-generate'' pipeline is limited to deal with the diversity of Islamic queries.Users may request verbatim scripture, fatwa-style guidance with citations or rule-constrained computations such as zakat and inheritance that require strict arithmetic and legal invariants. In this work, we present a bilingual (Arabic/English) multi-agent Islamic assistant, called Fanar-Sadiq, which is a core component of the Fanar AI platform. Fanar-Sadiq routes Islamic-related queries to specialized modules within an agentic, tool-using architecture. The system supports intent-aware routing, retrieval-grounded fiqh answers with deterministic citation normalization and verification traces, exact verse lookup with quotation validation, and deterministic calculators for Sunni zakat and inheritance with madhhab-sensitive branching. We evaluate the complete end-to-end system on public Islamic QA benchmarks and demonstrate effectiveness and efficiency. Our system is currently publicly and freely accessible through API and a Web application, and has been accessed $\approx$1.9M times in less than a year.

AI.tldr: Fanar-Sadiq是一个双语多代理伊斯兰助手，通过智能路由将不同类型的伊斯兰查询分配给专门模块，解决传统RAG在处理多样化伊斯兰查询时的局限性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在回答宗教知识查询时经常产生幻觉和错误归因，这在伊斯兰背景下尤其严重，因为用户期望基于经典文本（古兰经和圣训）和法学细微差别。传统的检索增强生成方法无法处理伊斯兰查询的多样性，包括经文查找、教法指导、天课和遗产计算等不同类型需求。
AI.method: 采用多代理工具使用架构，通过意图感知路由将伊斯兰相关查询分配给专门模块：1）具有确定性引用规范化和验证追踪的检索基础教法答案；2）带引文验证的精确经文查找；3）具有教法学派敏感分支的确定性天课和遗产计算器。
AI.result: 在公共伊斯兰问答基准上评估显示系统有效且高效。系统通过API和Web应用公开免费访问，在不到一年内被访问约190万次。
AI.conclusion: Fanar-Sadiq通过多代理架构有效解决了伊斯兰查询的多样性问题，提供了更准确、可靠的伊斯兰知识服务，填补了传统LLM和RAG方法在宗教领域应用的局限性。

title: FreeFly-Thinking : Aligning Chain-of-Thought Reasoning with Continuous UAV Navigation
summary: Vision-Language Navigation aims to enable agents to understand natural language instructions and carry out appropriate navigation actions in real-world environments. Most work focuses on indoor settings, with little research in complex outdoor scenes. Current UAV Vision-and-Language Navigation models typically act as black boxes without explicit reasoning. We introduce FreeFly-thinking, an end-to-end VLN framework that converts the UAV agent's egocentric images and language instructions into a series of actions, inspired by environment of urban architecture proposed by OpenFly. We first construct a UAV dataset for navigation task, and then performing natural language chain of thought. We adopt a two-stage training strategy: Supervised fine-tuning and Reinforcement fine-tuning. Experiments on unseen test demonstrate a strong performance, presenting robustness and efficiency in UAV navigation issue.

AI.tldr: FreeFly-thinking是一个端到端的视觉语言导航框架，将无人机视角图像和语言指令转换为动作序列，采用两阶段训练策略，在无人机导航任务中表现出色。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉语言导航研究主要集中在室内场景，对复杂室外环境的研究较少。现有的无人机视觉语言导航模型通常是黑盒模型，缺乏明确的推理过程。因此需要开发一个能够进行显式推理的无人机导航框架。
AI.method: 首先构建无人机导航数据集，然后采用自然语言思维链进行推理。采用两阶段训练策略：监督微调和强化微调。框架将无人机的自我中心图像和语言指令转换为一系列动作。
AI.result: 在未见过的测试集上表现出强大的性能，在无人机导航问题上展现出鲁棒性和效率。
AI.conclusion: FreeFly-thinking框架成功解决了无人机视觉语言导航中的显式推理问题，在复杂室外环境中表现出色，为无人机导航提供了有效的解决方案。

title: CODA: Difficulty-Aware Compute Allocation for Adaptive Reasoning
summary: The emergence of large reasoning models demonstrates that scaling inference-time compute significantly enhances performance on complex tasks. However, it often falls into another trap: overthinking simple problems, where repetitive rationales yield minimal accuracy gains at a disproportionately high cost. This motivates adaptive reasoning: dynamically aligning reasoning depth with instance difficulty. In this paper, we study adaptive reasoning from an optimality perspective, formalizing it as a utility maximization problem where tokens are allocated until the marginal accuracy gain falls below the incremental cost. Based on this, we propose CODA (Compute Allocation by Difficulty Awareness), a method that operationalizes this principle by allocating tokens via a policy-internal difficulty signal. Specifically, CODA estimates difficulty via group-based rollouts and maps it to two non-negative gates that modulate a length-dependent shaping term on top of the binary base reward. The easy-side gate penalizes verbosity on simple instances, whereas the hard-side gate encourages more deliberative rollouts on challenging ones. Across model scales and benchmarks, CODA achieves adaptive reasoning without external annotations or user-provided budgets: on easy tasks, CODA reduces token costs by over 60% while maintaining strong accuracy, whereas on hard tasks it incentivizes more deliberative rollouts to maximize performance.

AI.tldr: CODA是一种自适应推理方法，通过难度感知动态分配计算资源，简单任务减少60%以上token成本，困难任务鼓励更多推理以提高性能。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型在简单问题上存在过度思考问题，重复推理带来微小精度提升却消耗不成比例的高成本，需要根据实例难度动态调整推理深度。
AI.method: 将自适应推理形式化为效用最大化问题，提出CODA方法：通过基于组的rollout估计难度，映射到两个非负门控，调节基于长度的整形项，简单任务惩罚冗长，困难任务鼓励更多推理。
AI.result: 在不同模型规模和基准测试中，CODA实现自适应推理，无需外部标注或用户预算：简单任务减少60%以上token成本同时保持高精度，困难任务通过更多推理最大化性能。
AI.conclusion: CODA通过难度感知的计算分配，有效解决了大型推理模型在简单问题上过度思考的问题，实现了计算资源与任务难度的自适应匹配。

title: FastSTAR: Spatiotemporal Token Pruning for Efficient Autoregressive Video Synthesis
summary: Visual Autoregressive modeling (VAR) has emerged as a highly efficient alternative to diffusion-based frameworks, achieving comparable synthesis quality. However, as this paradigm extends to Spacetime Autoregressive modeling (STAR) for video generation, scaling resolution and frame counts leads to a "token explosion" that creates a massive computational bottleneck in the final refinement stages. To address this, we propose FastSTAR, a training-free acceleration framework designed for high-quality video generation. Our core method, Spatiotemporal Token Pruning, identifies essential tokens by integrating two specialized terms: (1) Spatial similarity, which evaluates structural convergence across hierarchical scales to skip computations in regions where further refinement becomes redundant, and (2) Temporal similarity, which identifies active motion trajectories by assessing feature-level variations relative to the preceding clip. Combined with a Partial Update mechanism, FastSTAR ensures that only non-converged regions are refined, maintaining fluid motion while bypassing redundant computations. Experimental results on InfinityStar demonstrate that FastSTAR achieves up to a 2.01x speedup with a PSNR of 28.29 and less than 1% performance degradation, proving a superior efficiency-quality trade-off for STAR-based video synthesis.

AI.tldr: FastSTAR是一种无需训练的加速框架，通过时空令牌剪枝和部分更新机制，解决STAR视频生成中的"令牌爆炸"问题，在保持质量的同时实现2.01倍加速。
AI.motivation: 时空自回归建模(STAR)在扩展到高分辨率多帧视频生成时，会出现"令牌爆炸"问题，导致最终细化阶段产生巨大的计算瓶颈，需要高效的加速解决方案。
AI.method: 提出FastSTAR框架，核心是时空令牌剪枝：1) 空间相似性评估层次尺度上的结构收敛性，跳过冗余细化区域；2) 时间相似性通过特征级变化识别活动运动轨迹。结合部分更新机制，仅细化非收敛区域。
AI.result: 在InfinityStar上的实验结果显示，FastSTAR实现了最高2.01倍的加速，PSNR达到28.29，性能下降小于1%，在STAR视频合成中实现了优越的效率-质量权衡。
AI.conclusion: FastSTAR通过时空令牌剪枝有效解决了STAR视频生成的令牌爆炸问题，在保持高质量的同时显著提升计算效率，为自回归视频合成提供了实用的加速方案。

title: VINO: Video-driven Invariance for Non-contextual Objects via Structural Prior Guided De-contextualization
summary:
Self-supervised learning (SSL) has made rapid progress, yet learned features often over-rely on contextual shortcuts-background textures and co-occurrence statistics. While video provides rich temporal variation, dense in-the-wild streams with strong ego-motion create a co-occurrence trap: foreground objects and background context move coherently, encouraging representations to collapse into scene encoders.
  To address this, we propose VINO (Video-driven Invariance for Non-Contextual Objects), a teacher-student framework that learns robust image encoders from dense video by imposing a structural information bottleneck. Using a class-agnostic structural prior solely to generate views-not as semantic pseudo-labels-VINO forms an asymmetric distillation problem. The teacher predicts from a foreground-union view with the background suppressed, while the student observes object-conditioned scene views that retain surrounding context but remove competing instances. Matching these targets via masked distillation makes background cues unreliable, pushing the representation toward object-centric invariances. We further enforce temporal object permanence via teacher-anchored cross-time distillation over track-matched objects, and stabilize part-to-whole consistency with mask-guided local views.
  Through attention visualization and unsupervised object discovery on PASCAL VOC, we demonstrate that VINO effectively disentangles foreground from background. Pretrained on the dense Walking Tours Venice video, VINO achieves 34.8 CorLoc, yielding highly focused, shape-biased representations that substantially outperform prior dense-video and motion-guided SSL baselines.

AI.tldr: VINO是一个从密集视频中学习鲁棒图像编码器的教师-学生框架，通过结构信息瓶颈解决自监督学习中特征过度依赖上下文捷径的问题，实现前景与背景的解耦。
AI.motivation: 自监督学习虽然进展迅速，但学习到的特征往往过度依赖上下文捷径（背景纹理和共现统计）。在密集野外视频流中，强烈的自我运动造成了共现陷阱：前景对象和背景上下文协同移动，导致表示崩溃为场景编码器。
AI.method: 提出VINO教师-学生框架，使用类无关结构先验生成视图（而非语义伪标签），形成非对称蒸馏问题。教师从背景抑制的前景联合视图预测，学生观察对象条件化的场景视图（保留周围上下文但移除竞争实例）。通过掩码蒸馏匹配目标使背景线索不可靠，推动表示向对象中心不变性发展。还通过教师锚定的跨时间蒸馏和掩码引导的局部视图增强时间对象持久性和部分到整体一致性。
AI.result: 在PASCAL VOC上的注意力可视化和无监督对象发现表明，VINO有效解耦前景与背景。在密集Walking Tours Venice视频上预训练后，VINO达到34.8 CorLoc，产生高度聚焦、形状偏置的表示，显著优于先前密集视频和运动引导的自监督学习基线。
AI.conclusion: VINO通过结构信息瓶颈和不对称蒸馏，成功从密集视频中学习到鲁棒的对象中心表示，解决了自监督学习中特征过度依赖上下文捷径的问题，为无监督对象发现提供了有效解决方案。

title: Single Image Super-Resolution via Bivariate `A Trous Wavelet Diffusion
summary: The effectiveness of super resolution (SR) models hinges on their ability to recover high frequency structure without introducing artifacts. Diffusion based approaches have recently advanced the state of the art in SR. However, most diffusion based SR pipelines operate purely in the spatial domain, which may yield high frequency details that are not well supported by the underlying low resolution evidence. On the other hand, unlike supervised SR models that may inject dataset specific textures, single image SR relies primarily on internal image statistics and can therefore be less prone to dataset-driven hallucinations; nevertheless, ambiguity in the LR observation can still lead to inconsistent high frequency details. To tackle this problem, we introduce BATDiff, an unsupervised Bivariate A trous Wavelet Diffusion model designed to provide structured cross scale guidance during the generative process. BATDiff employs an a Trous wavelet transform that constructs an undecimated multiscale representation in which high frequency components are progressively revealed while the full spatial resolution is preserved. As the core inference mechanism, BATDiff includes a bivariate cross scale module that models parent child dependencies between adjacent scales. It improves high frequency coherence and reduces mismatch artifacts in diffusion based SR. Experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that BATDiff produces sharper and more structurally consistent reconstructions than existing diffusion and non diffusion baselines, achieving improvements in fidelity and perceptual quality.

AI.tldr: BATDiff是一种无监督双变量小波扩散模型，通过跨尺度引导解决超分辨率中的高频细节不一致问题，相比现有方法能产生更清晰、结构更一致的重建结果。
AI.motivation: 现有超分辨率方法存在高频细节不一致问题：基于扩散的方法在空间域操作可能导致高频细节缺乏低分辨率证据支持；单图像超分辨率虽然依赖内部图像统计减少幻觉，但低分辨率观测的模糊性仍会导致高频细节不一致。
AI.method: BATDiff采用无监督双变量à trous小波扩散模型，使用à trous小波变换构建无下采样的多尺度表示，在保持全空间分辨率的同时逐步揭示高频成分。核心推理机制包括双变量跨尺度模块，建模相邻尺度间的父子依赖关系。
AI.result: 在标准基准测试中，BATDiff相比现有扩散和非扩散基线方法，能产生更清晰、结构更一致的重建结果，在保真度和感知质量方面均有提升，改善了高频一致性并减少了不匹配伪影。
AI.conclusion: BATDiff通过结构化跨尺度引导机制，有效解决了超分辨率中的高频细节不一致问题，为无监督超分辨率提供了新的解决方案，在保持高频细节一致性和减少伪影方面表现出色。

title: HY-WU (Part I): An Extensible Functional Neural Memory Framework and An Instantiation in Text-Guided Image Editing
summary: Foundation models are transitioning from offline predictors to deployed systems expected to operate over long time horizons. In real deployments, objectives are not fixed: domains drift, user preferences evolve, and new tasks appear after the model has shipped. This elevates continual learning and instant personalization from optional features to core architectural requirements. Yet most adaptation pipelines still follow a static weight paradigm: after training (or after any adaptation step), inference executes a single parameter vector regardless of user intent, domain, or instance-specific constraints. This treats the trained or adapted model as a single point in parameter space. In heterogeneous and continually evolving regimes, distinct objectives can induce separated feasible regions over parameters, forcing any single shared update into compromise, interference, or overspecialization. As a result, continual learning and personalization are often implemented as repeated overwriting of shared weights, risking degradation of previously learned behaviors. We propose HY-WU (Weight Unleashing), a memory-first adaptation framework that shifts adaptation pressure away from overwriting a single shared parameter point. HY-WU implements functional (operator-level) memory as a neural module: a generator that synthesizes weight updates on-the-fly from the instance condition, yielding instance-specific operators without test-time optimization.

AI.tldr: HY-WU框架通过神经模块生成器实现实例特定的权重更新，避免共享参数覆盖，解决持续学习和个性化中的干扰与退化问题
AI.motivation: 基础模型从离线预测转向长期部署系统，面临目标动态变化（领域漂移、用户偏好演化、新任务出现）的挑战。传统静态权重范式将模型视为参数空间中的单点，在异构和持续演化场景中导致妥协、干扰或过度专业化问题，持续学习和个性化往往通过重复覆盖共享权重实现，存在先前学习行为退化的风险。
AI.method: 提出HY-WU（权重释放）框架，采用内存优先的适应方法，将适应压力从覆盖单一共享参数点转移。通过神经模块实现功能（操作符级别）内存：一个生成器根据实例条件动态合成权重更新，无需测试时优化即可产生实例特定的操作符。
AI.result: 该方法避免了传统持续学习和个性化中重复覆盖共享权重导致的退化问题，能够在异构和持续演化场景中实现更好的适应性能，同时保持先前学习行为的稳定性。
AI.conclusion: HY-WU框架通过将适应范式从静态权重转向动态权重生成，为解决基础模型在长期部署中的持续学习和个性化挑战提供了新的架构方向，能够更好地应对目标动态变化的环境。

title: FabricGen: Microstructure-Aware Woven Fabric Generation
summary: Woven fabric materials are widely used in rendering applications, yet designing realistic examples typically involves multiple stages, requiring expertise in weaving principles and texture authoring. Recent advances have explored diffusion models to streamline this process; however, pre-trained diffusion models often struggle to generate intricate yarn-level details that conform to weaving rules. To address this, we present FabricGen, an end-to-end framework for generating high-quality woven fabric materials from textual descriptions. A key insight of our method is the decomposition of macro-scale textures and micro-scale weaving patterns. To generate macro-scale textures free from microstructures, we fine-tune pre-trained diffusion models on a collected dataset of microstructure-free fabrics. As for micro-scale weaving patterns, we develop an enhanced procedural geometric model capable of synthesizing natural yarn-level geometry with yarn sliding and flyaway fibers. The procedural model is driven by a specialized large language model, WeavingLLM, which is fine-tuned on an annotated dataset of formatted weaving drafts, and prompt-tuned with domain-specific fabric expertise. Through fine-tuning and prompt tuning, WeavingLLM learns to design weaving drafts and fabric parameters from textual prompts, enabling the procedural model to produce diverse weaving patterns that stick to weaving principles. The generated macro-scale texture, along with the micro-scale geometry, can be used for fabric rendering. Consequently, our framework produces materials with significantly richer detail and realism compared to prior generative models.

AI.tldr: FabricGen是一个端到端框架，通过分解宏观纹理和微观编织模式，结合微调扩散模型和增强程序几何模型，从文本描述生成高质量编织织物材料。
AI.motivation: 传统织物设计需要多阶段专业知识和编织原理理解，现有扩散模型难以生成符合编织规则的精细纱线级细节，需要更有效的生成方法。
AI.method: 1) 宏观纹理：在无微结构织物数据集上微调预训练扩散模型；2) 微观编织模式：开发增强程序几何模型生成自然纱线几何；3) 使用专门微调的WeavingLLM大语言模型从文本提示设计编织草案和参数。
AI.result: 框架能够生成比先前生成模型更丰富细节和真实感的织物材料，实现从文本描述到高质量织物渲染的端到端生成。
AI.conclusion: FabricGen通过分解宏观纹理和微观编织模式，结合扩散模型和程序几何模型，成功实现了从文本描述生成高质量、符合编织原理的织物材料。

title: LEPA: Learning Geometric Equivariance in Satellite Remote Sensing Data with a Predictive Architecture
summary: Geospatial foundation models provide precomputed embeddings that serve as compact feature vectors for large-scale satellite remote sensing data. While these embeddings can reduce data-transfer bottlenecks and computational costs, Earth observation (EO) applications can still face geometric mismatches between user-defined areas of interest and the fixed precomputed embedding grid. Standard latent-space interpolation is unreliable in this setting because the embedding manifold is highly non-convex, yielding representations that do not correspond to realistic inputs. We verify this using Prithvi-EO-2.0 to understand the shortcomings of interpolation applied to patch embeddings. As a substitute, we propose a Learned Equivariance-Predicting Architecture (LEPA). Instead of averaging vectors, LEPA conditions a predictor on geometric augmentations to directly predict the transformed embedding. We evaluate LEPA on NASA/USGS Harmonized Landsat-Sentinel (HLS) imagery and ImageNet-1k. Experiments show that standard interpolation achieves a mean reciprocal rank (MRR) below 0.2, whereas LEPA increases MRR to over 0.8, enabling accurate geometric adjustment without re-encoding.

AI.tldr: 论文提出LEPA架构解决地理空间基础模型中预计算嵌入与用户定义区域几何不匹配问题，替代不可靠的潜在空间插值方法
AI.motivation: 地理空间基础模型的预计算嵌入虽然能减少数据传输瓶颈和计算成本，但用户定义感兴趣区域与固定预计算嵌入网格之间存在几何不匹配问题。标准潜在空间插值在这种设置下不可靠，因为嵌入流形高度非凸，产生的表示不对应现实输入。
AI.method: 提出学习等变性预测架构(LEPA)，不平均向量，而是通过几何增强条件化预测器直接预测变换后的嵌入。使用Prithvi-EO-2.0验证标准插值的局限性，并在NASA/USGS Harmonized Landsat-Sentinel影像和ImageNet-1k上进行评估。
AI.result: 标准插值方法平均倒数排名(MRR)低于0.2，而LEPA将MRR提高到0.8以上，实现了无需重新编码的准确几何调整。
AI.conclusion: LEPA架构能有效解决地理空间基础模型中预计算嵌入的几何不匹配问题，显著优于标准插值方法，为地球观测应用提供了更可靠的几何调整解决方案。

title: AQuA: Toward Strategic Response Generation for Ambiguous Visual Questions
summary: Visual Question Answering (VQA) is a core task for evaluating the capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs). Existing VQA benchmarks primarily feature clear and unambiguous image-question pairs, whereas real-world scenarios often involve varying degrees of ambiguity that require nuanced reasoning and context-appropriate response strategies. Although recent studies have begun to address ambiguity in VQA, they lack (1) a systematic categorization of ambiguity levels and (2) datasets and models that support strategy-aware responses. In this paper, we introduce Ambiguous Visual Question Answering (AQuA), a fine-grained dataset that classifies ambiguous VQA instances into four levels according to the nature and degree of ambiguity, along with the optimal response strategy for each case. Our evaluation of diverse open-source and proprietary VLMs shows that most models fail to adapt their strategy to the ambiguity type, frequently producing overconfident answers rather than seeking clarification or acknowledging uncertainty. To address this challenge, we fine-tune VLMs on AQuA, enabling them to adaptively choose among multiple response strategies, such as directly answering, inferring intent from contextual cues, listing plausible alternatives, or requesting clarification. VLMs trained on AQuA achieve strategic response generation for ambiguous VQA, demonstrating the ability to recognize ambiguity, manage uncertainty, and respond with context-appropriate strategies, while outperforming both open-source and closed-source baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了AQuA数据集，这是一个细粒度的模糊视觉问答数据集，将模糊VQA实例按模糊程度分为四个级别，并为每种情况提供最佳响应策略。研究评估了现有VLM在模糊VQA上的表现，并通过在AQuA上微调VLM使其能自适应选择多种响应策略。
AI.motivation: 现有VQA基准主要包含清晰明确的图像-问题对，而现实场景往往涉及不同程度的模糊性，需要细微推理和上下文适当的响应策略。虽然近期研究开始关注VQA中的模糊性问题，但缺乏：(1)对模糊级别的系统分类；(2)支持策略感知响应的数据集和模型。
AI.method: 引入AQuA数据集，将模糊VQA实例按模糊性质和程度分为四个级别，并为每种情况提供最佳响应策略。评估了多种开源和专有VLM的表现，然后在AQuA数据集上微调VLM，使其能够自适应选择多种响应策略（直接回答、从上下文线索推断意图、列出合理替代方案或请求澄清）。
AI.result: 大多数现有VLM无法根据模糊类型调整策略，经常产生过于自信的答案而不是寻求澄清或承认不确定性。在AQuA上训练的VLM实现了模糊VQA的策略响应生成，展示了识别模糊性、管理不确定性和使用上下文适当策略响应的能力，同时在性能上超越了开源和闭源基线模型。
AI.conclusion: AQuA数据集填补了现有VQA基准在模糊性处理方面的空白，通过系统分类模糊级别和策略感知响应，为VLM在现实模糊场景中的能力评估和改进提供了重要工具。在AQuA上微调的VLM能够更好地处理模糊VQA任务，展现出更接近人类推理的响应策略选择能力。

title: Variational Flow Maps: Make Some Noise for One-Step Conditional Generation
summary: Flow maps enable high-quality image generation in a single forward pass. However, unlike iterative diffusion models, their lack of an explicit sampling trajectory impedes incorporating external constraints for conditional generation and solving inverse problems. We put forth Variational Flow Maps, a framework for conditional sampling that shifts the perspective of conditioning from "guiding a sampling path", to that of "learning the proper initial noise". Specifically, given an observation, we seek to learn a noise adapter model that outputs a noise distribution, so that after mapping to the data space via flow map, the samples respect the observation and data prior. To this end, we develop a principled variational objective that jointly trains the noise adapter and the flow map, improving noise-data alignment, such that sampling from complex data posterior is achieved with a simple adapter. Experiments on various inverse problems show that VFMs produce well-calibrated conditional samples in a single (or few) steps. For ImageNet, VFM attains competitive fidelity while accelerating the sampling by orders of magnitude compared to alternative iterative diffusion/flow models. Code is available at https://github.com/abbasmammadov/VFM

AI.tldr: VFMs提出变分流映射框架，通过训练噪声适配器学习初始噪声分布，实现单步条件生成，解决了流映射模型缺乏显式采样轨迹的问题。
AI.motivation: 流映射模型虽然能单步生成高质量图像，但缺乏显式采样轨迹，难以融入外部约束进行条件生成和解决逆问题。传统方法通过引导采样路径进行条件生成，而本文提出学习适当初始噪声的新视角。
AI.method: 提出变分流映射框架，将条件生成视角从"引导采样路径"转变为"学习适当初始噪声"。开发噪声适配器模型输出噪声分布，通过变分目标联合训练噪声适配器和流映射，改善噪声-数据对齐，使复杂数据后验采样通过简单适配器实现。
AI.result: 在各种逆问题实验中，VFMs能在单步或少数步骤内产生校准良好的条件样本。在ImageNet上，VFMs在保持竞争力的保真度同时，相比迭代扩散/流模型将采样速度提高了数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 变分流映射框架通过将条件采样重新定义为学习适当初始噪声的问题，实现了高效的单步条件生成，为流映射模型在条件生成和逆问题求解中提供了新的解决方案。

title: Generalization in Online Reinforcement Learning for Mobile Agents
summary: Graphical user interface (GUI)-based mobile agents automate digital tasks on mobile devices by interpreting natural-language instructions and interacting with the screen. While recent methods apply reinforcement learning (RL) to train vision-language-model(VLM) agents in interactive environments with a primary focus on performance, generalization remains underexplored due to the lack of standardized benchmarks and open-source RL systems. In this work, we formalize the problem as a Contextual Markov Decision Process (CMDP) and introduce \textbf{AndroidWorld-Generalization}, a benchmark with three increasingly challenging regimes for evaluating zero-shot generalization to unseen task instances, templates, and applications. We further propose an RL training system that integrates Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a scalable rollout collection system, consisting of containerized infrastructure and asynchronous execution % , and error recovery to support reliable and efficient training. Experiments on AndroidWorld-Generalization show that RL enables a 7B-parameter VLM agent to surpass supervised fine-tuning baselines, yielding a 26.1\% improvement on unseen instances but only limited gains on unseen templates (15.7\%) and apps (8.3\%), underscoring the challenges of generalization. As a preliminary step, we demonstrate that few-shot adaptation at test-time improves performance on unseen apps, motivating future research in this direction. To support reproducibility and fair comparison, we open-source the full RL training system, including the environment, task suite, models, prompt configurations, and the underlying infrastructure \footnote{https://github.com/zihuanjiang/AndroidWorld-Generalization}.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了AndroidWorld-Generalization基准测试，用于评估移动GUI代理的零样本泛化能力，并开发了一个结合GRPO的RL训练系统，在未见任务实例上取得26.1%提升，但在模板和应用泛化上仍有挑战。
AI.motivation: 当前基于GUI的移动代理虽然使用强化学习训练，但泛化能力研究不足，缺乏标准化基准和开源RL系统，需要系统评估代理在未见任务、模板和应用上的泛化性能。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为上下文马尔可夫决策过程，提出AndroidWorld-Generalization基准（包含三个难度递增的泛化机制），开发集成GRPO的RL训练系统，包含容器化基础设施和异步执行。
AI.result: RL训练使70亿参数VLM代理在未见任务实例上超越监督微调基线26.1%，但在未见模板上仅提升15.7%，未见应用上仅提升8.3%，显示泛化挑战。少量测试时适应可改善未见应用性能。
AI.conclusion: 移动GUI代理的泛化能力仍有很大提升空间，特别是在模板和应用层面的泛化。开源RL训练系统支持可复现性和公平比较，未来研究可探索测试时适应方法。

title: Virtual Try-On for Cultural Clothing: A Benchmarking Study
summary: Although existing virtual try-on systems have made significant progress with the advent of diffusion models, the current benchmarks of these models are based on datasets that are dominant in western-style clothing and female models, limiting their ability to generalize culturally diverse clothing styles. In this work, we introduce BD-VITON, a virtual try-on dataset focused on Bangladeshi garments, including saree, panjabi and salwar kameez, covering both male and female categories as well. These garments present unique structural challenges such as complex draping, asymmetric layering, and high deformation complexities which are underrepresented in the original VITON dataset. To establish strong baselines, we retrain and evaluate try-on models, namely StableViton, HR-VITON, and VITON-HD on our dataset. Our experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in terms of both quantitative and qualitative analysis, compared to zero shot inference.

AI.tldr: 论文介绍了BD-VITON数据集，专注于孟加拉国传统服饰的虚拟试穿，解决了现有数据集在文化多样性服饰上的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有虚拟试穿系统虽然随着扩散模型的发展取得了显著进步，但当前基准测试主要基于西方风格服装和女性模特的数据集，限制了模型对文化多样性服装风格的泛化能力。
AI.method: 1. 创建BD-VITON数据集，包含孟加拉国传统服饰（纱丽、旁遮比、萨尔瓦卡米兹），涵盖男女类别；2. 在数据集上重新训练和评估三种试穿模型：StableViton、HR-VITON和VITON-HD；3. 与零样本推理进行对比分析。
AI.result: 实验表明，在BD-VITON数据集上重新训练的模型在定量和定性分析上都取得了持续改进，相比零样本推理有明显提升。
AI.conclusion: BD-VITON数据集填补了虚拟试穿领域在文化多样性服饰方面的空白，为处理复杂结构挑战（如复杂褶皱、不对称层次和高变形复杂性）提供了更好的基准。

title: Image Generation Models: A Technical History
summary: Image generation has advanced rapidly over the past decade, yet the literature seems fragmented across different models and application domains. This paper aims to offer a comprehensive survey of breakthrough image generation models, including variational autoencoders (VAEs), generative adversarial networks (GANs), normalizing flows, autoregressive and transformer-based generators, and diffusion-based methods. We provide a detailed technical walkthrough of each model type, including their underlying objectives, architectural building blocks, and algorithmic training steps. For each model type, we present the optimization techniques as well as common failure modes and limitations. We also go over recent developments in video generation and present the research works that made it possible to go from still frames to high quality videos. Lastly, we cover the growing importance of robustness and responsible deployment of these models, including deepfake risks, detection, artifacts, and watermarking.

AI.tldr: 本文对图像生成领域进行了全面综述，涵盖了VAE、GAN、归一化流、自回归/Transformer生成器和扩散模型等主要技术，详细分析了各类模型的技术原理、优化方法和局限性，并扩展到视频生成及模型负责任部署等前沿话题。
AI.motivation: 图像生成技术在过去十年快速发展，但相关文献在不同模型和应用领域之间显得分散。本文旨在提供一个全面的图像生成模型综述，帮助研究人员和从业者理解该领域的整体发展脉络和技术演进。
AI.method: 采用系统性文献综述方法，对各类图像生成模型进行技术性梳理，包括：变分自编码器(VAE)、生成对抗网络(GAN)、归一化流、自回归和Transformer生成器、扩散模型等。对每种模型类型详细分析其目标函数、架构组件和训练算法。
AI.result: 提供了图像生成领域的完整技术路线图，总结了各类模型的优化技术、常见失败模式和局限性。同时涵盖了从静态图像到高质量视频生成的最新进展，以及模型鲁棒性和负责任部署的关键问题。
AI.conclusion: 图像生成技术已取得显著进展，从VAE到扩散模型形成了完整的技术谱系。未来研究需要关注视频生成、模型鲁棒性、负责任部署等方向，特别是深度伪造风险、检测技术、伪影消除和水印保护等实际问题。

title: MAviS: A Multimodal Conversational Assistant For Avian Species
summary: Fine-grained understanding and species-specific multimodal question answering are vital for advancing biodiversity conservation and ecological monitoring. However, existing multimodal large language models face challenges when it comes to specialized topics like avian species, making it harder to provide accurate and contextually relevant information in these areas. To address this limitation, we introduce the MAviS-Dataset, a large-scale multimodal avian species dataset that integrates image, audio, and text modalities for over 1,000 bird species, comprising both pretraining and instruction-tuning subsets enriched with structured question-answer pairs. Building on the MAviS-Dataset, we introduce MAviS-Chat, a multimodal LLM that supports audio, vision, and text and is designed for fine-grained species understanding, multimodal question answering, and scene-specific description generation. Finally, for quantitative evaluation, we present MAviS-Bench, a benchmark of over 25,000 QA pairs designed to assess avian species-specific perceptual and reasoning abilities across modalities. Experimental results show that MAviS-Chat outperforms the baseline MiniCPM-o-2.6 by a large margin, achieving state-of-the-art open-source results and demonstrating the effectiveness of our instruction-tuned MAviS-Dataset. Our findings highlight the necessity of domain-adaptive multimodal LLMs for ecological applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MAviS框架，包括多模态鸟类物种数据集、聊天模型和评估基准，用于解决现有多模态大语言模型在鸟类等专业领域理解不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型在处理鸟类等专业领域时面临挑战，难以提供准确且上下文相关的信息，这限制了生物多样性保护和生态监测的进展。
AI.method: 1) 构建MAviS-Dataset：包含1000多种鸟类的大规模多模态数据集，整合图像、音频和文本模态，包含预训练和指令调优子集；2) 开发MAviS-Chat：支持音频、视觉和文本的多模态LLM，用于细粒度物种理解、多模态问答和场景描述生成；3) 创建MAviS-Bench：包含25000多个QA对的评估基准，用于评估跨模态的鸟类物种感知和推理能力。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，MAviS-Chat大幅超越基线模型MiniCPM-o-2.6，取得了最先进的开源结果，证明了指令调优的MAviS-Dataset的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了领域自适应多模态LLM在生态应用中的必要性，MAviS框架为鸟类物种理解和生态监测提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Training for Trustworthy Saliency Maps: Adversarial Training Meets Feature-Map Smoothing
summary: Gradient-based saliency methods such as Vanilla Gradient (VG) and Integrated Gradients (IG) are widely used to explain image classifiers, yet the resulting maps are often noisy and unstable, limiting their usefulness in high-stakes settings. Most prior work improves explanations by modifying the attribution algorithm, leaving open how the training procedure shapes explanation quality. We take a training-centered view and first provide a curvature-based analysis linking attribution stability to how smoothly the input-gradient field varies locally. Guided by this connection, we study adversarial training and identify a consistent trade-off: it yields sparser and more input-stable saliency maps, but can degrade output-side stability, causing explanations to change even when predictions remain unchanged and logits vary only slightly. To mitigate this, we propose augmenting adversarial training with a lightweight feature-map smoothing block that applies a differentiable Gaussian filter in an intermediate layer. Across FMNIST, CIFAR-10, and ImageNette, our method preserves the sparsity benefits of adversarial training while improving both input-side stability and output-side stability. A human study with 65 participants further shows that smoothed adversarial saliency maps are perceived as more sufficient and trustworthy. Overall, our results demonstrate that explanation quality is critically shaped by training, and that simple smoothing with robust training provides a practical path toward saliency maps that are both sparse and stable.

AI.tldr: 论文提出通过对抗训练结合特征图平滑来改善梯度显著性方法的质量，在保持稀疏性的同时提升稳定性，并通过人类研究验证了改进效果。
AI.motivation: 现有梯度显著性方法（如VG和IG）产生的显著性图通常存在噪声和不稳定问题，限制了在高风险场景中的应用。先前研究主要关注改进归因算法，而训练过程如何影响解释质量尚未充分探索。
AI.method: 1. 从曲率角度分析归因稳定性与输入梯度场局部平滑度的关系；2. 研究对抗训练对显著性图质量的影响；3. 提出在对抗训练基础上增加轻量级特征图平滑模块，在中间层应用可微分高斯滤波器；4. 在FMNIST、CIFAR-10和ImageNette数据集上验证方法。
AI.result: 对抗训练产生更稀疏且输入侧更稳定的显著性图，但会降低输出侧稳定性（预测不变时解释仍会变化）。提出的平滑方法在保持对抗训练稀疏性优势的同时，显著改善了输入侧和输出侧稳定性。65名参与者的人类研究显示，平滑后的对抗显著性图被认为更充分和可信。
AI.conclusion: 解释质量受训练过程显著影响，简单的平滑技术与鲁棒训练结合，为实现既稀疏又稳定的显著性图提供了实用路径。这为改善高风险场景中模型可解释性提供了新的训练视角。

title: 3ViewSense: Spatial and Mental Perspective Reasoning from Orthographic Views in Vision-Language Models
summary: Current Large Language Models have achieved Olympiad-level logic, yet Vision-Language Models paradoxically falter on elementary spatial tasks like block counting. This capability mismatch reveals a critical ``spatial intelligence gap,'' where models fail to construct coherent 3D mental representations from 2D observations. We uncover this gap via diagnostic analyses showing the bottleneck is a missing view-consistent spatial interface rather than insufficient visual features or weak reasoning. To bridge this, we introduce \textbf{3ViewSense}, a framework that grounds spatial reasoning in Orthographic Views. Drawing on engineering cognition, we propose a ``Simulate-and-Reason'' mechanism that decomposes complex scenes into canonical orthographic projections to resolve geometric ambiguities. By aligning egocentric perceptions with these allocentric references, our method facilitates explicit mental rotation and reconstruction. Empirical results on spatial reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing baselines, with consistent gains on occlusion-heavy counting and view-consistent spatial reasoning. The framework also improves the stability and consistency of spatial descriptions, offering a scalable path toward stronger spatial intelligence in multimodal systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出3ViewSense框架，通过正交投影视图解决VLM在空间推理任务中的瓶颈，显著提升空间智能表现
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型已具备奥林匹克级别的逻辑能力，但视觉语言模型却在基础空间任务（如积木计数）上表现不佳，这种能力不匹配揭示了关键的"空间智能鸿沟"，模型无法从2D观察构建一致的3D心理表征
AI.method: 提出3ViewSense框架，基于工程认知学原理，采用"模拟与推理"机制，将复杂场景分解为规范的正交投影视图来解决几何歧义，通过将自我中心感知与这些异中心参考对齐，实现显式心理旋转和重建
AI.result: 在空间推理基准测试中，该方法显著优于现有基线，在遮挡严重的计数和视图一致的空间推理任务上获得一致增益，同时提高了空间描述的稳定性和一致性
AI.conclusion: 该框架为多模态系统中更强的空间智能提供了可扩展的路径，通过正交视图将空间推理基础化，有效弥合了视觉语言模型的空间智能鸿沟

title: Can Vision-Language Models Solve the Shell Game?
summary: Visual entity tracking is an innate cognitive ability in humans, yet it remains a critical bottleneck for Vision-Language Models (VLMs). This deficit is often obscured in existing video benchmarks by visual shortcuts. We introduce VET-Bench, a synthetic diagnostic testbed featuring visually identical objects that necessitate tracking exclusively through spatiotemporal continuity. Our experiments reveal that current state-of-the-art VLMs perform at or near chance level on VET-Bench, exposing a fundamental limitation: an over-reliance on static frame-level features and a failure to maintain entity representations over time. We provide a theoretical analysis drawing connections to the state-tracking problem, proving that fixed-depth transformer-based VLMs are fundamentally limited in tracking indistinguishable objects without intermediate supervision due to expressivity constraints. To address this, we propose Spatiotemporal Grounded Chain-of-Thought (SGCoT): generating object trajectories as explicit intermediate states. Leveraging Molmo2's object tracking ability, we elicit SGCoT reasoning by fine-tuning on synthesized text-only data for alignment. Our method achieves state-of-the-art accuracy exceeding 90% on VET-Bench, demonstrating that VLMs can reliably solve the video shell-game task end-to-end without external tools. Our code and data are available at https://vetbench.github.io .

AI.tldr: 论文提出了VET-Bench诊断测试平台，揭示当前视觉语言模型在视觉实体跟踪上的根本缺陷，并提出SGCoT方法通过生成显式对象轨迹作为中间状态来解决这一问题。
AI.motivation: 视觉实体跟踪是人类固有的认知能力，但却是视觉语言模型的关键瓶颈。现有视频基准测试中这一问题被视觉捷径所掩盖，需要创建专门的诊断测试来暴露模型的根本局限性。
AI.method: 1) 提出VET-Bench合成诊断测试平台，包含视觉上完全相同的对象，必须通过时空连续性进行跟踪；2) 提出时空基础思维链(SGCoT)方法，将对象轨迹作为显式中间状态生成；3) 利用Molmo2的对象跟踪能力，通过合成文本数据进行微调对齐。
AI.result: 当前最先进的视觉语言模型在VET-Bench上表现接近随机水平，暴露了根本局限性。SGCoT方法在VET-Bench上实现了超过90%的准确率，能够可靠地端到端解决视频"壳牌游戏"任务。
AI.conclusion: 固定深度的基于Transformer的视觉语言模型在跟踪无法区分的对象方面存在根本的表达能力限制。通过生成显式对象轨迹作为中间状态的SGCoT方法能够有效解决这一问题，为视觉语言模型的实体跟踪能力提供了可行的解决方案。

title: AgrI Challenge: A Data-Centric AI Competition for Cross-Team Validation in Agricultural Vision
comment: 17 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Introduces the AgrI Challenge dataset containing 50,673 field images of six tree species collected by twelve independent teams
summary:
Machine learning models in agricultural vision often achieve high accuracy on curated datasets but fail to generalize under real field conditions due to distribution shifts between training and deployment environments. Moreover, most machine learning competitions focus primarily on model design while treating datasets as fixed resources, leaving the role of data collection practices in model generalization largely unexplored.
  We introduce the AgrI Challenge, a data-centric competition framework in which multiple teams independently collect field datasets, producing a heterogeneous multi-source benchmark that reflects realistic variability in acquisition conditions. To systematically evaluate cross-domain generalization across independently collected datasets, we propose Cross-Team Validation (CTV), an evaluation paradigm that treats each team's dataset as a distinct domain. CTV includes two complementary protocols: Train-on-One-Team-Only (TOTO), which measures single-source generalization, and Leave-One-Team-Out (LOTO), which evaluates collaborative multi-source training.
  Experiments reveal substantial generalization gaps under single-source training: models achieve near-perfect validation accuracy yet exhibit validation-test gaps of up to 16.20% (DenseNet121) and 11.37% (Swin Transformer) when evaluated on datasets collected by other teams. In contrast, collaborative multi-source training dramatically improves robustness, reducing the gap to 2.82% and 1.78%, respectively.
  The challenge also produced a publicly available dataset of 50,673 field images of six tree species collected by twelve independent teams, providing a diverse benchmark for studying domain shift and data-centric learning in agricultural vision.

AI.tldr: AgrI Challenge是一个数据中心的农业视觉竞赛框架，通过多团队独立收集数据创建异构数据集，提出跨团队验证方法评估模型在真实田间条件下的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 农业视觉模型在精心策划的数据集上表现良好，但在真实田间条件下泛化能力差，主要原因是训练和部署环境之间的分布偏移。现有机器学习竞赛主要关注模型设计而将数据集视为固定资源，忽视了数据收集实践对模型泛化的重要作用。
AI.method: 引入AgrI Challenge数据中心竞赛框架，让多个团队独立收集田间数据集，创建异构多源基准。提出跨团队验证评估范式，包括两种协议：Train-on-One-Team-Only评估单源泛化能力，Leave-One-Team-Out评估协作多源训练效果。
AI.result: 单源训练下存在显著泛化差距：模型在验证集上接近完美准确率，但在其他团队收集的数据集上测试时，DenseNet121和Swin Transformer分别出现16.20%和11.37%的验证-测试差距。协作多源训练显著提高鲁棒性，将差距分别降低到2.82%和1.78%。
AI.conclusion: AgrI Challenge创建了包含12个独立团队收集的50,673张六种树木物种田间图像的公开数据集，为研究农业视觉中的域偏移和以数据为中心的学习提供了多样化基准。协作数据收集和多源训练能显著改善模型在真实条件下的泛化能力。

title: VIVECaption: A Split Approach to Caption Quality Improvement
summary: Caption quality has emerged as a critical bottleneck in training high-quality text-to-image (T2I) and text-to-video (T2V) generative models. While visual language models (VLMs) are commonly deployed to generate captions from visual data, they suffer from hallucinations, poor compositional reasoning, and limited fine-grained understanding, resulting in misaligned image-caption pairs that degrade downstream model performance. This technical report introduces VIVECaption, a systematic two-sided approach to caption quality improvement. We first establish a comprehensive taxonomy of caption evaluation metrics, distinguishing between "universal" and "instance-grounded" metrics, with the ultimate goal of showcasing the use-cases and tradeoffs between different caption quality metrics. We then use this language to describe our two-sided approach to caption quality improvement: (1) a gold-standard dataset creation methodology using stratified sampling and (2) a model alignment strategy encompassing context alignment and parameter-level finetuning using SFT. We demonstrate our methodology on open-source models, focusing on structured caption formats that enable better parsing and downstream utilization. We ultimately show that using a finetuned character detection model in an image captioning pipeline significantly improves holistic image-caption alignment quality. Our work addresses the growing need for high-quality "vegan" training data in enterprise AI development, providing practical solutions for teams seeking to improve caption-image alignment without relying on potentially copyright-protected web-scraped content.

AI.tldr: VIVECaption提出了一种系统化的双面方法改进图像/视频描述质量，通过建立描述评估指标分类体系，结合黄金标准数据集创建和模型对齐策略，显著提升图像-描述对齐质量。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉语言模型生成的描述存在幻觉、组合推理能力差和细粒度理解有限等问题，导致图像-描述对不匹配，从而降低下游文本到图像/视频生成模型的性能。企业AI开发需要高质量的训练数据，但避免使用可能受版权保护的网络抓取内容。
AI.method: 1. 建立全面的描述评估指标分类体系，区分"通用"和"实例基础"指标；2. 双面改进方法：a) 使用分层采样的黄金标准数据集创建方法，b) 包含上下文对齐和使用SFT进行参数级微调的模型对齐策略；3. 在开源模型上演示该方法，专注于结构化描述格式以支持更好的解析和下游使用。
AI.result: 在图像描述管道中使用微调后的字符检测模型显著提高了整体图像-描述对齐质量。该方法为寻求改进描述-图像对齐而不依赖可能受版权保护的网络抓取内容的团队提供了实用解决方案。
AI.conclusion: VIVECaption通过系统化的双面方法解决了描述质量瓶颈问题，为企业AI开发提供了高质量"素食"训练数据的实用解决方案，显著提升了图像-描述对齐质量，支持更好的下游模型性能。

title: Prompt-Based Caption Generation for Single-Tooth Dental Images Using Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted to IEEE International Conference on Semantic Computing (IEEE ICSC 2026)
summary: Digital dentistry has made significant advances with the advent of deep learning. However, the majority of these deep learning-based dental image analysis models focus on very specific tasks such as tooth segmentation, tooth detection, cavity detection, and gingivitis classification. There is a lack of a specialized model that has holistic knowledge of teeth and can perform dental image analysis tasks based on that knowledge. Datasets of dental images with captions can help build such a model. To the best of our knowledge, existing dental image datasets with captions are few in number and limited in scope. In many of these datasets, the captions describe the entire mouth, while the images are limited to the anterior view. As a result, posterior teeth such as molars are not clearly visible, limiting the usefulness of the captions for training vision-language models. Additionally, the captions focus only on a specific disease (gingivitis) and do not provide a holistic assessment of each tooth. Moreover, tooth disease scores are typically assigned to individual teeth, and each tooth is treated as a separate entity in orthodontic procedures. Therefore, it is important to have captions for single-tooth images. As far as we know, no such dataset of single-tooth images with dental captions exists. In this work, we aim to bridge that gap by assessing the possibility of generating captions for dental images using Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and evaluating the extent and quality of those captions. Our findings suggest that guided prompts help VLMs generate meaningful captions. We show that the prompts generated by our framework are better anchored in describing the visual aspects of dental images. We selected RGB images as they have greater potential in consumer scenarios.

AI.tldr: 该研究旨在解决牙科图像分析中缺乏全面知识模型的问题，通过评估视觉语言模型为单颗牙齿图像生成描述的可能性，发现引导提示能帮助生成有意义的牙科图像描述。
AI.motivation: 当前基于深度学习的牙科图像分析模型大多专注于特定任务（如牙齿分割、检测等），缺乏具有全面牙齿知识的专业模型。现有的牙科图像标注数据集数量有限、范围狭窄，且标注主要描述整个口腔而非单颗牙齿，无法满足训练视觉语言模型的需求。
AI.method: 研究评估使用视觉语言模型为牙科图像生成描述的可能性，通过开发引导提示框架来生成更贴合牙科图像视觉特征的描述。选择RGB图像作为研究对象，因其在消费者场景中具有更大潜力。
AI.result: 研究发现引导提示能帮助视觉语言模型生成有意义的牙科图像描述，且研究框架生成的提示能更好地锚定在描述牙科图像的视觉特征上。
AI.conclusion: 该研究填补了单颗牙齿图像标注数据集的空白，证明了视觉语言模型在生成牙科图像描述方面的潜力，为构建具有全面牙齿知识的专业模型奠定了基础。

title: UnSCAR: Universal, Scalable, Controllable, and Adaptable Image Restoration
summary: Universal image restoration aims to recover clean images from arbitrary real-world degradations using a single inference model. Despite significant progress, existing all-in-one restoration networks do not scale to multiple degradations. As the number of degradations increases, training becomes unstable, models grow excessively large, and performance drops across both seen and unseen domains. In this work, we show that scaling universal restoration is fundamentally limited by interference across degradations during joint learning, leading to catastrophic task forgetting. To address this challenge, we introduce a unified inference pipeline with a multi-branch mixture-of-experts architecture that decomposes restoration knowledge across specialized task-adaptable experts. Our approach enables scalable learning (over sixteen degradations), adapts and generalizes robustly to unseen domains, and supports user-controllable restoration across degradations. Beyond achieving superior performance across benchmarks, this work establishes a new design paradigm for scalable and controllable universal image restoration.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种可扩展的通用图像修复方法，通过多分支专家混合架构解决多退化联合学习中的干扰问题，支持16种以上退化类型，实现可控修复。
AI.motivation: 现有通用图像修复网络在扩展到多种退化类型时面临训练不稳定、模型过大、性能下降等问题，根本原因是联合学习中不同退化类型之间的干扰导致灾难性任务遗忘。
AI.method: 采用统一推理流水线，结合多分支专家混合架构，将修复知识分解到专门的任务自适应专家中，支持可扩展学习、鲁棒适应未见领域和用户可控修复。
AI.result: 该方法在多个基准测试中取得优越性能，支持超过16种退化类型的学习，能够适应和泛化到未见领域，并实现跨退化类型的可控修复。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作为可扩展和可控的通用图像修复建立了新的设计范式，解决了多退化联合学习中的根本限制问题。

title: QdaVPR: A novel query-based domain-agnostic model for visual place recognition
summary: Visual place recognition (VPR) aiming at predicting the location of an image based solely on its visual features is a fundamental task in robotics and autonomous systems. Domain variation remains one of the main challenges in VPR and is relatively unexplored. Existing VPR models attempt to achieve domain agnosticism either by training on large-scale datasets that inherently contain some domain variations, or by being specifically adapted to particular target domains. In practice, the former lacks explicit domain supervision, while the latter generalizes poorly to unseen domain shifts. This paper proposes a novel query-based domain-agnostic VPR model called QdaVPR. First, a dual-level adversarial learning framework is designed to encourage domain invariance for both the query features forming the global descriptor and the image features from which these query features are derived. Then, a triplet supervision based on query combinations is designed to enhance the discriminative power of the global descriptors. To support the learning process, we augment a large-scale VPR dataset using style transfer methods, generating various synthetic domains with corresponding domain labels as auxiliary supervision. Extensive experiments show that QdaVPR achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple VPR benchmarks with significant domain variations. Specifically, it attains the best Recall@1 and Recall@10 on nearly all test scenarios: 93.5%/98.6% on Nordland (seasonal changes), 97.5%/99.0% on Tokyo24/7 (day-night transitions), and the highest Recall@1 across almost all weather conditions on the SVOX dataset. Our code will be released at https://github.com/shuimushan/QdaVPR.

AI.tldr: 提出QdaVPR模型，通过双重对抗学习和查询组合三元组监督实现跨域视觉位置识别，在季节变化、昼夜转换和天气变化等场景中达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉位置识别中的域变化是一个重要但相对未被充分探索的挑战。现有方法要么缺乏明确的域监督，要么对未见域变化的泛化能力差。
AI.method: 1. 设计双重对抗学习框架，使查询特征和图像特征都具有域不变性；2. 基于查询组合的三元组监督增强全局描述符的判别能力；3. 使用风格迁移方法增强大规模VPR数据集，生成带域标签的合成数据作为辅助监督。
AI.result: 在多个VPR基准测试中达到最先进性能：Nordland（季节变化）Recall@1/Recall@10为93.5%/98.6%；Tokyo24/7（昼夜转换）为97.5%/99.0%；在SVOX数据集的各种天气条件下Recall@1最高。
AI.conclusion: QdaVPR通过双重对抗学习和查询组合监督有效解决了VPR中的域变化问题，在多种域变化场景中表现出优越的泛化能力和识别精度。

title: Disentangled Textual Priors for Diffusion-based Image Super-Resolution
summary: Image Super-Resolution (SR) aims to reconstruct high-resolution images from degraded low-resolution inputs. While diffusion-based SR methods offer powerful generative capabilities, their performance heavily depends on how semantic priors are structured and integrated into the generation process. Existing approaches often rely on entangled or coarse-grained priors that mix global layout with local details, or conflate structural and textural cues, thereby limiting semantic controllability and interpretability. In this work, we propose DTPSR, a novel diffusion-based SR framework that introduces disentangled textual priors along two complementary dimensions: spatial hierarchy (global vs. local) and frequency semantics (low- vs. high-frequency). By explicitly separating these priors, DTPSR enables the model to simultaneously capture scene-level structure and object-specific details with frequency-aware semantic guidance. The corresponding embeddings are injected via specialized cross-attention modules, forming a progressive generation pipeline that reflects the semantic granularity of visual content, from global layout to fine-grained textures. To support this paradigm, we construct DisText-SR, a large-scale dataset containing approximately 95,000 image-text pairs with carefully disentangled global, low-frequency, and high-frequency descriptions. To further enhance controllability and consistency, we adopt a multi-branch classifier-free guidance strategy with frequency-aware negative prompts to suppress hallucinations and semantic drift. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks show that DTPSR achieves high perceptual quality, competitive fidelity, and strong generalization across diverse degradation scenarios.

AI.tldr: DTPSR是一种基于扩散模型的图像超分辨率框架，通过解耦文本先验到空间层次（全局vs局部）和频率语义（低频vs高频）两个维度，实现更好的语义控制和图像重建质量。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的超分辨率方法通常依赖纠缠或粗粒度的语义先验，这些先验混合了全局布局与局部细节，或混淆了结构和纹理线索，限制了语义可控性和可解释性。需要一种能够明确分离不同语义维度的框架。
AI.method: 提出DTPSR框架，通过解耦文本先验到两个互补维度：空间层次（全局vs局部）和频率语义（低频vs高频）。使用专门的交叉注意力模块注入相应的嵌入，形成渐进式生成流程。构建DisText-SR数据集（约95,000个图像-文本对），采用多分支无分类器引导策略和频率感知负提示来增强可控性和一致性。
AI.result: 在合成和真实世界基准测试上的广泛实验表明，DTPSR实现了高感知质量、有竞争力的保真度，并在各种退化场景下表现出强大的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: DTPSR通过解耦文本先验到空间层次和频率语义维度，显著提升了扩散基超分辨率方法的语义可控性、可解释性和生成质量，为语义引导的图像重建提供了新的框架。

title: RPG-SAM: Reliability-Weighted Prototypes and Geometric Adaptive Threshold Selection for Training-Free One-Shot Polyp Segmentation
comment: Under review at MICCAI 2026. 8 pages, 3 figures
summary: Training-free one-shot segmentation offers a scalable alternative to expert annotations where knowledge is often transferred from support images and foundation models. But existing methods often treat all pixels in support images and query response intensities models in a homogeneous way. They ignore the regional heterogeity in support images and response heterogeity in query.To resolve this, we propose RPG-SAM, a framework that systematically tackles these heterogeneity gaps. Specifically, to address regional heterogeneity, we introduce Reliability-Weighted Prototype Mining (RWPM) to prioritize high-fidelity support features while utilizing background anchors as contrastive references for noise suppression. To address response heterogeneity, we develop Geometric Adaptive Selection (GAS) to dynamically recalibrate binarization thresholds by evaluating the morphological consensus of candidates. Finally, an iterative refinement loop method is designed to polishes anatomical boundaries. By accounting for multi-layered information heterogeneity, RPG-SAM achieves a 5.56\% mIoU improvement on the Kvasir dataset. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: RPG-SAM是一个训练免费的单次分割框架，通过处理支持图像的区域异质性和查询响应的异质性，在医学图像分割中实现了更好的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有训练免费的单次分割方法通常将支持图像中的所有像素和查询响应强度模型同质化处理，忽略了支持图像的区域异质性和查询响应的异质性，这限制了分割性能。
AI.method: 提出RPG-SAM框架：1) 可靠性加权原型挖掘(RWPM)处理区域异质性，优先选择高保真支持特征，使用背景锚点作为对比参考抑制噪声；2) 几何自适应选择(GAS)处理响应异质性，通过评估候选者的形态共识动态重新校准二值化阈值；3) 迭代细化循环方法优化解剖边界。
AI.result: 在Kvasir数据集上实现了5.56%的mIoU提升，表明通过处理多层信息异质性可以显著改善分割性能。
AI.conclusion: RPG-SAM通过系统性地解决支持图像的区域异质性和查询响应的异质性，在训练免费的单次分割中取得了显著改进，为医学图像分割提供了一种可扩展的解决方案。

title: Classifying Novel 3D-Printed Objects without Retraining: Towards Post-Production Automation in Additive Manufacturing
summary: Reliable classification of 3D-printed objects is essential for automating post-production workflows in industrial additive manufacturing. Despite extensive automation in other stages of the printing pipeline, this task still relies heavily on manual inspection, as the set of objects to be classified can change daily, making frequent model retraining impractical. Automating the identification step is therefore critical for improving operational efficiency. A vision model that could classify any set of objects by utilizing their corresponding CAD models and avoiding retraining would be highly beneficial in this setting. To enable systematic evaluation of vision models on this task, we introduce ThingiPrint, a new publicly available dataset that pairs CAD models with real photographs of their 3D-printed counterparts. Using ThingiPrint, we benchmark a range of existing vision models on the task of 3D-printed object classification. We additionally show that contrastive fine-tuning with a rotation-invariant objective allows effective prototype-based classification of previously unseen 3D-printed objects. By relying solely on the available CAD models, this avoids the need for retraining when new objects are introduced. Experiments show that this approach outperforms standard pretrained baselines, suggesting improved generalization and practical relevance for real-world use.

AI.tldr: 提出ThingiPrint数据集用于3D打印物体分类，通过对比微调和旋转不变性目标实现无需重新训练的原型分类
AI.motivation: 工业3D打印后处理流程中，物体分类仍依赖人工检查，由于物体集合每日变化，频繁重新训练模型不切实际，需要能利用CAD模型进行分类且无需重新训练的视觉模型
AI.method: 引入ThingiPrint数据集（CAD模型与其实物照片配对），采用对比微调结合旋转不变性目标，实现基于原型的分类方法，仅依赖CAD模型而无需重新训练
AI.result: 提出的方法在ThingiPrint数据集上优于标准预训练基线，显示出更好的泛化能力和实际应用价值
AI.conclusion: 通过对比微调和旋转不变性目标的方法能够有效分类未见过的3D打印物体，仅使用CAD模型而无需重新训练，为工业3D打印自动化提供了实用解决方案

title: FedEU: Evidential Uncertainty-Driven Federated Fine-Tuning of Vision Foundation Models for Remote Sensing Image Segmentation
summary: Remote sensing image segmentation (RSIS) in federated environments has gained increasing attention because it enables collaborative model training across distributed datasets without sharing raw imagery or annotations. Federated RSIS combined with parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) can unleash the generalization power of pretrained foundation models for real-world applications, with minimal parameter aggregation and communication overhead. However, the dynamic adaptation of pretrained models to heterogeneous client data inevitably increases update uncertainty and compromises the reliability of collaborative optimization due to the lack of uncertainty estimation for each local model. To bridge this gap, we present FedEU, a federated optimization framework for fine-tuning RSIS models driven by evidential uncertainty. Specifically, personalized evidential uncertainty modeling is introduced to quantify epistemic variations of local models and identify high-risk areas under local data distributions. Furthermore, the client-specific feature embedding (CFE) is exploited to enhance channel-aware feature representation while preserving client-specific properties through personalized attention and an element-aware parameter update approach. These uncertainty estimates are uploaded to the server to enable adaptive global aggregation via a Top-k uncertainty-guided weighting (TUW) strategy, which mitigates the impact of distribution shifts and unreliable updates. Extensive experiments on three large-scale heterogeneous datasets demonstrate the superior performance of FedEU. More importantly, FedEU enables balanced model adaptation across diverse clients by explicitly reducing prediction uncertainty, resulting in more robust and reliable federated outcomes. The source codes will be available at https://github.com/zxk688/FedEU.

AI.tldr: FedEU是一个基于证据不确定性的联邦优化框架，用于遥感图像分割模型的微调，通过个性化不确定性建模和自适应聚合策略提升异构数据环境下的模型鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 联邦遥感图像分割结合参数高效微调虽然能利用预训练基础模型的泛化能力，但在异构客户端数据上的动态适应会增加更新不确定性，缺乏对本地模型的不确定性估计会损害协作优化的可靠性。
AI.method: 提出FedEU框架：1）引入个性化证据不确定性建模量化本地模型的认知变化并识别高风险区域；2）利用客户端特定特征嵌入增强通道感知特征表示；3）采用Top-k不确定性引导加权策略进行自适应全局聚合。
AI.result: 在三个大规模异构数据集上的广泛实验表明FedEU具有优越性能，能通过显式降低预测不确定性实现跨多样客户端的平衡模型适应，产生更鲁棒可靠的联邦学习结果。
AI.conclusion: FedEU通过证据不确定性驱动的优化框架有效解决了联邦遥感图像分割中的更新不确定性问题，提升了异构数据环境下的模型适应性和可靠性。

title: EVLF: Early Vision-Language Fusion for Generative Dataset Distillation
summary: Dataset distillation (DD) aims to synthesize compact training sets that enable models to achieve high accuracy with significantly fewer samples. Recent diffusion-based DD methods commonly introduce semantic guidance through late-stage cross-attention, where textual prompts tend to dominate the generative process. Although this strategy enforces label relevance, it diminishes the contribution of visual latents, resulting in over-corrected samples that mirror prompt patterns rather than reflecting intrinsic visual features. To solve this problem, we introduce an Early Vision-Language Fusion (EVLF) method that aligns textual and visual embeddings at the transition between the encoder and the generative backbone. By incorporating a lightweight cross-attention module at this transition, the early representations simultaneously encode local textures and global semantic directions across the denoising process. Importantly, EVLF is plug-and-play and can be easily integrated into any diffusion-based dataset distillation pipeline with an encoder. It works across different denoiser architectures and sampling schedules without any task-specific modifications. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EVLF generates semantically faithful and visually coherent synthetic data, yielding consistent improvements in downstream classification accuracy across varied settings. Source code is available at https://github.com/wenqi-cai297/earlyfusion-for-dd/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种早期视觉-语言融合方法，用于改进基于扩散的数据集蒸馏，通过在编码器和生成主干之间对齐文本和视觉嵌入，生成更具视觉特征而非过度依赖文本提示的合成数据。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的数据集蒸馏方法通常通过后期交叉注意力引入语义指导，导致文本提示主导生成过程，虽然增强了标签相关性，但削弱了视觉潜变量的贡献，产生过度校正的样本，这些样本更多反映提示模式而非内在视觉特征。
AI.method: 提出早期视觉-语言融合方法，在编码器和生成主干之间的过渡阶段对齐文本和视觉嵌入。通过在该过渡阶段引入轻量级交叉注意力模块，早期表示在去噪过程中同时编码局部纹理和全局语义方向。该方法即插即用，可轻松集成到任何带有编码器的基于扩散的数据集蒸馏流程中。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，EVLF生成语义忠实且视觉连贯的合成数据，在各种设置下对下游分类准确率带来一致改进。该方法适用于不同的去噪器架构和采样计划，无需任务特定修改。
AI.conclusion: 早期视觉-语言融合方法解决了现有扩散基数据集蒸馏中文本提示过度主导的问题，通过在编码器和生成主干之间早期对齐视觉和文本表示，生成更平衡、更具视觉特征的合成数据，提升了数据集蒸馏的效果。

title: RobustSCI: Beyond Reconstruction to Restoration for Snapshot Compressive Imaging under Real-World Degradations
summary: Deep learning algorithms for video Snapshot Compressive Imaging (SCI) have achieved great success, yet they predominantly focus on reconstructing from clean measurements. This overlooks a critical real-world challenge: the captured signal itself is often severely degraded by motion blur and low light. Consequently, existing models falter in practical applications. To break this limitation, we pioneer the first study on robust video SCI restoration, shifting the goal from "reconstruction" to "restoration"--recovering the underlying pristine scene from a degraded measurement. To facilitate this new task, we first construct a large-scale benchmark by simulating realistic, continuous degradations on the DAVIS 2017 dataset. Second, we propose RobustSCI, a network that enhances a strong encoder-decoder backbone with a novel RobustCFormer block. This block introduces two parallel branches--a multi-scale deblur branch and a frequency enhancement branch--to explicitly disentangle and remove degradations during the recovery process. Furthermore, we introduce RobustSCI-C (RobustSCI-Cascade), which integrates a pre-trained Lightweight Post-processing Deblurring Network to significantly boost restoration performance with minimal overhead. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our methods outperform all SOTA models on the new degraded testbeds, with additional validation on real-world degraded SCI data confirming their practical effectiveness, elevating SCI from merely reconstructing what is captured to restoring what truly happened.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次研究视频快照压缩成像（SCI）的鲁棒恢复问题，提出从"重建"转向"恢复"的新范式，开发了RobustSCI和RobustSCI-C模型来处理实际中的运动模糊和低光退化问题。
AI.motivation: 现有视频SCI深度学习算法主要关注从干净测量中重建，忽略了实际应用中信号常受运动模糊和低光严重退化的问题，导致现有模型在实际应用中表现不佳。
AI.method: 1. 构建大规模基准测试集：在DAVIS 2017数据集上模拟真实连续退化；2. 提出RobustSCI网络：基于强编码器-解码器骨干，引入RobustCFormer块，包含多尺度去模糊分支和频率增强分支来显式解耦和去除退化；3. 提出RobustSCI-C：集成预训练的轻量级后处理去模糊网络，以最小开销显著提升恢复性能。
AI.result: 在新建的退化测试集上，所提方法优于所有SOTA模型；在真实世界退化SCI数据上的额外验证证实了其实际有效性，将SCI从仅重建捕获内容提升到恢复真实场景。
AI.conclusion: 该研究开创了视频SCI鲁棒恢复的新方向，提出的方法成功解决了实际应用中信号退化问题，实现了从"重建"到"恢复"的范式转变，具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: DocCogito: Aligning Layout Cognition and Step-Level Grounded Reasoning for Document Understanding
summary: Document understanding with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) requires not only accurate answers but also explicit, evidence-grounded reasoning, especially in high-stakes scenarios. However, current document MLLMs still fall short of forming a complete, human-like reasoning process, because even when they improve both layout encoding and CoT-style prompting, the interaction between the two is typically learned implicitly and remains loosely coupled rather than being enforced as a systematic mechanism. So we propose DocCogito, a unified framework that integrates global layout perception with structured, region-grounded reasoning. DocCogito introduces a lightweight layout tower that distills page structure into learnable global layout prior tokens, and a deterministic Visual-Semantic Chain (VSC)-a concise structured representation less ambiguous than free-form natural-language CoT-to supervise fine-grained intermediate reasoning aligned with evidence regions. Training follows a progressive recipe, including layout perception pretraining, VSC-guided cold start, rejection sampling, and GRPO. To further strengthen the internal coupling between layout priors and VSC execution, we augment standard rewards with a fine-grained region-confidence signal that encourages reasoning traces to stay aligned with corresponding evidence regions. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks (DocVQA, WTQ, ChartQA, TextVQA, OCRBench, and InfoVQA) demonstrate strong generalization, achieving state-of-the-art results on four benchmarks.

AI.tldr: DocCogito是一个统一框架，通过全局布局感知与结构化区域推理的显式耦合，提升文档多模态大语言模型的证据基础推理能力
AI.motivation: 当前文档MLLMs在形成完整、类人推理过程方面存在不足，即使改进了布局编码和思维链提示，两者之间的交互通常是隐式学习且松散耦合，缺乏系统机制来强制证据基础推理
AI.method: 提出DocCogito框架：1) 轻量级布局塔将页面结构蒸馏为可学习的全局布局先验标记；2) 确定性视觉语义链(VSC)作为结构化表示监督细粒度中间推理；3) 渐进式训练方法；4) 添加细粒度区域置信度信号增强布局先验与VSC执行的内在耦合
AI.result: 在六个基准测试(DocVQA、WTQ、ChartQA、TextVQA、OCRBench、InfoVQA)上表现出强大的泛化能力，在四个基准上达到最先进结果
AI.conclusion: DocCogito通过显式耦合全局布局感知与结构化区域推理，显著提升了文档MLLMs的证据基础推理能力，实现了更完整、类人的推理过程

title: AMR-CCR: Anchored Modular Retrieval for Continual Chinese Character Recognition
summary: Ancient Chinese character recognition is a core capability for cultural heritage digitization, yet real-world workflows are inherently non-stationary: newly excavated materials are continuously onboarded, bringing new classes in different scripts, and expanding the class space over time. We formalize this process as Continual Chinese Character Recognition (Continual CCR), a script-staged, class-incremental setting that couples two challenges: (i) scalable learning under continual class growth with subtle inter-class differences and scarce incremental data, and (ii) pronounced intra-class diversity caused by writing-style variations across writers and carrier conditions. To overcome the limitations of conventional closed-set classification, we propose AMR-CCR, an anchored modular retrieval framework that performs recognition via embedding-based dictionary matching in a shared multimodal space, allowing new classes to be added by simply extending the dictionary. AMR-CCR further introduces a lightweight script-conditioned injection module (SIA+SAR) to calibrate newly onboarded scripts while preserving cross-stage embedding compatibility, and an image-derived multi-prototype dictionary that clusters within-class embeddings to better cover diverse style modes. To support systematic evaluation, we build EvoCON, a six-stage benchmark for continual script onboarding, covering six scripts (OBC, BI, SS, SAC, WSC, CS), augmented with meaning/shape descriptions and an explicit zero-shot split for unseen characters without image exemplars.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了AMR-CCR框架，用于解决古汉字识别中的持续学习问题，通过基于嵌入的字典匹配方法支持新字符类别的持续添加，并构建了EvoCON六阶段基准数据集进行评估。
AI.motivation: 古汉字识别是文化遗产数字化的核心能力，但实际工作流程具有非平稳性：新出土材料不断加入，带来不同字体的新字符类别，类别空间随时间扩展。现有封闭集分类方法难以应对持续类别增长、类间差异细微、增量数据稀缺以及书写风格变化带来的类内多样性等挑战。
AI.method: 提出了AMR-CCR（锚定模块化检索框架），采用基于嵌入的字典匹配方法在共享多模态空间中进行识别，允许通过简单扩展字典来添加新类别。框架包含轻量级字体条件注入模块（SIA+SAR）来校准新加入的字体同时保持跨阶段嵌入兼容性，以及图像衍生的多原型字典通过聚类类内嵌入来覆盖多样化的书写风格模式。
AI.result: 构建了EvoCON六阶段基准数据集，涵盖六种字体（OBC、BI、SS、SAC、WSC、CS），并增强含义/形状描述和明确的零样本分割用于无图像示例的未见字符。该框架在持续字体加入场景下表现出色，能够有效处理类别持续增长和书写风格多样性问题。
AI.conclusion: AMR-CCR框架为古汉字识别中的持续学习问题提供了有效解决方案，通过基于检索的方法克服了传统封闭集分类的局限性，支持新字符类别的无缝添加，并为该领域的研究建立了系统化的评估基准。

title: EvolveReason: Self-Evolving Reasoning Paradigm for Explainable Deepfake Facial Image Identification
summary: With the rapid advancement of AIGC technology, developing identification methods to address the security challenges posed by deepfakes has become urgent. Face forgery identification techniques can be categorized into two types: traditional classification methods and explainable VLM approaches. The former provides classification results but lacks explanatory ability, while the latter, although capable of providing coarse-grained explanations, often suffers from hallucinations and insufficient detail. To overcome these limitations, we propose EvolveReason, which mimics the reasoning and observational processes of human auditors when identifying face forgeries. By constructing a chain-of-thought dataset, CoT-Face, tailored for advanced VLMs, our approach guides the model to think in a human-like way, prompting it to output reasoning processes and judgment results. This provides practitioners with reliable analysis and helps alleviate hallucination. Additionally, our framework incorporates a forgery latent-space distribution capture module, enabling EvolveReason to identify high-frequency forgery cues difficult to extract from the original images. To further enhance the reliability of textual explanations, we introduce a self-evolution exploration strategy, leveraging reinforcement learning to allow the model to iteratively explore and optimize its textual descriptions in a two-stage process. Experimental results show that EvolveReason not only outperforms the current state-of-the-art methods in identification performance but also accurately identifies forgery details and demonstrates generalization capabilities.

AI.tldr: EvolveReason：一种模仿人类审计员推理过程的深度伪造人脸识别方法，通过思维链数据集和自进化探索策略提高识别性能和解释可靠性
AI.motivation: 随着AIGC技术快速发展，深度伪造带来的安全挑战日益严峻。现有的人脸伪造识别技术存在局限性：传统分类方法缺乏解释能力，而可解释的视觉语言模型方法虽然能提供粗粒度解释，但常出现幻觉和细节不足的问题。需要一种既能提供可靠识别结果又能给出详细解释的方法。
AI.method: 提出EvolveReason框架：1）构建专门为高级视觉语言模型设计的思维链数据集CoT-Face，引导模型以人类方式思考并输出推理过程和判断结果；2）包含伪造潜在空间分布捕获模块，识别原始图像中难以提取的高频伪造线索；3）引入自进化探索策略，利用强化学习让模型在两阶段过程中迭代探索和优化文本描述。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，EvolveReason不仅在识别性能上超越了当前最先进的方法，还能准确识别伪造细节并展现出良好的泛化能力。该方法为从业者提供了可靠的分析，有助于缓解幻觉问题。
AI.conclusion: EvolveReason通过模仿人类审计员的推理和观察过程，结合思维链数据集、潜在空间分布捕获和自进化探索策略，成功解决了深度伪造识别中解释能力不足和幻觉问题，为安全领域提供了一种既准确又可解释的解决方案。

title: SketchGraphNet: A Memory-Efficient Hybrid Graph Transformer for Large-Scale Sketch Corpora Recognition
summary: This work investigates large-scale sketch recognition from a graph-native perspective, where free-hand sketches are directly modeled as structured graphs rather than raster images or stroke sequences. We propose SketchGraphNet, a hybrid graph neural architecture that integrates local message passing with a memory-efficient global attention mechanism, without relying on auxiliary positional or structural encodings. To support systematic evaluation, we construct SketchGraph, a large-scale benchmark comprising 3.44 million graph-structured sketches across 344 categories, with two variants (A and R) to reflect different noise conditions. Each sketch is represented as a spatiotemporal graph with normalized stroke-order attributes. On SketchGraph-A and SketchGraph-R, SketchGraphNet achieves Top-1 accuracies of 83.62% and 87.61%, respectively, under a unified training configuration. MemEffAttn further reduces peak GPU memory by over 40% and training time by more than 30% compared with Performer-based global attention, while maintaining comparable accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该研究从图原生视角探索大规模草图识别，提出SketchGraphNet混合图神经网络架构，构建了包含344类344万张图结构草图的基准数据集SketchGraph，在两种噪声条件下分别达到83.62%和87.61%的Top-1准确率。
AI.motivation: 传统草图识别方法通常将手绘草图视为光栅图像或笔画序列，本研究从图原生视角出发，直接将自由手绘草图建模为结构化图，探索图结构表示在草图识别中的潜力。
AI.method: 提出SketchGraphNet混合图神经网络架构，整合局部消息传递与内存高效的全局注意力机制（MemEffAttn），无需依赖辅助位置或结构编码。构建SketchGraph基准数据集，包含3.44百万个图结构草图，每个草图表示为具有归一化笔画顺序属性的时空图。
AI.result: 在SketchGraph-A和SketchGraph-R两个数据集变体上，SketchGraphNet分别达到83.62%和87.61%的Top-1准确率。MemEffAttn相比基于Performer的全局注意力，峰值GPU内存减少超过40%，训练时间减少30%以上，同时保持可比准确率。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了从图原生视角处理草图识别的有效性，提出的SketchGraphNet架构在保持高性能的同时显著提升了计算效率，构建的大规模基准数据集为后续研究提供了系统评估平台。

title: How Long Can Unified Multimodal Models Generate Images Reliably? Taming Long-Horizon Interleaved Image Generation via Context Curation
summary: Unified multimodal models hold the promise of generating extensive, interleaved narratives, weaving text and imagery into coherent long-form stories. However, current systems suffer from a critical reliability gap: as sequences grow, generation quality rapidly collapses. In this work, we investigate the mechanism behind this failure and argue that it is distinct from standard long-context challenges. We reveal that in generation, accumulated visual history acts as a source of active pollution, a decay governed specifically by the number of image events rather than raw token count. We identify a structural vulnerability where dense visual tokens overwhelm the attention mechanism, creating noise that distorts future synthesis. Guided by these mechanistic insights, we propose UniLongGen, a training-free inference strategy that prioritizes safe conditioning over total recall. Instead of retaining all history, UniLongGen dynamically curates the model's memory, identifying and discarding interfering visual signals based on the model's own internal relevance rankings. Extensive experiments demonstrate that this active forgetting approach is essential for stability: UniLongGen significantly outperforms baselines in long-horizon fidelity and consistency, while simultaneously reducing memory footprint and inference time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UniLongGen方法，通过动态管理视觉历史来提升多模态长序列生成的稳定性，避免视觉信息累积污染
AI.motivation: 当前统一多模态模型在生成长序列时存在可靠性问题：随着序列增长，生成质量迅速下降。作者发现这种失败机制与标准长上下文挑战不同，视觉历史积累会主动污染后续生成
AI.method: 提出UniLongGen，一种无需训练的推理策略，通过动态管理模型记忆，基于模型内部相关性排名识别并丢弃干扰性视觉信号，实现安全条件化而非完全记忆
AI.result: 实验表明UniLongGen在长序列保真度和一致性方面显著优于基线方法，同时减少了内存占用和推理时间
AI.conclusion: 主动遗忘策略对多模态长序列生成的稳定性至关重要，视觉历史管理是解决长序列生成质量下降的关键

title: DreamSAC: Learning Hamiltonian World Models via Symmetry Exploration
summary: Learned world models excel at interpolative generalization but fail at extrapolative generalization to novel physical properties. This limitation arises because they learn statistical correlations rather than the environment's underlying generative rules, such as physical invariances and conservation laws. We argue that learning these invariances is key to robust extrapolation. To achieve this, we first introduce \textbf{Symmetry Exploration}, an unsupervised exploration strategy where an agent is intrinsically motivated by a Hamiltonian-based curiosity bonus to actively probe and challenge its understanding of conservation laws, thereby collecting physically informative data. Second, we design a Hamiltonian-based world model that learns from the collected data, using a novel self-supervised contrastive objective to identify the invariant physical state from raw, view-dependent pixel observations. Our framework, \textbf{DreamSAC}, trained on this actively curated data, significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in 3D physics simulations on tasks requiring extrapolation.

AI.tldr: DreamSAC框架通过对称性探索和哈密顿世界模型，学习物理不变性以实现外推泛化，在3D物理模拟中显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有学习的世界模型擅长内插泛化但无法外推到新的物理属性，因为它们学习的是统计相关性而非环境的生成规则（如物理不变性和守恒定律）。学习这些不变性是实现鲁棒外推的关键。
AI.method: 1. 对称性探索：基于哈密顿量的好奇心奖励的无监督探索策略，主动探测和挑战对守恒定律的理解，收集物理信息数据。2. 哈密顿世界模型：使用新颖的自监督对比目标从原始像素观测中识别不变物理状态。
AI.result: DreamSAC框架在3D物理模拟任务中，在需要外推泛化的任务上显著优于最先进的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 学习物理不变性和守恒定律是实现外推泛化的关键，通过主动探索和专门的世界模型设计可以有效学习这些不变性，从而在物理推理任务中实现更好的泛化性能。

title: PureCC: Pure Learning for Text-to-Image Concept Customization
summary: Existing concept customization methods have achieved remarkable outcomes in high-fidelity and multi-concept customization. However, they often neglect the influence on the original model's behavior and capabilities when learning new personalized concepts. To address this issue, we propose PureCC. PureCC introduces a novel decoupled learning objective for concept customization, which combines the implicit guidance of the target concept with the original conditional prediction. This separated form enables PureCC to substantially focus on the original model during training. Moreover, based on this objective, PureCC designs a dual-branch training pipeline that includes a frozen extractor providing purified target concept representations as implicit guidance and a trainable flow model producing the original conditional prediction, jointly achieving pure learning for personalized concepts. Furthermore, PureCC introduces a novel adaptive guidance scale $λ^\star$ to dynamically adjust the guidance strength of the target concept, balancing customization fidelity and model preservation. Extensive experiments show that PureCC achieves state-of-the-art performance in preserving the original behavior and capabilities while enabling high-fidelity concept customization. The code is available at https://github.com/lzc-sg/PureCC.

AI.tldr: PureCC提出了一种解耦学习目标，在保持原始模型行为的同时实现高保真概念定制
AI.motivation: 现有概念定制方法在实现高保真和多概念定制方面取得了显著成果，但往往忽视了学习新个性化概念时对原始模型行为和能力的影响
AI.method: PureCC引入解耦学习目标，结合目标概念的隐式指导和原始条件预测；设计双分支训练流程，包括提供净化目标概念表示的冻结提取器和生成原始条件预测的可训练流模型；提出自适应指导尺度λ*动态调整目标概念指导强度
AI.result: 大量实验表明，PureCC在保持原始模型行为和能力的同时，实现了高保真概念定制，达到了最先进的性能
AI.conclusion: PureCC通过解耦学习目标和双分支训练流程，有效平衡了概念定制保真度和模型保护，为个性化概念学习提供了纯净的解决方案

title: A Systematic Comparison of Training Objectives for Out-of-Distribution Detection in Image Classification
summary: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is critical in safety-sensitive applications. While this challenge has been addressed from various perspectives, the influence of training objectives on OOD behavior remains comparatively underexplored. In this paper, we present a systematic comparison of four widely used training objectives: Cross-Entropy Loss, Prototype Loss, Triplet Loss, and Average Precision (AP) Loss, spanning probabilistic, prototype-based, metric-learning, and ranking-based supervision, for OOD detection in image classification under standardized OpenOOD protocols. Across CIFAR-10/100 and ImageNet-200, we find that Cross-Entropy Loss, Prototype Loss, and AP Loss achieve comparable in-distribution accuracy, while Cross-Entropy Loss provides the most consistent near- and far-OOD performance overall; the other objectives can be competitive in specific settings.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了四种训练目标（交叉熵损失、原型损失、三元组损失和平均精度损失）在图像分类OOD检测中的表现，发现交叉熵损失在标准化OpenOOD协议下提供最一致的OOD性能。
AI.motivation: 在安全关键应用中，OOD检测至关重要。虽然已从多个角度研究此问题，但训练目标对OOD行为的影响相对较少探索。本文旨在系统比较不同训练目标在OOD检测中的表现。
