AI.method: 提出SOT-GLP方法，包含全局分支和局部分支。全局分支保持标准图像-文本匹配；局部分支使用V-V注意力构建类别条件稀疏补丁集，并通过平衡熵最优传输将其对齐到多个类别特定提示，实现补丁的软划分。
AI.result: 在11个标准基准测试的16-shot ViT-B/16设置下，SOT-GLP达到85.1%的平均准确率，优于现有提示学习方法。在OOD检测方面，无投影的局部对齐保持了CLIP流形的原生几何结构，实现了94.2% AUC的最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: SOT-GLP通过共享稀疏补丁支持和平衡最优传输分配，有效解决了提示重叠问题，在少样本分类和OOD检测方面都取得了优异性能，揭示了提示学习中准确性与鲁棒性的权衡关系。

title: $Δ$VLA: Prior-Guided Vision-Language-Action Models via World Knowledge Variation
summary: Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models have significantly advanced robotic manipulation by unifying perception, reasoning, and control. To achieve such integration, recent studies adopt a predictive paradigm that models future visual states or world knowledge to guide action generation. However, these models emphasize forecasting outcomes rather than reasoning about the underlying process of change, which is essential for determining how to act. To address this, we propose $Δ$VLA, a prior-guided framework that models world-knowledge variations relative to an explicit current-world knowledge prior for action generation, rather than regressing absolute future world states. Specifically, 1) to construct the current world knowledge prior, we propose the Prior-Guided WorldKnowledge Extractor (PWKE). It extracts manipulable regions, spatial relations, and semantic cues from the visual input, guided by auxiliary heads and prior pseudo labels, thus reducing redundancy. 2) Building upon this, to represent how world knowledge evolves under actions, we introduce the Latent World Variation Quantization (LWVQ). It learns a discrete latent space via a VQ-VAE objective to encode world knowledge variations, shifting prediction from full modalities to compact latent. 3)Moreover, to mitigate interference during variation modeling, we design the Conditional Variation Attention (CV-Atten), whichpromotes disentangled learning and preserves the independence of knowledge representations. Extensive experiments on both simulated benchmarks and real-world robotic tasks demonstrate $Δ$VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance while improving efficiency. Code and real-world execution videos are available at https://github.com/JiuTian-VL/DeltaVLA.

AI.tldr: ΔVLA提出了一种基于先验引导的视觉-语言-动作框架，通过建模世界知识变化而非预测绝对未来状态来指导动作生成，在机器人操作任务中实现了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型主要采用预测范式来建模未来视觉状态或世界知识，但这种方法强调预测结果而非推理变化过程，而理解变化过程对于确定如何行动至关重要。因此需要一种能够建模世界知识变化而非回归绝对未来状态的框架。
AI.method: 1) 提出先验引导的世界知识提取器(PWKE)，从视觉输入中提取可操作区域、空间关系和语义线索，减少冗余；2) 引入潜在世界变化量化(LWVQ)，通过VQ-VAE目标学习离散潜在空间来编码世界知识变化；3) 设计条件变化注意力(CV-Atten)来促进解耦学习并保持知识表示的独立性。
AI.result: 在模拟基准测试和真实世界机器人任务上的大量实验表明，ΔVLA实现了最先进的性能，同时提高了效率。代码和真实世界执行视频已开源。
AI.conclusion: ΔVLA通过建模世界知识变化而非预测绝对未来状态，为机器人操作任务提供了一种更有效的VLA框架，在性能和效率方面都取得了显著提升。

title: Diffusion-Based Data Augmentation for Image Recognition: A Systematic Analysis and Evaluation
summary: Diffusion-based data augmentation (DiffDA) has emerged as a promising approach to improving classification performance under data scarcity. However, existing works vary significantly in task configurations, model choices, and experimental pipelines, making it difficult to fairly compare methods or assess their effectiveness across different scenarios. Moreover, there remains a lack of systematic understanding of the full DiffDA workflow. In this work, we introduce UniDiffDA, a unified analytical framework that decomposes DiffDA methods into three core components: model fine-tuning, sample generation, and sample utilization. This perspective enables us to identify key differences among existing methods and clarify the overall design space. Building on this framework, we develop a comprehensive and fair evaluation protocol, benchmarking representative DiffDA methods across diverse low-data classification tasks. Extensive experiments reveal the relative strengths and limitations of different DiffDA strategies and offer practical insights into method design and deployment. All methods are re-implemented within a unified codebase, with full release of code and configurations to ensure reproducibility and to facilitate future research.

AI.tldr: UniDiffDA是一个统一的扩散数据增强分析框架，将DiffDA方法分解为三个核心组件，建立了公平评估协议，并提供了代码实现以促进可重复性研究。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散数据增强方法在任务配置、模型选择和实验流程上差异很大，难以公平比较，且缺乏对完整DiffDA工作流程的系统理解。
AI.method: 提出UniDiffDA统一分析框架，将DiffDA方法分解为三个核心组件：模型微调、样本生成和样本利用；建立全面的公平评估协议，在统一代码库中重新实现代表性方法。
AI.result: 通过广泛实验揭示了不同DiffDA策略的相对优势和局限性，为方法设计和部署提供了实用见解。
AI.conclusion: UniDiffDA框架澄清了DiffDA的设计空间，建立了公平比较基准，并发布了完整代码和配置以促进未来研究。

title: This Looks Distinctly Like That: Grounding Interpretable Recognition in Stiefel Geometry against Neural Collapse
summary: Prototype networks provide an intrinsic case based explanation mechanism, but their interpretability is often undermined by prototype collapse, where multiple prototypes degenerate to highly redundant evidence. We attribute this failure mode to the terminal dynamics of Neural Collapse, where cross entropy optimization suppresses intra class variance and drives class conditional features toward a low dimensional limit. To mitigate this, we propose Adaptive Manifold Prototypes (AMP), a framework that leverages Riemannian optimization on the Stiefel manifold to represent class prototypes as orthonormal bases and make rank one prototype collapse infeasible by construction. AMP further learns class specific effective rank via a proximal gradient update on a nonnegative capacity vector, and introduces spatial regularizers that reduce rotational ambiguity and encourage localized, non overlapping part evidence. Extensive experiments on fine-grained benchmarks demonstrate that AMP achieves state-of-the-art classification accuracy while significantly improving causal faithfulness over prior interpretable models.

AI.tldr: AMP框架通过黎曼优化在Stiefel流形上表示类原型为正交基，防止原型坍缩，同时学习类别特异性有效秩，提高可解释性和分类精度。
AI.motivation: 原型网络虽然提供基于案例的解释机制，但其可解释性常因原型坍缩而受损，即多个原型退化为高度冗余的证据。作者将此归因于神经坍缩的终端动力学，其中交叉熵优化抑制类内方差并将类条件特征推向低维极限。
AI.method: 提出自适应流形原型（AMP）框架：1）利用Stiefel流形上的黎曼优化将类原型表示为正交基，从构造上使秩一原型坍缩不可行；2）通过非负容量向量的近端梯度更新学习类别特异性有效秩；3）引入空间正则化器减少旋转模糊性并鼓励局部化、非重叠的部分证据。
AI.result: 在细粒度基准测试上的大量实验表明，AMP实现了最先进的分类精度，同时显著提高了相对于先前可解释模型的因果忠实度。
AI.conclusion: AMP框架通过流形优化和正则化技术有效解决了原型坍缩问题，在保持高分类精度的同时显著提升了模型的可解释性和因果忠实度。

title: Real-Time Drone Detection in Event Cameras via Per-Pixel Frequency Analysis
summary: Detecting fast-moving objects, such as unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), from event camera data is challenging due to the sparse, asynchronous nature of the input. Traditional Discrete Fourier Transforms (DFT) are effective at identifying periodic signals, such as spinning rotors, but they assume uniformly sampled data, which event cameras do not provide. We propose a novel per-pixel temporal analysis framework using the Non-uniform Discrete Fourier Transform (NDFT), which we call Drone Detection via Harmonic Fingerprinting (DDHF). Our method uses purely analytical techniques that identify the frequency signature of drone rotors, as characterized by frequency combs in their power spectra, enabling a tunable and generalizable algorithm that achieves accurate real-time localization of UAV. We compare against a YOLO detector under equivalent conditions, demonstrating improvement in accuracy and latency across a difficult array of drone speeds, distances, and scenarios. DDHF achieves an average localization F1 score of 90.89% and average latency of 2.39ms per frame, while YOLO achieves an F1 score of 66.74% and requires 12.40ms per frame. Through utilization of purely analytic techniques, DDHF is quickly tuned on small data, easily interpretable, and achieves competitive accuracies and latencies to deep learning alternatives.

AI.tldr: 提出基于非均匀离散傅里叶变换的无人机检测方法DDHF，通过分析事件相机数据中的谐波指纹实现实时无人机定位，相比YOLO在准确率和延迟方面均有显著提升。
AI.motivation: 事件相机数据稀疏异步的特性使得检测快速移动物体（如无人机）具有挑战性。传统DFT需要均匀采样数据，而事件相机无法提供这样的数据，因此需要新的分析方法。
AI.method: 提出DDHF方法，使用非均匀离散傅里叶变换进行逐像素时间分析，通过识别无人机旋翼在功率谱中的频率梳特征（谐波指纹），实现可调谐、可泛化的实时定位算法。
AI.result: DDHF平均定位F1分数达到90.89%，平均延迟为2.39ms/帧；相比之下，YOLO的F1分数为66.74%，延迟为12.40ms/帧。在不同速度、距离和场景下均表现出更好的准确性和实时性。
AI.conclusion: DDHF通过纯分析技术实现了快速调谐、易于解释的无人机检测方案，在准确性和延迟方面与深度学习替代方案相比具有竞争力，特别适合事件相机数据的实时处理。

title: AULLM++: Structural Reasoning with Large Language Models for Micro-Expression Recognition
summary: Micro-expression Action Unit (AU) detection identifies localized AUs from subtle facial muscle activations, providing a foundation for decoding affective cues. Previous methods face three key limitations: (1) heavy reliance on low-density visual information, rendering discriminative evidence vulnerable to background noise; (2) coarse-grained feature processing that misaligns with the demand for fine-grained representations; and (3) neglect of inter-AU correlations, restricting the parsing of complex expression patterns. We propose AULLM++, a reasoning-oriented framework leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), which injects visual features into textual prompts as actionable semantic premises to guide inference. It formulates AU prediction into three stages: evidence construction, structure modeling, and deduction-based prediction. Specifically, a Multi-Granularity Evidence-Enhanced Fusion Projector (MGE-EFP) fuses mid-level texture cues with high-level semantics, distilling them into a compact Content Token (CT). Furthermore, inspired by micro- and macro-expression AU correspondence, we encode AU relationships as a sparse structural prior and learn interaction strengths via a Relation-Aware AU Graph Neural Network (R-AUGNN), producing an Instruction Token (IT). We then fuse CT and IT into a structured textual prompt and introduce Counterfactual Consistency Regularization (CCR) to construct counterfactual samples, enhancing the model's generalization. Extensive experiments demonstrate AULLM++ achieves state-of-the-art performance on standard benchmarks and exhibits superior cross-domain generalization.

AI.tldr: AULLM++：基于大语言模型的微表情动作单元检测框架，通过多粒度证据融合和关系感知图神经网络，结合反事实一致性正则化，实现细粒度AU识别和跨域泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有微表情AU检测方法存在三个主要问题：过度依赖低密度视觉信息易受背景噪声影响；粗粒度特征处理不符合细粒度表示需求；忽视AU间相关性限制复杂表情模式解析。
AI.method: 提出AULLM++框架，包含三个阶段：证据构建、结构建模和推理预测。使用MGE-EFP融合多粒度特征生成内容令牌；通过R-AUGNN编码AU关系生成指令令牌；结合反事实一致性正则化增强泛化能力。
AI.result: 在标准基准测试中达到最先进性能，并展现出优异的跨域泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: AULLM++通过将视觉特征注入文本提示作为语义前提，结合图神经网络建模AU关系，有效解决了现有方法的局限性，为微表情AU检测提供了新的解决方案。

title: SPIRAL: A Closed-Loop Framework for Self-Improving Action World Models via Reflective Planning Agents
summary: We introduce SPIRAL, a self-improving planning and iterative reflective action world modeling closed-loop framework that enables controllable long-horizon video generation conditioned on high-level semantic actions. Existing one-shot video generation models operate in open-loop, often resulting in incomplete action execution, weak semantic grounding, and temporal drift. SPIRAL formulates ActWM as a closed-loop think-act-reflect process, where generation proceeds step by step under explicit planning and feedback. A PlanAgent decomposes abstract actions into object-centric sub-actions, while a CriticAgent evaluates intermediate results and guides iterative refinement with long-horizon memory. This closed-loop design naturally supports RL evolving optimization, improving semantic alignment and temporal consistency over extended horizons. We further introduce the ActWM-Dataset and ActWM-Bench for training and evaluation. Experiments across multiple TI2V backbones demonstrate consistent gains on ActWM-Bench and mainstream video generation benchmarks, validating SPIRAL's effectiveness.

AI.tldr: SPIRAL是一个自改进的规划与迭代反思动作世界建模闭环框架，用于基于高级语义动作的可控长时程视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现有的一次性视频生成模型在开环中运行，常导致动作执行不完整、语义基础薄弱和时间漂移问题。
AI.method: SPIRAL将动作世界建模(ActWM)构建为闭环的思考-行动-反思过程，通过PlanAgent将抽象动作分解为以对象为中心的子动作，CriticAgent评估中间结果并通过长时程记忆指导迭代优化。
AI.result: 在多个文本到视频(TI2V)骨干网络上进行实验，在ActWM-Bench和主流视频生成基准测试中均获得一致性能提升。
AI.conclusion: SPIRAL的闭环设计自然支持强化学习演化优化，在长时程视频生成中提高了语义对齐和时间一致性。

title: Information Maximization for Long-Tailed Semi-Supervised Domain Generalization
summary: Semi-supervised domain generalization (SSDG) has recently emerged as an appealing alternative to tackle domain generalization when labeled data is scarce but unlabeled samples across domains are abundant. In this work, we identify an important limitation that hampers the deployment of state-of-the-art methods on more challenging but practical scenarios. In particular, state-of-the-art SSDG severely suffers in the presence of long-tailed class distributions, an arguably common situation in real-world settings. To alleviate this limitation, we propose IMaX, a simple yet effective objective based on the well-known InfoMax principle adapted to the SSDG scenario, where the Mutual Information (MI) between the learned features and latent labels is maximized, constrained by the supervision from the labeled samples. Our formulation integrates an α-entropic objective, which mitigates the class-balance bias encoded in the standard marginal entropy term of the MI, thereby better handling arbitrary class distributions. IMaX can be seamlessly plugged into recent state-of-the-art SSDG, consistently enhancing their performance, as demonstrated empirically across two different image modalities.

AI.tldr: IMaX：一种基于InfoMax原理的简单有效目标，用于解决半监督域泛化中的长尾类别分布问题，通过最大化特征与潜在标签的互信息，结合α-熵目标缓解类别平衡偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有半监督域泛化方法在面临实际场景中常见的长尾类别分布时性能严重下降，需要一种能够处理任意类别分布的方法。
AI.method: 提出IMaX方法，基于InfoMax原理，最大化学习特征与潜在标签之间的互信息，同时引入α-熵目标来缓解标准边缘熵项中的类别平衡偏差。
AI.result: IMaX能够无缝集成到现有的半监督域泛化方法中，在两个不同的图像模态上实验证明，能够持续提升这些方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: IMaX是一种简单有效的解决方案，能够缓解半监督域泛化中的长尾类别分布问题，提升现有方法在实际场景中的适用性。

title: Alfa: Attentive Low-Rank Filter Adaptation for Structure-Aware Cross-Domain Personalized Gaze Estimation
summary:
Pre-trained gaze models learn to identify useful patterns commonly found across users, but subtle user-specific variations (i.e., eyelid shape or facial structure) can degrade model performance. Test-time personalization (TTP) adapts pre-trained models to these user-specific domain shifts using only a few unlabeled samples. Efficient fine-tuning is critical in performing this domain adaptation: data and computation resources can be limited-especially for on-device customization. While popular parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods address adaptation costs by updating only a small set of weights, they may not be taking full advantage of structures encoded in pre-trained filters. To more effectively leverage existing structures learned during pre-training, we reframe personalization as a process to reweight existing features rather than learning entirely new ones.
  We present Attentive Low-Rank Filter Adaptation (Alfa) to adapt gaze models by reweighting semantic patterns in pre-trained filters. With Alfa, singular value decomposition (SVD) extracts dominant spatial components that capture eye and facial characteristics across users. Via an attention mechanism, we need only a few unlabeled samples to adjust and reweight pre-trained structures, selectively amplifying those relevant to a target user. Alfa achieves the lowest average gaze errors across four cross-dataset gaze benchmarks, outperforming existing TTP methods and low-rank adaptation (LoRA)-based variants. We also show that Alfa's attentive low-rank methods can be applied to applications beyond vision, such as diffusion-based language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Alfa方法，通过注意力机制重加权预训练滤波器的语义模式来实现视线模型的个性化适配，在跨数据集视线基准测试中表现最优。
AI.motivation: 预训练的视线模型能学习跨用户的通用模式，但用户特定的细微差异（如眼睑形状或面部结构）会降低模型性能。现有的参数高效微调方法虽然减少了计算成本，但未能充分利用预训练滤波器中的编码结构。
AI.method: 提出Attentive Low-Rank Filter Adaptation (Alfa)方法：1) 使用奇异值分解提取预训练滤波器中的主要空间成分；2) 通过注意力机制，仅用少量无标签样本调整和重加权预训练结构，选择性放大与目标用户相关的特征。
AI.result: Alfa在四个跨数据集视线基准测试中实现了最低的平均视线误差，优于现有的测试时个性化方法和基于LoRA的变体。该方法还可应用于视觉之外的领域，如基于扩散的语言模型。
AI.conclusion: 将个性化重新定义为重加权现有特征而非学习全新特征的过程，能更有效地利用预训练期间学习到的结构，实现更高效的测试时个性化适配。

title: Global Cross-Modal Geo-Localization: A Million-Scale Dataset and a Physical Consistency Learning Framework
summary: Cross-modal Geo-localization (CMGL) matches ground-level text descriptions with geo-tagged aerial imagery, which is crucial for pedestrian navigation and emergency response. However, existing researches are constrained by narrow geographic coverage and simplistic scene diversity, failing to reflect the immense spatial heterogeneity of global architectural styles and topographic features. To bridge this gap and facilitate universal positioning, we introduce CORE, the first million-scale dataset dedicated to global CMGL. CORE comprises 1,034,786 cross-view images sampled from 225 distinct geographic regions across all continents, offering an unprecedented variety of perspectives in varying environmental conditions and urban layouts. We leverage the zero-shot reasoning of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) to synthesize high-quality scene descriptions rich in discriminative cues. Furthermore, we propose a physical-law-aware network (PLANET) for cross-modal geo-localization. PLANET introduces a novel contrastive learning paradigm to guide textual representations in capturing the intrinsic physical signatures of satellite imagery. Extensive experiments across varied geographic regions demonstrate that PLANet significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, establishing a new benchmark for robust, global-scale geo-localization. The dataset and source code will be released at https://github.com/YtH0823/CORE.

AI.tldr: 提出了CORE数据集和PLANET模型，用于解决跨模态地理定位中地理覆盖范围窄和场景多样性不足的问题，实现了百万级规模的全球地理定位。
AI.motivation: 现有跨模态地理定位研究受限于狭窄的地理覆盖范围和简单的场景多样性，无法反映全球建筑风格和地形特征的巨大空间异质性，需要构建大规模数据集和更有效的模型来实现全球范围的精确定位。
AI.method: 1) 构建CORE数据集：包含103万张跨视角图像，覆盖全球225个不同地理区域；2) 利用大型视觉语言模型的零样本推理能力合成高质量场景描述；3) 提出物理定律感知网络PLANET，采用新颖的对比学习范式，引导文本表示捕捉卫星图像的内在物理特征。
AI.result: PLANET模型在不同地理区域的广泛实验中显著优于现有最先进方法，为稳健的全球尺度地理定位建立了新的基准。
AI.conclusion: CORE数据集和PLANET模型为跨模态地理定位提供了首个百万级规模的全球数据集和有效的物理感知学习方法，推动了全球范围精确定位技术的发展。

title: Reading $\neq$ Seeing: Diagnosing and Closing the Typography Gap in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models achieve near-perfect accuracy at reading text in images, yet prove largely typography-blind: capable of recognizing what text says, but not how it looks. We systematically investigate this gap by evaluating font family, size, style, and color recognition across 26 fonts, four scripts, and three difficulty levels. Our evaluation of 15 state-of-the-art VLMs reveals a striking perception hierarchy: color recognition is near-perfect, yet font style detection remains universally poor. We further find that model scale fails to predict performance and that accuracy is uniform across difficulty levels, together pointing to a training-data omission rather than a capacity ceiling. LoRA fine-tuning on a small set of synthetic samples substantially improves an open-source model, narrowing the gap to the best closed-source system and surpassing it on font size recognition. Font style alone remains resistant to fine-tuning, suggesting that relational visual reasoning may require architectural innovation beyond current patch-based encoders. We release our evaluation framework, data, and fine-tuning recipe to support progress in closing the typographic gap in vision-language understanding.

AI.tldr: 视觉语言模型在识别图像中文本内容方面接近完美，但在识别文本外观（字体、大小、样式、颜色）方面存在显著盲点，尤其是字体样式识别最差
AI.motivation: 研究视觉语言模型在识别文本外观特征方面的能力差距，这些模型虽然能准确读取文本内容，但对文本的视觉呈现形式（字体样式等）感知能力有限
AI.method: 系统评估26种字体、4种文字脚本、3个难度级别下的字体家族、大小、样式和颜色识别能力，测试15个最先进的视觉语言模型，并使用LoRA微调在合成样本上改进模型
AI.result: 发现感知层次：颜色识别接近完美，但字体样式检测普遍较差；模型规模不能预测性能；LoRA微调显著提升开源模型性能，缩小与闭源系统差距，但字体样式识别仍难以改善
AI.conclusion: 视觉语言模型存在排版盲点，主要是训练数据缺失而非能力限制；字体样式识别可能需要超越当前基于补丁编码器的架构创新；发布了评估框架、数据和微调方案以推动进展

title: All Vehicles Can Lie: Efficient Adversarial Defense in Fully Untrusted-Vehicle Collaborative Perception via Pseudo-Random Bayesian Inference
summary: Collaborative perception (CP) enables multiple vehicles to augment their individual perception capacities through the exchange of feature-level sensory data. However, this fusion mechanism is inherently vulnerable to adversarial attacks, especially in fully untrusted-vehicle environments. Existing defense approaches often assume a trusted ego vehicle as a reference or incorporate additional binary classifiers. These assumptions limit their practicality in real-world deployments due to the questionable trustworthiness of ego vehicles, the requirement for real-time detection, and the need for generalizability across diverse scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose a novel Pseudo-Random Bayesian Inference (PRBI) framework, a first efficient defense method tailored for fully untrusted-vehicle CP. PRBI detects adversarial behavior by leveraging temporal perceptual discrepancies, using the reliable perception from the preceding frame as a dynamic reference. Additionally, it employs a pseudo-random grouping strategy that requires only two verifications per frame, while applying Bayesian inference to estimate both the number and identities of malicious vehicles. Theoretical analysis has proven the convergence and stability of the proposed PRBI framework. Extensive experiments show that PRBI requires only 2.5 verifications per frame on average, outperforming existing methods significantly, and restores detection precision to between 79.4% and 86.9% of pre-attack levels.

AI.tldr: PRBI框架是针对完全不可信车辆协同感知环境的首个高效防御方法，通过时间感知差异和伪随机分组策略检测对抗攻击，仅需平均每帧2.5次验证即可恢复79.4%-86.9%的检测精度。
AI.motivation: 协同感知通过特征级数据交换增强车辆感知能力，但在完全不可信车辆环境中极易受到对抗攻击。现有防御方法通常假设可信的自我车辆作为参考或使用额外的二元分类器，这些假设在实际部署中存在局限性，包括自我车辆可信度问题、实时检测需求以及跨场景泛化能力不足。
AI.method: 提出伪随机贝叶斯推理（PRBI）框架：1）利用时间感知差异检测对抗行为，使用前一帧的可靠感知作为动态参考；2）采用伪随机分组策略，每帧仅需两次验证；3）应用贝叶斯推理估计恶意车辆的数量和身份。
AI.result: 理论分析证明了PRBI框架的收敛性和稳定性。实验表明，PRBI平均每帧仅需2.5次验证，显著优于现有方法，并将检测精度恢复到攻击前水平的79.4%至86.9%。
AI.conclusion: PRBI是针对完全不可信车辆协同感知环境的高效防御框架，通过创新的时间参考和伪随机分组策略解决了现有方法的局限性，在保持实时性的同时有效恢复了感知精度。

title: Improving Continual Learning for Gaussian Splatting based Environments Reconstruction on Commercial Off-the-Shelf Edge Devices
summary: Novel view synthesis (NVS) is increasingly relevant for edge robotics, where compact and incrementally updatable 3D scene models are needed for SLAM, navigation, and inspection under tight memory and latency budgets. Variational Bayesian Gaussian Splatting (VBGS) enables replay-free continual updates for the 3DGS algorithm by maintaining a probabilistic scene model, but its high-precision computations and large intermediate tensors make on-device training impractical. We present a precision-adaptive optimization framework that enables VBGS training on resource-constrained hardware without altering its variational formulation. We (i) profile VBGS to identify memory/latency hotspots, (ii) fuse memory-dominant kernels to reduce materialized intermediate tensors, and (iii) automatically assign operation-level precisions via a mixed-precision search with bounded relative error. Across the Blender, Habitat, and Replica datasets, our optimised pipeline reduces peak memory from 9.44 GB to 1.11 GB and training time from ~234 min to ~61 min on an A5000 GPU, while preserving (and in some cases improving) reconstruction quality of the state-of-the-art VBGS baseline. We also enable for the first time NVS training on a commercial embedded platform, the Jetson Orin Nano, reducing per-frame latency by 19x compared to 3DGS.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种精度自适应优化框架，使变分贝叶斯高斯泼溅（VBGS）能够在资源受限的硬件上进行训练，大幅减少内存占用和训练时间，同时保持重建质量。
AI.motivation: 边缘机器人需要紧凑且可增量更新的3D场景模型用于SLAM、导航和检测，但VBGS的高精度计算和大中间张量使其在设备上训练不切实际。
AI.method: 通过(i)分析VBGS的内存/延迟热点，(ii)融合内存主导的内核以减少中间张量，(iii)使用有界相对误差的混合精度搜索自动分配操作级精度。
AI.result: 在Blender、Habitat和Replica数据集上，优化后的流水线将峰值内存从9.44GB降至1.11GB，训练时间从约234分钟降至约61分钟，同时保持（有时甚至提升）重建质量。
AI.conclusion: 该精度自适应优化框架使VBGS能够在资源受限的硬件上高效训练，首次在Jetson Orin Nano等商业嵌入式平台上实现NVS训练，相比3DGS将每帧延迟降低了19倍。

title: Spherical-GOF: Geometry-Aware Panoramic Gaussian Opacity Fields for 3D Scene Reconstruction
comment: The source code and dataset will be released at https://github.com/1170632760/Spherical-GOF
summary: Omnidirectional images are increasingly used in robotics and vision due to their wide field of view. However, extending 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) to panoramic camera models remains challenging, as existing formulations are designed for perspective projections and naive adaptations often introduce distortion and geometric inconsistencies. We present Spherical-GOF, an omnidirectional Gaussian rendering framework built upon Gaussian Opacity Fields (GOF). Unlike projection-based rasterization, Spherical-GOF performs GOF ray sampling directly on the unit sphere in spherical ray space, enabling consistent ray-Gaussian interactions for panoramic rendering. To make the spherical ray casting efficient and robust, we derive a conservative spherical bounding rule for fast ray-Gaussian culling and introduce a spherical filtering scheme that adapts Gaussian footprints to distortion-varying panoramic pixel sampling. Extensive experiments on standard panoramic benchmarks (OmniBlender and OmniPhotos) demonstrate competitive photometric quality and substantially improved geometric consistency. Compared with the strongest baseline, Spherical-GOF reduces depth reprojection error by 57% and improves cycle inlier ratio by 21%. Qualitative results show cleaner depth and more coherent normal maps, with strong robustness to global panorama rotations. We further validate generalization on OmniRob, a real-world robotic omnidirectional dataset introduced in this work, featuring UAV and quadruped platforms. The source code and the OmniRob dataset will be released at https://github.com/1170632760/Spherical-GOF.

AI.tldr: Spherical-GOF：基于高斯不透明度场的全景高斯渲染框架，通过球面射线采样解决传统方法在全景相机模型中的失真和几何不一致问题
AI.motivation: 全景图像在机器人和视觉领域应用广泛，但现有的3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）方法主要针对透视投影设计，直接适配全景相机模型会导致失真和几何不一致问题
AI.method: 1. 在球面射线空间中进行GOF射线采样；2. 推导保守的球面边界规则用于快速射线-高斯剔除；3. 引入球面滤波方案，根据失真变化的全景像素采样自适应调整高斯足迹
AI.result: 在标准全景基准测试（OmniBlender和OmniPhotos）上表现出竞争力的光度质量和显著改善的几何一致性：深度重投影误差减少57%，循环内点比率提高21%；在真实世界机器人全景数据集OmniRob上验证了泛化能力
AI.conclusion: Spherical-GOF为全景相机模型提供了高效且几何一致的高斯渲染框架，解决了现有方法在全景场景中的失真问题，在机器人和视觉应用中具有实用价值

title: SecAgent: Efficient Mobile GUI Agent with Semantic Context
summary: Mobile Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents powered by multimodal large language models have demonstrated promising capabilities in automating complex smartphone tasks. However, existing approaches face two critical limitations: the scarcity of high-quality multilingual datasets, particularly for non-English ecosystems, and inefficient history representation methods. To address these challenges, we present SecAgent, an efficient mobile GUI agent at 3B scale. We first construct a human-verified Chinese mobile GUI dataset with 18k grounding samples and 121k navigation steps across 44 applications, along with a Chinese navigation benchmark featuring multi-choice action annotations. Building upon this dataset, we propose a semantic context mechanism that distills history screenshots and actions into concise, natural language summaries, significantly reducing computational costs while preserving task-relevant information. Through supervised and reinforcement fine-tuning, SecAgent outperforms similar-scale baselines and achieves performance comparable to 7B-8B models on our and public navigation benchmarks. We will open-source the training dataset, benchmark, model, and code to advance research in multilingual mobile GUI automation.

AI.tldr: SecAgent是一个3B规模的移动GUI代理，通过构建中文数据集和语义上下文机制，在移动界面自动化任务中超越了同规模基线，性能接近7B-8B模型。
AI.motivation: 现有移动GUI代理面临两个关键限制：高质量多语言数据集稀缺（特别是非英语生态系统），以及历史表示方法效率低下。这些问题阻碍了移动GUI自动化在多语言环境中的发展。
AI.method: 1. 构建人工验证的中文移动GUI数据集（18k grounding样本，121k导航步骤，44个应用）和中文导航基准；2. 提出语义上下文机制，将历史截图和动作提炼为简洁的自然语言摘要；3. 通过监督和强化微调训练模型。
AI.result: SecAgent在相同规模基线中表现优异，在作者构建的中文基准和公共导航基准上，性能可媲美7B-8B规模模型。语义上下文机制显著降低了计算成本，同时保留了任务相关信息。
AI.conclusion: SecAgent通过高质量中文数据集和高效的语义上下文机制，成功解决了多语言移动GUI自动化的关键挑战。作者承诺开源数据集、基准、模型和代码，将推动多语言移动GUI自动化研究的发展。

title: SWIFT: Sliding Window Reconstruction for Few-Shot Training-Free Generated Video Attribution
summary: Recent advancements in video generation technologies have been significant, resulting in their widespread application across multiple domains. However, concerns have been mounting over the potential misuse of generated content. Tracing the origin of generated videos has become crucial to mitigate potential misuse and identify responsible parties. Existing video attribution methods require additional operations or the training of source attribution models, which may degrade video quality or necessitate large amounts of training samples. To address these challenges, we define for the first time the "few-shot training-free generated video attribution" task and propose SWIFT, which is tightly integrated with the temporal characteristics of the video. By leveraging the "Pixel Frames(many) to Latent Frame(one)" temporal mapping within each video chunk, SWIFT applies a fixed-length sliding window to perform two distinct reconstructions: normal and corrupted. The variation in the losses between two reconstructions is then used as an attribution signal. We conducted an extensive evaluation of five state-of-the-art (SOTA) video generation models. Experimental results show that SWIFT achieves over 90% average attribution accuracy with merely 20 video samples across all models and even enables zero-shot attribution for HunyuanVideo, EasyAnimate, and Wan2.2. Our source code is available at https://github.com/wangchao0708/SWIFT.

AI.tldr: SWIFT是一种无需训练、只需少量样本的视频生成溯源方法，通过利用视频时间特性，在正常和损坏重建之间的损失差异作为溯源信号，在5个SOTA视频生成模型上达到90%以上平均准确率。
AI.motivation: 随着视频生成技术的快速发展，生成内容可能被滥用，溯源变得至关重要。现有视频溯源方法需要额外操作或训练溯源模型，可能降低视频质量或需要大量训练样本。
AI.method: 首次定义"few-shot training-free generated video attribution"任务，提出SWIFT方法，利用视频块内"像素帧到潜在帧"的时间映射，通过固定长度滑动窗口执行正常和损坏两种重建，利用两种重建损失的变化作为溯源信号。
AI.result: 在5个SOTA视频生成模型上评估，仅用20个视频样本就达到超过90%的平均溯源准确率，对HunyuanVideo、EasyAnimate和Wan2.2甚至实现零样本溯源。
AI.conclusion: SWIFT是一种高效、无需训练的视频生成溯源方法，仅需少量样本就能准确识别视频来源，为解决生成视频滥用问题提供了实用解决方案。

title: Online Sparse Synthetic Aperture Radar Imaging
summary: With modern defense applications increasingly relying on inexpensive, autonomous drones, lies the major challenge of designing computationally and memory-efficient onboard algorithms to fulfill mission objectives. This challenge is particularly significant in Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR), where large volumes of data must be collected and processed for downstream tasks. We propose an online reconstruction method, the Online Fast Iterative Shrinkage-Thresholding Algorithm (Online FISTA), which incrementally reconstructs a scene with limited data through sparse coding. Rather than requiring storage of all received signal data, the algorithm recursively updates storage matrices for each iteration, greatly reducing memory demands. Online SAR image reconstruction facilitates more complex downstream tasks, such as Automatic Target Recognition (ATR), in an online manner, resulting in a more versatile and integrated framework compared to existing post-collection reconstruction and ATR approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出Online FISTA算法用于SAR在线图像重建，通过稀疏编码增量重建场景，大幅减少内存需求，支持下游任务如ATR的在线处理。
AI.motivation: 现代防御应用依赖廉价自主无人机，但面临计算和内存效率的挑战，特别是在SAR中需要处理大量数据。现有方法需要存储所有信号数据，内存需求大，无法支持在线处理。
AI.method: 提出Online FISTA算法，基于稀疏编码进行增量式场景重建。算法递归更新存储矩阵而不是存储所有接收信号数据，大大降低内存需求。支持在线SAR图像重建。
AI.result: 算法显著减少了内存需求，实现了在线SAR图像重建能力。这使得更复杂的下游任务如自动目标识别(ATR)可以在线进行，相比现有的采集后重建和ATR方法提供了更通用和集成的框架。
AI.conclusion: Online FISTA算法为SAR图像重建提供了内存高效的在线解决方案，支持下游任务的实时处理，为自主无人机防御应用提供了更集成的处理框架。

title: CARE-Edit: Condition-Aware Routing of Experts for Contextual Image Editing
comment: Accepted by CVPR 2026. Project page: https://care-edit.github.io/
summary: Unified diffusion editors often rely on a fixed, shared backbone for diverse tasks, suffering from task interference and poor adaptation to heterogeneous demands (e.g., local vs global, semantic vs photometric). In particular, prevalent ControlNet and OmniControl variants combine multiple conditioning signals (e.g., text, mask, reference) via static concatenation or additive adapters which cannot dynamically prioritize or suppress conflicting modalities, thus resulting in artifacts like color bleeding across mask boundaries, identity or style drift, and unpredictable behavior under multi-condition inputs. To address this, we propose Condition-Aware Routing of Experts (CARE-Edit) that aligns model computation with specific editing competencies. At its core, a lightweight latent-attention router assigns encoded diffusion tokens to four specialized experts--Text, Mask, Reference, and Base--based on multi-modal conditions and diffusion timesteps: (i) a Mask Repaint module first refines coarse user-defined masks for precise spatial guidance; (ii) the router applies sparse top-K selection to dynamically allocate computation to the most relevant experts; (iii) a Latent Mixture module subsequently fuses expert outputs, coherently integrating semantic, spatial, and stylistic information to the base images. Experiments validate CARE-Edit's strong performance on contextual editing tasks, including erasure, replacement, text-driven edits, and style transfer. Empirical analysis further reveals task-specific behavior of specialized experts, showcasing the importance of dynamic, condition-aware processing to mitigate multi-condition conflicts.

AI.tldr: CARE-Edit提出条件感知专家路由机制，通过动态分配计算给四个专门专家（文本、掩码、参考、基础）来解决统一扩散编辑器中多条件冲突问题
AI.motivation: 现有统一扩散编辑器使用固定共享主干处理多样化任务，存在任务干扰和异构需求适应不良问题，特别是ControlNet和OmniControl变体通过静态拼接或加法适配器组合多条件信号，无法动态优先或抑制冲突模态，导致跨掩码边界颜色渗透、身份或风格漂移等问题
AI.method: 提出条件感知专家路由（CARE-Edit），核心是轻量级潜在注意力路由器，基于多模态条件和扩散时间步将编码的扩散令牌分配给四个专门专家：文本、掩码、参考、基础专家。包含掩码重绘模块细化用户定义掩码，路由器应用稀疏top-K选择动态分配计算给最相关专家，潜在混合模块融合专家输出
AI.result: 实验验证CARE-Edit在上下文编辑任务（擦除、替换、文本驱动编辑、风格迁移）上的强大性能。实证分析揭示了专门专家的任务特定行为，展示了动态条件感知处理对缓解多条件冲突的重要性
AI.conclusion: 通过条件感知专家路由机制，CARE-Edit能够更好地处理多条件编辑任务，避免传统方法中的冲突和伪影问题，为扩散模型编辑提供了更灵活和精确的解决方案

title: PRISM: Streaming Human Motion Generation with Per-Joint Latent Decomposition
summary:
Text-to-motion generation has advanced rapidly, yet two challenges persist. First, existing motion autoencoders compress each frame into a single monolithic latent vector, entangling trajectory and per-joint rotations in an unstructured representation that downstream generators struggle to model faithfully. Second, text-to-motion, pose-conditioned generation, and long-horizon sequential synthesis typically require separate models or task-specific mechanisms, with autoregressive approaches suffering from severe error accumulation over extended rollouts.
  We present PRISM, addressing each challenge with a dedicated contribution. (1) A joint-factorized motion latent space: each body joint occupies its own token, forming a structured 2D grid (time
  joints) compressed by a causal VAE with forward-kinematics supervision. This simple change to the latent space -- without modifying the generator -- substantially improves generation quality, revealing that latent space design has been an underestimated bottleneck. (2) Noise-free condition injection: each latent token carries its own timestep embedding, allowing conditioning frames to be injected as clean tokens (timestep0) while the remaining tokens are denoised. This unifies text-to-motion and pose-conditioned generation in a single model, and directly enables autoregressive segment chaining for streaming synthesis. Self-forcing training further suppresses drift in long rollouts. With these two components, we train a single motion generation foundation model that seamlessly handles text-to-motion, pose-conditioned generation, autoregressive sequential generation, and narrative motion composition, achieving state-of-the-art on HumanML3D, MotionHub, BABEL, and a 50-scenario user study.

AI.tldr: PRISM提出了一种新的运动生成框架，通过关节分解的潜在空间设计和无噪声条件注入，统一处理文本到运动、姿态条件生成和长序列合成等多种任务，在多个基准测试中达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有运动生成方法存在两个主要问题：1）运动自编码器将每帧压缩为单一潜在向量，导致轨迹和关节旋转纠缠在非结构化表示中，下游生成器难以准确建模；2）不同任务（文本到运动、姿态条件生成、长序列合成）需要单独模型或特定机制，自回归方法在长序列中误差累积严重。
AI.method: PRISM包含两个核心创新：1）关节分解的运动潜在空间：每个身体关节占据独立token，形成时间×关节的2D网格结构，通过因果VAE压缩并加入前向运动学监督；2）无噪声条件注入：每个潜在token携带自己的时间步嵌入，允许将条件帧作为干净token注入（时间步0），其余token进行去噪处理，支持自强迫训练抑制长序列漂移。
AI.result: PRISM在HumanML3D、MotionHub、BABEL等多个基准测试中达到最先进水平，在50个场景的用户研究中表现优异。该方法能够无缝处理文本到运动、姿态条件生成、自回归序列生成和叙事运动组合等多种任务。
AI.conclusion: PRISM通过重新设计潜在空间结构和条件注入机制，解决了运动生成中的关键瓶颈，展示了潜在空间设计的重要性，并提供了一个统一的运动生成基础模型，显著提升了生成质量和任务适应性。

title: Boosting MLLM Spatial Reasoning with Geometrically Referenced 3D Scene Representations
summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable success in 2D visual understanding, their ability to reason about 3D space remains limited. To address this gap, we introduce geometrically referenced 3D scene representations (GR3D). Given a set of input images, GR3D annotates objects in the images with unique IDs and encodes their 3D geometric attributes as textual references indexed by these IDs. This representation enables MLLMs to interpret 3D cues using their advanced language-based skills in mathematical reasoning, while concurrently analyzing 2D visual features in a tightly coupled way. We present a simple yet effective approach based on GR3D, which requires no additional training and is readily applicable to different MLLMs. Implemented in a zero-shot setting, our approach boosts GPT-5's performance on VSI-Bench by 8% overall and more than 11% on tasks that rely heavily on spatial layout understanding. Qualitative studies further demonstrate that GR3D empowers MLLMs to perform complex spatial reasoning with highly sparse input views.

AI.tldr: GR3D是一种几何参考的3D场景表示方法，通过为图像中的物体分配唯一ID并编码其3D几何属性作为文本参考，使多模态大语言模型能够利用其语言推理能力进行3D空间理解，无需额外训练即可提升MLLMs的3D推理性能。
AI.motivation: 虽然多模态大语言模型在2D视觉理解方面取得了显著成功，但在3D空间推理能力方面仍然有限。现有的MLLMs缺乏有效的3D场景理解机制，这限制了它们在需要空间布局理解的任务上的表现。
AI.method: 提出GR3D（几何参考的3D场景表示）方法：为输入图像中的物体分配唯一ID，并将它们的3D几何属性编码为基于这些ID索引的文本参考。这种方法使MLLMs能够利用其语言推理能力解释3D线索，同时紧密耦合地分析2D视觉特征。该方法无需额外训练，可直接应用于不同的MLLMs。
AI.result: 在零样本设置下，该方法将GPT-5在VSI-Bench上的整体性能提升了8%，在依赖空间布局理解的任务上提升了超过11%。定性研究表明，GR3D使MLLMs能够在高度稀疏的输入视图下执行复杂的空间推理。
AI.conclusion: GR3D提供了一种简单而有效的3D场景表示方法，通过将3D几何信息编码为文本参考，使MLLMs能够利用其强大的语言推理能力进行3D空间理解，显著提升了MLLMs在3D推理任务上的性能，且无需额外训练。

title: StreamReady: Learning What to Answer and When in Long Streaming Videos
summary: Streaming video understanding often involves time-sensitive scenarios where models need to answer exactly when the supporting visual evidence appears: answering before the evidence reflects speculation, answering after it has passed reduces real-time utility. To capture this behavior, we introduce a readiness-aware formulation of streaming video understanding with the Answer Readiness Score (ARS), a timing-aware objective with asymmetric early and late penalties. When combined with correctness, ARS defines an effective accuracy that measures not just whether a model is right, but whether it answers at the appropriate moment. Building on this formulation, we introduce StreamReady, a framework to unify temporal reasoning with on-time answering through a lightweight readiness mechanism that decides if sufficient evidence has been observed before responding. To evaluate this capability, we further introduce ProReady-QA, a benchmark with annotated answer evidence windows and proactive multi-turn questions across local and global contexts. StreamReady achieves superior performance on ProReady-QA, and consistently outperforms prior methods across eight additional streaming and offline long-video benchmarks, demonstrating robust and broadly generalizable video understanding capability.

AI.tldr: StreamReady框架通过引入答案准备度评分(ARS)和轻量级准备度机制，实现流式视频理解中的适时回答，在ProReady-QA基准测试中表现优异
AI.motivation: 流式视频理解需要模型在支持性视觉证据出现时准确回答：在证据出现前回答属于猜测，在证据出现后回答则降低实时效用。现有方法缺乏对回答时机的精确评估机制。
AI.method: 提出答案准备度评分(ARS)，一个具有不对称早期和晚期惩罚的时间感知目标；开发StreamReady框架，通过轻量级准备度机制统一时间推理与适时回答；创建ProReady-QA基准测试，包含标注的答案证据窗口和主动多轮问题。
AI.result: StreamReady在ProReady-QA基准测试中表现优异，同时在八个额外的流式和离线长视频基准测试中一致优于先前方法，展示了鲁棒且广泛可泛化的视频理解能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入准备度感知的流式视频理解框架，实现了模型在适当时间回答问题的能力，不仅关注答案是否正确，还关注回答时机是否恰当，为实时视频理解提供了有效解决方案。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Gaussian Avatars: Improving Expression Generalization
summary: Template-free animatable head avatars can achieve high visual fidelity by learning expression-dependent facial deformation directly from a subject's capture, avoiding parametric face templates and hand-designed blendshape spaces. However, since learned deformation is supervised only by the expressions observed for a single identity, these models suffer from limited expression coverage and often struggle when driven by motions that deviate from the training distribution. We introduce RAF (Retrieval-Augmented Faces), a simple training-time augmentation designed for template-free head avatars that learn deformation from data. RAF constructs a large unlabeled expression bank and, during training, replaces a subset of the subject's expression features with nearest-neighbor expressions retrieved from this bank while still reconstructing the subject's original frames. This exposes the deformation field to a broader range of expression conditions, encouraging stronger identity-expression decoupling and improving robustness to expression distribution shift without requiring paired cross-identity data, additional annotations, or architectural changes. We further analyze how retrieval augmentation increases expression diversity and validate retrieval quality with a user study showing that retrieved neighbors are perceptually closer in expression and pose. Experiments on the NeRSemble benchmark demonstrate that RAF consistently improves expression fidelity over the baseline, in both self-driving and cross-driving scenarios.

AI.tldr: RAF通过检索增强训练方法，为无模板可动画头部化身提供更广泛的表达式覆盖，提高身份-表情解耦和跨驱动鲁棒性
AI.motivation: 无模板可动画头部化身虽然能实现高视觉保真度，但由于仅从单个身份观察到的表情进行学习，存在表达式覆盖有限的问题，当驱动动作偏离训练分布时表现不佳
AI.method: 提出RAF（检索增强面部）训练时增强方法：构建大型无标签表情库，训练时用最近邻检索的表情特征替换部分原始表情特征，同时重建原始帧，让变形场接触更广泛的表达式条件
AI.result: 在NeRSemble基准测试中，RAF在自驱动和跨驱动场景下均持续提升表达式保真度，用户研究表明检索邻居在表情和姿态上感知更接近
AI.conclusion: RAF通过简单的检索增强方法，无需配对跨身份数据、额外标注或架构更改，就能改善无模板头部化身的表情多样性、身份-表情解耦和分布偏移鲁棒性

title: CAST: Modeling Visual State Transitions for Consistent Video Retrieval
summary: As video content creation shifts toward long-form narratives, composing short clips into coherent storylines becomes increasingly important. However, prevailing retrieval formulations remain context-agnostic at inference time, prioritizing local semantic alignment while neglecting state and identity consistency. To address this structural limitation, we formalize the task of Consistent Video Retrieval (CVR) and introduce a diagnostic benchmark spanning YouCook2, COIN, and CrossTask. We propose CAST (Context-Aware State Transition), a lightweight, plug-and-play adapter compatible with diverse frozen vision-language embedding spaces. By predicting a state-conditioned residual update ($Δ$) from visual history, CAST introduces an explicit inductive bias for latent state evolution. Extensive experiments show that CAST improves performance on YouCook2 and CrossTask, remains competitive on COIN, and consistently outperforms zero-shot baselines across diverse foundation backbones. Furthermore, CAST provides a useful reranking signal for black-box video generation candidates (e.g., from Veo), promoting more temporally coherent continuations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种用于一致视频检索的上下文感知状态转换方法，通过预测视觉历史的状态条件残差更新，在冻结的视觉语言嵌入空间中引入显式归纳偏置，以解决现有检索方法在推理时忽略状态和身份一致性的问题。
AI.motivation: 随着视频内容创作向长篇叙事转变，将短视频片段组合成连贯故事线变得越来越重要。然而，现有的检索方法在推理时缺乏上下文感知，优先考虑局部语义对齐而忽略了状态和身份一致性。为了解决这一结构性限制，需要开发能够保持视频内容连贯性的检索方法。
AI.method: 提出了CAST（上下文感知状态转换），这是一个轻量级、即插即用的适配器，兼容各种冻结的视觉语言嵌入空间。通过从视觉历史中预测状态条件残差更新（Δ），为潜在状态演化引入显式归纳偏置。
AI.result: 在YouCook2和CrossTask数据集上性能得到提升，在COIN数据集上保持竞争力，并在各种基础骨干网络上一致优于零样本基线。此外，CAST为黑盒视频生成候选（如Veo）提供了有用的重排序信号，促进了更时间连贯的延续。
AI.conclusion: CAST方法有效解决了视频检索中的状态一致性问题，通过上下文感知的状态转换机制，在保持语义对齐的同时增强了视频内容的连贯性，为长视频叙事创作提供了实用的技术解决方案。

title: ImprovedGS+: A High-Performance C++/CUDA Re-Implementation Strategy for 3D Gaussian Splatting
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure. Technical Report. This work introduces ImprovedGS+, a library-free C++/CUDA implementation for 3D Gaussian Splatting within the LichtFeld-Studio framework. Source code available at https://github.com/jordizv/ImprovedGS-Plus
summary: Recent advancements in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have shifted the focus toward balancing reconstruction fidelity with computational efficiency. In this work, we propose ImprovedGS+, a high-performance, low-level reinvention of the ImprovedGS strategy, implemented natively within the LichtFeld-Studio framework. By transitioning from high-level Python logic to hardware-optimized C++/CUDA kernels, we achieve a significant reduction in host-device synchronization and training latency. Our implementation introduces a Long-Axis-Split (LAS) CUDA kernel, custom Laplacian-based importance kernels with Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS) for edge scores, and an adaptive Exponential Scale Scheduler. Experimental results on the Mip-NeRF360 dataset demonstrate that ImprovedGS+ establishes a new Pareto-optimal front for scene reconstruction. Our 1M-budget variant outperforms the state-of-the-art MCMC baseline by achieving a 26.8% reduction in training time (saving 17 minutes per session) and utilizing 13.3% fewer Gaussians while maintaining superior visual quality. Furthermore, our full variant demonstrates a 1.28 dB PSNR increase over the ADC baseline with a 38.4% reduction in parametric complexity. These results validate ImprovedGS+ as a scalable, high-speed solution that upholds the core pillars of Speed, Quality, and Usability within the LichtFeld-Studio ecosystem.

AI.tldr: ImprovedGS+ 是一个在 LichtFeld-Studio 框架中实现的 3D 高斯泼溅优化方案，通过硬件优化的 C++/CUDA 内核显著降低了训练延迟，在 Mip-NeRF360 数据集上建立了新的帕累托最优前沿。
AI.motivation: 3D 高斯泼溅技术需要在重建保真度和计算效率之间取得平衡。现有方法存在主机-设备同步和训练延迟问题，需要更高效、硬件优化的实现方案。
AI.method: 从高级 Python 逻辑转向硬件优化的 C++/CUDA 内核，引入长轴分割 CUDA 内核、基于拉普拉斯算子的自定义重要性内核（带非极大值抑制的边缘评分）以及自适应指数尺度调度器。
AI.result: 在 Mip-NeRF360 数据集上，1M 预算变体相比最先进的 MCMC 基线减少 26.8% 训练时间（节省 17 分钟），使用 13.3% 更少的高斯分布同时保持更优视觉质量；完整变体相比 ADC 基线 PSNR 提高 1.28 dB，参数复杂度降低 38.4%。
AI.conclusion: ImprovedGS+ 是一个可扩展的高速解决方案，在 LichtFeld-Studio 生态系统中保持了速度、质量和可用性的核心支柱，建立了新的帕累托最优前沿。

title: Talking Together: Synthesizing Co-Located 3D Conversations from Audio
summary: We tackle the challenging task of generating complete 3D facial animations for two interacting, co-located participants from a mixed audio stream. While existing methods often produce disembodied "talking heads" akin to a video conference call, our work is the first to explicitly model the dynamic 3D spatial relationship -- including relative position, orientation, and mutual gaze -- that is crucial for realistic in-person dialogues. Our system synthesizes the full performance of both individuals, including precise lip-sync, and uniquely allows their relative head poses to be controlled via textual descriptions. To achieve this, we propose a dual-stream architecture where each stream is responsible for one participant's output. We employ speaker's role embeddings and inter-speaker cross-attention mechanisms designed to disentangle the mixed audio and model the interaction. Furthermore, we introduce a novel eye gaze loss to promote natural, mutual eye contact. To power our data-hungry approach, we introduce a novel pipeline to curate a large-scale conversational dataset consisting of over 2 million dyadic pairs from in-the-wild videos. Our method generates fluid, controllable, and spatially aware dyadic animations suitable for immersive applications in VR and telepresence, significantly outperforming existing baselines in perceived realism and interaction coherence.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种从混合音频流生成两个交互参与者完整3D面部动画的方法，首次明确建模了动态3D空间关系，包括相对位置、方向和相互注视，显著提升了对话的真实感。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常产生类似视频会议的"说话头像"，缺乏真实面对面对话中至关重要的动态3D空间关系（相对位置、方向、相互注视）。需要一种能够生成完整表演、精确唇形同步，并能通过文本描述控制相对头部姿态的系统。
AI.method: 提出双流架构，每个流负责一个参与者的输出；使用说话者角色嵌入和说话者间交叉注意力机制来分离混合音频并建模交互；引入新颖的注视损失来促进自然的相互眼神接触；构建了包含200多万对对话数据的大规模数据集。
AI.result: 该方法生成了流畅、可控且具有空间感知的双人动画，适用于VR和远程呈现等沉浸式应用，在感知真实性和交互连贯性方面显著优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次实现了从混合音频流生成具有动态3D空间关系的完整双人面部动画，通过创新的架构设计和数据集构建，为沉浸式通信应用提供了更真实的对话体验。

title: HiAR: Efficient Autoregressive Long Video Generation via Hierarchical Denoising
summary: Autoregressive (AR) diffusion offers a promising framework for generating videos of theoretically infinite length. However, a major challenge is maintaining temporal continuity while preventing the progressive quality degradation caused by error accumulation. To ensure continuity, existing methods typically condition on highly denoised contexts; yet, this practice propagates prediction errors with high certainty, thereby exacerbating degradation. In this paper, we argue that a highly clean context is unnecessary. Drawing inspiration from bidirectional diffusion models, which denoise frames at a shared noise level while maintaining coherence, we propose that conditioning on context at the same noise level as the current block provides sufficient signal for temporal consistency while effectively mitigating error propagation. Building on this insight, we propose HiAR, a hierarchical denoising framework that reverses the conventional generation order: instead of completing each block sequentially, it performs causal generation across all blocks at every denoising step, so that each block is always conditioned on context at the same noise level. This hierarchy naturally admits pipelined parallel inference, yielding a 1.8 wall-clock speedup in our 4-step setting. We further observe that self-rollout distillation under this paradigm amplifies a low-motion shortcut inherent to the mode-seeking reverse-KL objective. To counteract this, we introduce a forward-KL regulariser in bidirectional-attention mode, which preserves motion diversity for causal inference without interfering with the distillation loss. On VBench (20s generation), HiAR achieves the best overall score and the lowest temporal drift among all compared methods.

AI.tldr: HiAR提出了一种分层去噪框架，通过在所有块上并行执行因果生成，使每个块始终在相同噪声水平下进行条件生成，解决了自回归扩散模型中时间连续性和质量退化的问题。
AI.motivation: 自回归扩散模型在生成无限长度视频时面临时间连续性保持和误差累积导致质量退化的挑战。现有方法通过高度去噪的上下文来确保连续性，但这会以高置信度传播预测误差，加剧质量退化。
AI.method: 提出HiAR分层去噪框架：1）采用与当前块相同噪声水平的上下文进行条件生成；2）反转传统生成顺序，在每个去噪步骤中在所有块上并行执行因果生成；3）引入前向KL正则化器来对抗低运动捷径问题。
AI.result: 在VBench（20秒生成）上，HiAR获得了最佳综合评分和最低的时间漂移；在4步设置中实现了1.8倍的实时加速；有效保持了运动多样性。
AI.conclusion: HiAR通过分层去噪框架和相同噪声水平的条件生成，成功解决了自回归扩散模型中的时间连续性和质量退化问题，同时实现了高效的并行推理和运动多样性保持。

title: FVG-PT: Adaptive Foreground View-Guided Prompt Tuning for Vision-Language Models
summary: CLIP-based prompt tuning enables pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to efficiently adapt to downstream tasks. Although existing studies have made significant progress, they pay limited attention to changes in the internal attention representations of VLMs during the tuning process. In this paper, we attribute the failure modes of prompt tuning predictions to shifts in foreground attention of the visual encoder, and propose Foreground View-Guided Prompt Tuning (FVG-PT), an adaptive plug-and-play foreground attention guidance module, to alleviate the shifts. Concretely, FVG-PT introduces a learnable Foreground Reliability Gate to automatically enhance the foreground view quality, applies a Foreground Distillation Compensation module to guide visual attention toward the foreground, and further introduces a Prior Calibration module to mitigate generalization degradation caused by excessive focus on the foreground. Experiments on multiple backbone models and datasets show the effectiveness and compatibility of FVG-PT. Codes are available at: https://github.com/JREion/FVG-PT

AI.tldr: FVG-PT是一种针对视觉语言模型提示调优的改进方法，通过自适应前景注意力引导模块解决预测失败问题，提升模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有CLIP提示调优方法在调整过程中对视觉语言模型内部注意力表示的变化关注有限，预测失败模式可归因于视觉编码器前景注意力的偏移。
AI.method: 提出FVG-PT方法，包含三个核心模块：可学习前景可靠性门自动增强前景视图质量，前景蒸馏补偿模块引导视觉注意力聚焦前景，先验校准模块缓解过度关注前景导致的泛化退化。
AI.result: 在多个骨干模型和数据集上的实验证明了FVG-PT的有效性和兼容性。
AI.conclusion: FVG-PT通过自适应前景注意力引导机制有效缓解了提示调优中的注意力偏移问题，提升了视觉语言模型的适应性能。
